title: Screw Puzzle Master
description: Pull out the nuts and bolts and release the woods. Get ready for a fluent and entertaining screw puzzle! It is time to do some brain practice. Many game levels, entertaining puzzles, and super power-ups await you!  Challenge a friend and complete chapters as fast as you can. Place the bolts as strategically as you can. Buy different skins and play in a different ambient.

title: Hyper Wave Challenge
description: Control the Wave, avoid obstacles, collect coins, and reach the end of each level. Every level features dangerous obstacles that require precision and dexterity, while portals keep the gameplay engaging.

title: Mahjong Cute Tiles
description: Enjoy a classic Mahjong game, now in another dimension! Rotate the board, explore fresh tile layouts and challenge your mind. Show off your skills and use powerful boosters like undo moves, tile shuffles, bombs and hints to help you advance faster.

title: Queen of Mahjong
description:
Plunge into the atmosphere of a magical world in a new game in the style of Mahjong Connect. Discover several worlds of objects by finding identical pairs of different items!

Queen of Mahjong is an amazing game that will give you moments of pleasure.

title: Basketball Fever
description:
Get ready for endless basketball fun! Basketball Fever features four exciting basketball challenges anyone can enjoy. 

Sharpen your aim, beat your high score, or just enjoy quick bursts of arcade-style fun, Basketball Fever delivers nonstop action that’s easy to pick up and hard to put down. It’s the ultimate way to test your reflexes, timing, and accuracy.

Simple controls, smooth gameplay, and satisfying physics make every shot feel rewarding.

title: DIY Phone Case Shop
description: Welcome to Case Craft, a fun and creative game where you'll design and decorate phone cases to impress clients! Run your own phone case shop, attract customers, and fulfill their unique requests. Customize phone cases with various designs, patterns, and themes, and decorate your shop with attractive items to draw in customers. As you meet client demands, earn rewards and upgrade your shop to become the top phone case designer!

title: Cinema Empire Idle Tycoon
description: Welcome to Cinema Empire Idle Tycoon! Do you dream of owning your own movie theater empire? Now's your chance! In this super fun idle simulation management game, you'll start with a small screening room! Build your own cinema empire! As a theater owner, you need to manage every aspect of the theater. Unlock the theater's facilities, ticket booths, movie halls, dining areas, and more. Hiring employees to help you get more bang for your buck.

title: Block Escape
description: Block Escape is a brain-teasing puzzle game where players clear blocks by moving them off the screen in the direction shown by the arrows on each block. Each level requires logical thinking and careful planning, as blocks can only move in specific directions, making every puzzle increasingly challenging and strategic.

title: Neighborhood Defense
description: Neighborhood Defense is a dynamic tower defense strategy game where your mission is to protect your neighborhood from waves of zombies. Diverse maps with multiple exits, different types of enemies, and limited tower spots make each match unique. Upgrade your towers, combine their abilities, and plan your tactics carefully to stop the horde and prevent them from breaking through.

title: Italian Brainrot Baby Clicker
description: Get ready for the cutest twist on the viral Brainrot universe! Italian Brainrot Baby Clicker is the baby-themed sequel to the hit Brainrot Clicker! Tap your way through the baby versions of your favorite characters, collect upgrades, and enjoy a whole new atmosphere with colorful visuals, cheerful music, and fresh sound effects designed to fit the playful baby theme!

title: Car Destruction King
description: Get behind the wheel and push your limits in this dynamic driving simulator! Choose from different cars, race across diverse maps, and challenge yourself against rotating hammers, giant presses, catapults, and other wild obstacles. With multiple game modes, realistic crash physics, and even the ability to slow down time, every drive is an unpredictable adventure. Set new records, experiment with stunts, and see how far your skills can take you!

title: Geometry Rush 4D
description: Geometry Rush 4D is an exhilarating 4D platformer that takes speed, precision, and reflexes to the next level. In this fast-paced, action-packed game, you guide a customizable character through vibrant, geometric worlds filled with intricate obstacles and dynamic traps. The game's signature dash mechanic allows players to perform rapid movements, weaving through ever-changing environments with seamless control.

title: Merge Hotel Empire
description: You can generate and collect different new items by synthesizing the same items, and then use them to create and decorate a new mansion for the hotel empire of the story.

title: Super Oliver World
description: Super Oliver World is an arcade game where you help little Oliver escape the dangers of a parallel world full of traps and dangerous enemies. Break blocks to find power-ups, coins, and other surprises along the way!

title: 67 Clicker
description:
Forget everything you know about gaming. Experience the absolute peak of interactive entertainment. It’s not just a number; it’s a lifestyle. Tap the 67 and watch your empire grow.

FULLY AUTOMATED STONKS: Buy upgrades to make the 67 click itself. It’s literally free real estate.

PEAK BRAIN ROT: No thoughts, just 67. The perfect idle experience for fans of "number go up" simulators.

title: Beach Club
description:
Calm down and manage your Beach Club!
Relax while listening to the waves, the ocean and some gulls. And soon you'll feel like you're floating around at the beach...
Let your helpers do all the work, stroll through the sand and collect the money from your customers.
Unlock new stuff so that even more people will come to your beach :D

Buy more seats, expand your beach and build your own empire!
Get some clean towels and make your Beach Club the most beautiful place.

title: Guinea Piggy Matching
description:
Guinea Piggy Match uses well known and easy to learn game mechanics. Your target is to take apart a pattern made of tiles. 
For each completed level, you are given a golden puzzle piece. For these, you can uncover images of cute guinea piggies.

title: Fashion Makeover Dash
description: Ready for a fun fashion adventure? In Fashion Makeover Dash, you can run through the mall, collect cute outfits, stylish accessories, and shiny coins along the way! After the dash, it’s makeover time! Dress up your character with all the fashion items you collected and create the cutest look ever. You can also use coins to decorate your room and make it extra stylish. Run, collect, dress up, and have fun in the ultimate fashion makeover game!

title: Fresh N Fresh Tiles
description: Fresh N Fresh Tiles is a fun and simple elimination mahjong-inspired game, your goal is to move tiles onto the bottom of the screen (there is limited space for that) and match 3 tiles to clear them. If you like playing Match 3 puzzles or mahjong game, you will love to play this game.

title: Cargo Skates
description:
No obstacles, no matter how high, can stop me from collecting more goods.
Pass the obstacles and finally collect enough goods.
Now, your supermarket can open

title: Favorite Puzzles
description: Meet Favorite Puzzles, your new favorite jigsaw puzzles! This addictive puzzle game will delight you with an endless gallery of beautiful images for every taste! Favorite Puzzles will be interesting for kids and adult, in this game you can adjust the difficulty and divide the picture from 6 to 600 elements! To make jigsaw puzzles even more enjoyable and easier - you can always get a hint, include an example and display the grid! And you can also create a puzzle from your own pictures or photos!

title: Chibi Doll - Avatar Creator
description:
Street - it's no matter build your modern city life or just stick with village-like town world you always be enjoy with it! 

Room - decorate and design home girly world.

Gacha - unlock countless gachapon surprises your lovely avatar, bring gacha to your fantasy life! 

Dress Up Games - match and mix more than 5000+ girly items for dressing up princess: hairstyle, clothes, hats, accessories, freckles, moles, blush, wings, tails.

title: Football Rush 3D
description: Football Rush 3d is a fast-paced, one-touch soccer game that puts you in the boots of a solo football hero. Forget complex controls—just tap, strike, and score! Whether you’re curving shots from midfield or charging down the pitch with speed boosts, every moment is packed with action.

title: Traffic Rider Moto Bike Racing
description: If you are bored of playing typical bike driving games and want some rust and challenges. Then this new “Highway Traffic Bike Rider Game” is specially developed for you. Traffic bike riding is a tough thing to do, unless you love to ride a bike on highway roads and have traffic from both sides, you should be a pro stuntman to do so. Get your sports bike on the road and be aware of traffic all around. Challenge yourself and rush into the highway! Race, Dodge, Overtake, and Go FAST!

title: Mahjong Connect Cookware
description: Help your chef to clean his kitchen and remove all cookware by connecting them with a line that can change it's direction no more than 2 times!

title: Tiny Cars
description: Tiny Cars is a colorful arcade traffic management game where players must avoid collisions. With a top-down view and engaging gameplay, this game features 50 base stages set in various locations like crossroads, squares, and highways. After completing the initial 50 levels, players will encounter the same environments with increased difficulty, offering a challenging and addictive experience for traffic control enthusiasts. Enjoy managing the traffic and becoming a master of Tiny Cars, the ultimate arcade traffic management game!

title: Domino World
description: Play a timeless game of dominoes where strategy rules and every move matters. Unlock exclusive trophies and collectible wooden sets as you progress. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts seeking endless fun and challenges.

title: Moto Traffic Rider
description: Throttle the roaring engines of 6 awesome superbikes with insane speed limits and ride them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can ride and control these bikes and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Upgrade your bikes with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the rides. Are you ready to show your bike riding skills? Prove yourself in Moto Traffic Rider

title: Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots
description: Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots is a fast and rewarding collection game where action, risk, and strategy come together. Your mission is to break brainrot eggs, collect rare Brainrot characters, and safely deliver them to your base before time runs out. Each run is a mix of decision making and reflex.

title: Shoot 2048 Hexa
description: Shoot 2048 Hexa is a fun and colorful puzzle game where you shoot hexagon tiles with numbers to make bigger ones. Aim carefully and match the same numbers to reach new values. The board slowly fills up, so think fast and plan your moves. Try to stay in the game as long as you can and get the highest score!

title: Two Dots Remastered
description: Welcome to Two Dots Remastered, a fun and popular HTML5 connecting game enjoyed by gamers of all ages! Two Dot Remastered’s gameplay is straightforward: Match two or more dots in the same color (not diagonal ones) and then blast them! Enjoy playing Two Dots Remastered, the ultimate connecting game for gamers of all ages, and become a master at connecting dots!

title: Jewel Block
description: Jewel Blocks is a HTML5 Puzzle Game, Clear the rows and columns by dragging the blocks in the free cells!

title: Mustang City Driver
description: Dive into city driving with four game modes. Navigate realistic traffic and monitor your fuel while exploring busy streets. Enjoy stunning night city graphics, transforming the city into a neon-lit spectacle. Pedestrians add unpredictability, and hitting them triggers police chases. Customize your car's appearance and performance. All this chaos is accompanied by your cute dog. Whether evading the cops or just cruising, Mustang City Driver offers a thrilling and visually amazing experience.

title: Jewels Classic
description:
Jewels Classic is a match-3 game with a mystery theme! Match three or more of the same gems to clear them from the level. Use boosters to create epic combos and reap the rewards of chests and more!

There is no timer in Jewels Classic. That means you can take your time to select the best gem matches for the most points. To earn more points, complete more difficult gem matches. Instead of just three-of-a-kinds, try to make four-of-a-kinds, five-of-a-kinds, and even L-shaped matches. The game ends
when you run out of moves.

Jewels Classic trains important brain skills including visual acuity and concentration. Play now to prove your multifaceted skills and compete against the world in leaderboards for the top score!

title: Jewel Legend Quest
description: The most legendary quest of your life begins! Miners from all around the world have come to get their hands on these precious gems. Join them in the effort and engage in various challenges while trying to dig out as many diamonds as possible.

title: Galaxy Clicker
description: Explore space in Galaxy Clicker, a free online game where you travel through galaxies with just a click. Play on your phone or computer and enjoy a relaxing space adventure that tests your strategy while keeping you entertained.

title: Racing Ball Adventure
description:
Race down massive slopes at high speed through stunning green plains, cliffs, and canyons!
In this thrilling arcade adventure, collect the mystical Crystal to save the world from an impending disaster.
Grab your sphere and start your journey — an epic low-poly adventure awaits!

title: Phone Case DIY Run
description: Phone Case DIY Run is a very fun simulation game. What type of phone case do you have now? If you are interested in making a phone case, then come and join us to learn about the process! Collect the models, choose your favorite color for painting, then paste the picture and choose the pendant. Finally, the more phone cases you collect when you reach the end, the more money you get. Have fun!

title: Barbiecore Aesthetics
description: Step into a whimsical world of pastel dreams and retro vibes with the Barbiecore Aesthetics dress-up game! Test your fashionista skills as you mix and match vibrant colors, fluffy textures, and vintage-inspired patterns to create the most stunning doll-like outfits. From quirky accessories to flouncy dresses, this game offers endless possibilities to express your style. Embrace the Barbiecore trend and let your creativity soar as you curate the perfect wardrobe for our beloved fashion icon.

title: Offroad Crash Climber 4X4
description:
Offroad Crash Climber 4X4 is a physics-based driving game featuring Endless Mode and Crash Levels. Drive across rough terrain, climb steep hills, avoid hazards, and collect coins to upgrade your vehicle.

Improve your engine, suspension, wheels, repair system, and fuel capacity, and unlock special abilities like Bounce, Low Gear, and 4x4. With challenging terrain, dangerous obstacles, and rewarding progression, every run is a new adventure.

title: Hidden Magic OG
description:
Try to find out missing objects and help the alchemist create magic and potions in this challenges puzzle game.
Levels is a fantastic mystery house rooms locations.
Enjoy the adventure and magic atmosphere of the hidden object 3D puzzle casual game thanks to the highly detailed amazing fairy tale graphics.
This game is sure to take you on an adventure you won’t want to step away from.

title: Obby Toilet Line
description:
Obby Toilet Line starts in the most chaotic place imaginable: a gas station restroom line. Around 30 different characters are already waiting, and the queue stretches all the way past the store entrance. Your goal is simple, but the situation is not: earn money while you wait, move up the line, and reach the mysterious toilet at the end.

This is not just a “stand still” queue. The game uses an idle-style progression system: the position you’re standing in determines how much you earn.

title: Knee Case Simulator
description: Knee Case Simulator is a delightful beauty and doctor simulation game where you get to showcase your medical skills and fashion sense! Help Tiara recover from her knee injury and give her a stylish makeover once she's feeling better.

title: Let's Catch
description: Let's Catch is super addictive puzzle game with  Minimalistic & Elegantly designed approach,which lets you think out of the box and sharpen your mind.The Goal is to drag n merge the same numbered blocks. The challenge increases gradually with large numbered blocks.You get to enjoy this amazing new puzzle game while improving your memory, concentration levels and reflexes at the same time.

title: Triple Sort 3D Home Design
description: Welcome to the world of Triple Sort 3D: Home Design, where matching meets decorating! Dive in the puzzle-solving with and begin crafting a virtual space of your dreams. Get ready to transform ugly and cluttered rooms  into clean and cozy spaces! Discover the perfect blend of challenges, creativity, and an epic makeover journey that awaits you!

title: Egg Adventure: Mirror World
description: Mr. Egg accidentally entered the Mirror World. In this world, all the challenges in each level look the same with Egg Adventure 2, but the ways to pass them are different. Use your wisdom to help Mr. Egg bravely pass every level!

title: Stick Fight The Chaos
description: Hello young warriors! In Stick Fight The Chaos, the fierce battles between stickmen continue with even more action! Catch the weapons falling from the sky, challenge your opponent and become the champion of the battlefield! Keep your balance, focus on your enemy and keep fighting! Each level brings new surprises. Play alone or with a friend and defeat your opponents!

title: Sand Sort: Color Puzzle Game
description: Dive into Sand Sorting Challenge, the ultimate relaxing color sort puzzle! Tap, pour, and organize vibrant sand into beautiful bottles. This easy-to-play game adds a fresh twist to classic color sorting puzzles, combining soothing gameplay with a fun challenge that will test your focus and strategy. Can you fill every bottle with the right color and master the art of color sand sorting?

title: Slinky Color Sort
description: Slinky Color Sort Puzzle is a relaxing color-therapy game where you sort bright slinky rings into matching stacks. Easy to play yet surprisingly challenging, it’s perfect for calming down while keeping your brain active. Enjoy smooth gameplay, colorful levels, and satisfying logic puzzles.

title: Tropical Cubes 2048
description: A game in the genre of 2048. Skillfully use the game physics to your advantage. The goal of the game is to connect the cubes to the maximum number 2048 and not to lose. There is a booster in the game, which will make it fun and easier to pass the game.

title: Solitaire Summer: Klondike
description:
Ready to experience a summer full of Solitaire?
Finally, it's summer! Time to relax! What's better than to lay back, listen to the smooth tunes, enjoy the warm breeze coming from the sea and play some Klondike Solitaire.
Your goal in Solitaire Summer is simple, yet so addictive: Arrange all cards sorted by color in 4 stacks, from lowest to highest value. Can you remove all cards in the correct order and solve the Solitaire Summer puzzle?

title: Number Tubes
description: Relax and train your brain with Number Tubes — the addictive number sorting and merging game! Tap to move balls, merge the same numbers into bigger ones, and keep going to beat your best score. No time limits, no pressure — just pure fun. Perfect for fans of merge games, number games, and classic sort puzzles.

title: Find The Cat - Cat Search
description: Discover the exciting world of finding hidden cats in this original puzzle game! Look for cats on black and white backgrounds by tapping on them to complete levels. With each stage, you will unlock new places and receive unique challenges that will test your attentiveness and observation skills.

title: Foxy Eco Sort
description:
Join Foxy and Raccoon on their eco-mission! Sort waste, play match-3 and matching pairs to clean polluted locations. 

But it's not just cleaning! Uncover the conspiracy of cunning Ratty who wants to destroy the forest. Complete story chapters: track garbage trucks, expose arsonists and save your home!

title: Devil Dash
description: Level Devil Dash is ready to break the ultimate limit within your inner demon rage! Prepare for a hellish journey that demands top-notch improvisation skills and extreme patience. You will embark on an adventure through interconnected worlds, tightly linked to one another.

title: Kids Cute Pairs
description: Let your kids enjoy a traditional game of Concentration. In this game they can play in three various difficulties, each with its own unique pictures including fruits and vegetables, musical instruments and animals. Therefore it provides challenge for kids of all ages. The game also includes mode for two players so you can play together!

title: Nuts & Bolts Puzzle
description:
Play Nuts and Bolts Game, the new brain-challenging puzzle to challenge and test your IQ. Train your mind while relaxing with multiple levels of our game.
Become the master of logic puzzles and enjoy the creative gameplay we have prepared especially for you.

title: Block Puzzle - Jewel Forest
description: An addictive block puzzle game that helps train your eyes and brain. It is a combination between the Tetris and Jewels game styles.

title: Grass Land
description: Grass Land is a vibrant exploration game that drops you into a sprawling world of thick greenery and hidden surprises. Take control of your grass cutter, uncover valuable resources beneath the overgrowth, and build up your base as you roam the fields. Stay sharp, move fast, and make the most of every patch of grass you find.

title: Find Objects - Hidden Item
description:
Find objects on colorful maps with links and Easter eggs!
An interesting puzzle casual indie game in the genres of "Hidden Objects" and "Find the Differences"!

Embark on an exciting journey through beautiful 2D locations, where hundreds of hidden objects and riddles await you! Explore picturesque landscapes, mysterious cities and magical worlds to find all the hidden objects. And in the "Spot the Difference" mode, test your attentiveness by comparing two almost identical pictures!

title: Zombie Idle Defense
description: Prepare for a zombie showdown in Zombie Idle Defense! In this exciting idle defense game, you will be the last line of defense against wave after wave of zombie attacks! Build your defenses,upgrade your weapons, put your automatic turrets on fire, and fight off the undead!

title: Sort Resort
description: Unleash your creativity and puzzle-solving skills in this unique game! Your mission: sort colorful liquids into the right flasks while also drawing beautiful pictures. Each level challenges you with tricky sorting tasks, but there's more — as you pour and sort, stunning images will come to life! Enjoy a relaxing yet engaging experience that blends art and logic. Can you master both sorting and drawing? Play now and find out how fun and satisfying it can be!

title: Word Finder Board Game
description: Word Finder is a HTML5 Word Game.Squeeze your brain and find as many words as possible in two minutes!

title: SuperPixelint
description:
It's a game where you draw a cute little image.
You can develop color matching skills and accuracy without any burden.
Why don't you get out of your daily life for a while and heal yourself through coloring games?

title: Pyramid Solitaire
description: Pyramid Solitaire is an exciting HTML5 game that offers a modern twist on the classic Pyramid Solitaire experience. Enjoy its sleek design while you strategically match cards to clear the pyramid. Whether you're a seasoned player or new to the game, this version promises both fun and challenge.

title: Skillful Finger
description: Touch the screen and slide your finger along the glowing line without lifting it. Avoid barriers, stay clear of the edges, and react quickly as the speed increases. Customize your ball and tail, face dynamic obstacles, and enjoy endlessly generated paths that keep every run fast, challenging, and addictive.

title: Master Addiction Solitaire
description:
Challenge yourself and take on this brain teaser of a solitaire game!

Masterfully rearrange the cards so they end up in ascending order, from A to 6

If you need some help, there are hints, undos, and shuffle that you can use

title: Key Quest
description: Key Quest is a challenging escape game where you must solve a series of puzzles to escape mysterious rooms. Use logic and memory to find useful items, uncover secrets, and solve clever riddles until you discover the Golden Key.

title: Find Goods
description: Find and tap on goods! Clear the stage when you find all the goods. Game over when time runs out. You can scroll and zoom the map. Be careful, as tapping items other than those specified will reduce the time limit.

title: Winter Mahjong
description: Winter Mahjong is a fun and exciting game of Mahjong with mistletoes and christmas presents! Use your skills, strategy and luck to complete the game! There are some handy features to help you complete the full game.

title: Stickman Epic
description:
Choose from three unique characters, fight bosses and upgrade your hero's power!
Equip your hero with 72 different armor options, complete 15 exciting levels and fight 6 different bosses!
Open chests and get rewards!
Earn a rating and be the best among the rest!

Bonuses every day! Come and get them!

title: Hero Transform Race
description: Hero Transform Race is an action-packed and fun parkour game that transforms you from an ordinary person into a legendary superhero. Your goal is to reach the end of the track by transforming into the appropriate superhero form for the obstacles you encounter!

title: Single Line: Drawing Puzzle
description: Challenge your mind and unleash your creativity with Single Line: Drawing Puzzle! This exciting game is perfect for anyone who loves brain teasers and enjoys solving clever puzzles. Your mission is simple yet addictive: draw one continuous line to complete intricate designs without lifting your finger or retracing your steps. Are you ready to take on this one-line challenge? ?

title: Snow Ball Racing Mutliplayer
description:
Roll. Race. Win!

Build the biggest snowball you can — then launch it down the slope and watch it fly! The farther it rolls, the more wins you earn. Use wins to unlock new zones, collect pets, and climb the leaderboard.

Fast, satisfying, and endlessly replayable. Snowball Racing is perfect for players who love speed, upgrades, and competition.

title: Blastify II
description: Blastify II is a new addictive  tap-to-blast puzzle game. Easy to pick up and play, this game offers a delightful experience for all ages. With endless entertainment and a steady stream of new puzzles, you can enjoy playing for hours on end.

title: Darts King
description: Square off against your opponents in a game of skill and precision. Progress in leagues and prove time and time again you're the best darts player. Upgrade your darts and create your own very unique set.

title: Mini Golf Saga
description: Embark on an immersive golf adventure with Mini Golf Saga, a captivating 3D mini-golf game set against the backdrop of a picturesque beach, featuring diverse golf levels where precision is key to achieving the lowest hit count for a high score; facing limited hits per level, strategize your shots wisely and, when needed, watch a rewarded video ad to replenish your chances and continue the saga of sun-soaked golfing excitement.

title: Candy Tile Blast
description: Candy Tile Blast is a fun and addictive matching game. Tap two or more of the same tiles to blast them out. Collect all the required tiles to pass the levels!

title: Two Stunt Racers
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning sports car through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Hole Puzzle
description: Hole Puzzle is a fun and addictive casual game where a hungry cat with a magical black-hole mouth is ready to eat everything in sight! Move across colorful levels, collect tasty food, complete objectives, and grow bigger with every bite. Easy to play, satisfying to master, and packed with charming visuals, exciting challenges, and endless food-collecting fun. Can you become the biggest hungry kitty of all?

title: Bubble Shooter: Spinner Pop
description:
Take the classic bubble shooter to a new level! Bubble Shooter: Spinner Pop features a rotating puzzle core that rewards smart aiming and chain reactions. 
Clear all bubbles to complete each level and earn up to 3 stars (10 pts per direct match, 20 pts for freed bubbles).
Beware the deadly Magma Vortex, and avoid fouls that add extra bubbles for missed matches!

title: Ball Drop
description: Embark on a thrilling journey with Ball Drop, where your objective is to guide the bouncing ball safely through a series of perilous obstacles while avoiding deadly spikes. With its captivating minimalist design, responsive gameplay, immersive music, and 32 challenging levels, this game promises an addictive experience that will keep you hooked for hours.

title: College Girls Team Makeover
description: Try our new fashionista app "College Girls Team Makeover". Here you can dress up 5 high school best friends. They are the most popular school girls and always together. Everyone would like to be in their girl squad! They manage to be the most stylish girls in school, because they have their own fashion stylist and that’s you! You can control their whole look from the color of their skin and eyes to hairstyle and makeup. More than 1000 items of clothes and accessories are at your disposal!

title: Galactic Golf Solitaire
description:
Enjoy a relaxing round of Golf Solitaire, a fun and easy-to-play card game. The goal is to clear the board by matching cards that are one rank higher or lower than the one on the discard pile. Don’t worry about suits—just focus on the numbers! If you’re stuck, you can draw from the deck to keep the game going. Play at your own pace and see how many rounds you can win.

Perfect for a quick break or to unwind at the end of the day!

title: Sudoku Guru - classic sudoku
description:
Develop your logic and train your brain in "Sudoku Guru - Classic Sudoku"!
Enjoy Sudoku, solve daily challenges and get trophies for completing tasks.

There are 5 different difficulty levels available to you: easy, medium, difficult, expert and guru. Each level is a unique puzzle.
Track your progress and challenge yourself with the statistics report. This feature adds a competitive element to the game, motivating you to become a real guru.

title: Block Mania
description: Block Mania: Mixing classic block and jigsaw puzzles, it’s a burst of creativity into beloved games! With easy controls, immersive sound effects, and a catchy beat, Block Mania guarantees addictive fun!

title: Mahjong Adventure: World Quest
description:
Welcome traveler, to the most epic quest of all time! Test your Mahjong skills as you journey across the world.

It's time to put everything on the line as you challenge these intriguing yet challenging levels. Complete the quest and witness the wonders of the world.

How quickly can you match the Mahjong tiles? Come play now and let's find out!

title: Italian Brainrot Clicker
description: Italian Brainrot Clicker is a hilarious one-button idle clicker that throws you into the chaotic charm of the Italian Brainrot universe. Fueled by Gen-Z meme culture and AI-generated madness, this game unleashes a world of mutant creatures and meme-fueled mayhem. From dancing cappuccinos to cactus-bodied elephants, every tap pulls you deeper into a spiral of satire and brainrot. It is weird, it is wild, and it is wonderfully addictive. You will not believe what you are unlocking next!

title: Arrow Sorting
description: Arrow! Sorting Food is a satisfying puzzle adventure where every move changes the board. Tap the arrows to unravel colorful fruit chains, clear paths, and untangle tricky patterns across countless levels. Unlock new visual themes, collect fun skins, and enjoy relaxing yet brain-teasing gameplay that grows more challenging with every stage. Simple to learn, surprisingly addictive to master!

title: Wood Nuts Master: Screw Puzzle
description:
In this physics-based innovative puzzle game, your objective is to strategically place screws and nuts to fall all the wooden blocks.
Unleash your cognitive ability as you tackle each brain-teasing level, each one designed to test your problem-solving skills. From simple puzzles to complex constructions, this 2D puzzle game offers an array of challenges suitable for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages.

title: Urus City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning sports SUV through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Hexa Stack Christmas
description: Get into the holiday spirit with Hexa Stack Christmas: a festive twist on the classic hexagon-stacking puzzle game. Place the Christmas-themed hexagon tiles stacks onto the board and sort the same color tiles to collect them. The game combines a light puzzle that requires attention and logic — perfect for relaxing while stimulating your brain. 2 game modes, infinite levels, a user-friendly interface, and save support let you play anytime without losing progress.

title: Obby Parkour Racing
description:
Welcome to Obby Parkour Racing – the game where speed, agility, and style collide to create the ultimate racing challenge!

Jump, grind, and dodge through dynamic obstacle courses on your snowboard! Prove your mastery in a world where parkour isn't just on foot
it's on a board. Every race is a new test, and only the fastest and most agile champions will claim victory.

title: Geometry Platformer
description: Geometry Platformer is a fast-paced, reflex-testing platformer where players guide a shape-shifting cube through a series of dangerous geometric obstacles. The game features sharp spikes, swinging hazards, and gravity-defying mechanics that challenge your timing and precision. The neon graphics and intense gameplay create a thrilling experience, requiring quick reactions and memorization of complex patterns.

title: Stick Kill 3D
description: Play as a stickman armed with a pistol in this puzzle-based shooter, where precision and clever thinking are key. Find the right angle, line up your shots, and eliminate enemies in creative ways. Each level becomes more challenging, testing your accuracy and problem-solving skills.

title: Mahjong Stack
description: Mahjong Stack is a unique tile-matching game featuring realistic 3D mahjong tiles. Unlike classic match-3, blocks appear in stacked piles. Match identical tiles and drag groups of three to the tray to clear. Use boosters to speed up progress. Dive in and enjoy!

title: Craft Block World Building
description: Welcome to Craft Block World Building! This is the creative simulator to ignite your creativity. In this colorful world of cubes, you can build, design and create your own amazing world! You can also drive a car and explore the open landscape! Feel the thrill of driving across blocky mountains, rivers, and endless fields!

title: Street Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 stunning street cars with modified body kits and drive them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself in Street Traffic Racer

title: Witch Craft Potion Sort
description: Step into the witch’s lair this Halloween night and test your skills in a spooky potion puzzle! Sort the eerie liquids, mix glowing brews, and fill each cauldron with the right color to complete your craft.

title: TriPeaks Solitaire
description: Challenge your mind with Tri Peaks Solitaire, a captivating twist on the classic solitaire! Clear all cards from the three pyramids by removing them in ascending or descending order. With polished graphics and relaxing gameplay, each match is a perfect blend of strategy and fun.

title: Nonogram Daily
description: Puzzle, draw and train your brain in this unique Japanese logic puzzle. New images to draw and to puzzle every day in Nonogram Daily!

title: Bubble Pop Legend
description:
Bubble Pop Legend is the best way to kill time.
Aim & shoot to pop all colorful bubbles to clear the board and win coins.
You'll spend hours with fun & addictive Bubble Pop Legend to keep your mind active.

▶ How to Play

• Aim carefully and tap where you want to shoot
• Match 3 or more bubbles of same color to pop them
• Pop all colorful bubbles to win levels
• Use less shots to get higher score and earn 3 stars
• Plan and use epic boosters at the right time to BLAST ALL LEVELS

title: Home Island
description:
Looking for a family adventure game? Try our Home Island: Family Pin free puzzle games about village life in paradise island! Pull the pin to solve the puzzle, follow the story and enjoy adventures on the island.
On the adventure for discovering the new island, a family cruise ship plane had to face an accident because of the bad weather. The father has gone missing, but the mother and their daughter luckily survived and got to a strange island.

title: Murder
description: Ready for the scary world of Murder? Colorful Halloween scenes, accompanied by scary ghosts and jack-o '-lanterns, enhance the immersion of the game. On this most mysterious night,let you try a nervous assassination adventure! You will be a cunning assassin who will seize the moment to kill the king. Play the king when you kill successfully.

title: Arrows Puzzle Escape
description: Arrows – Puzzle Escape is an addictive puzzle game that combines deep logic challenges and a thrilling escape experience. Every level throws you into a jam-packed arrow maze where only smart planning can set you free. Arrows point in different directions, blocking each other and creating tricky jam situations.

title: Halloween Tiles Mahjong
description: Experience Halloween Tile Matching with a 9-space stack. Tap tiles to stack and clear the board by finding 3 identical tiles while maintaining free space. Avoid overfilling the stack to achieve victory!

title: Pinball VS Zombie
description: Dive into Pinball Zombie Defense, the ultimate fusion of pinball chaos and zombie tower defense! Plant defensive flora to create a ricocheting battlefield where high-speed pinballs smash into plants, unleashing bullet barrages on undead waves. Auto-collect sunlight to grow stronger defenses and hold the line—don't let a single zombie reach your house!

title: Antistress Relaxation Box
description: Antistress - Relaxation Box is a fun casual game. Have you long been upset with some people in your life? He may be your date or a relative, and this game will vent your dissatisfaction! Choose a character and a tool for hitting, and your task is to beat the blood bar to 0 in a limited time. Easy to pick up, but informative and will give you hours of entertainment. Relax yourself and have fun!

title: Screw Nuts & Bolts: Wood Solve
description: Embark on a Brain-Twisting Journey with Screw Nuts & Bolts: Wood Solve, an exceptional wood puzzle game about nuts and bolts to test your IQ brain power. For nuts and bolts lovers who likes challenge and innovative gameplay, the right game for you - the ultimate puzzle game - is here.

title: Miracle Mahjong
description: The panda has a challenge for you. You will face five tests on your way to the top. Attempt to finish all stages and earn the honor of being a Mahjong master.

title: My Farm life
description: My Farm life is a fun farm adventure simulator game. Plant fields, take care of animals, hire workers and build bigger barns. Harvest apples, wheat, tomatoes, eggplants and all your favorite fruits and vegetables. Raise all kinds of cute pets like your own farm dog, breed cows, sheep and hens for milk and eggs. Become the richest farming tycoon, sit back and enjoy!

title: Good Sort Master: Triple Match
description:
A new game for those who like to put order on the shelf, in the closet, in the refrigerator. Collect identical items in groups of 3 - sort, arrange, tidy!
Connect items three in a row, create coziness! Cleaning has never been so interesting and fun!
A simple and relaxing game for women and men of all ages!

title: Magic Beauty Makeup
description: Welcome to Magic Beauty Makeup, a casual and relaxing girl makeover game on H5games4u. The girl is in trouble with her appearance. Help her return to her original beauty with skin care and makeup methods. You will act as a makeover artist who does skin care, applies facial makeup, and designs a perfect look in the virtual fashion salon. And the best part? All the makeup procedures are done just by clicking and dragging.

title: Hidden Easter Egg Hunt
description: Dive into the fun world of Hidden Easter Egg Hunt, a fun and relaxing hidden object game for players of all ages! Explore colorful spring landscapes filled with blooming flowers, green fields, and playful bunnies as you search for hidden Easter eggs scattered around the game board. With charming graphics and a festive feel, this game is perfect for getting into the Easter spirit. Test your observation skills, challenge your attention to detail, and enjoy the joyful hunt!

title: Cards Match Puzzle
description: Jump into Cards Match Puzzle, where matching cards is your ticket to addictive fun! Place cards on a grid to create killer combos—think 2-3-4 or four cards for massive points. Wild jokers shake things up, slipping into any sequence, while frozen cards dare you to crack them loose. Boost your score with dazzling multipliers and watch matches explode! Quick to learn, tough to master—can you rule the grid? Play now and match your way to glory!

title: Lazy Dog
description: Jump into this cozy puzzle game and help your adorable pup reunite with his beloved ball! Calculate the angles, time your moves, and draw lines to help the lazy dog catch his beloved ball by guiding it to him with ropes. With satisfying physics, cozy visuals, and challenging puzzles, Lazy Dog is the perfect game for the whole family. No ads, no in app purchases - just pup-tastic fun!

title: Wood Block Jam
description:
Wood Block Jam is a vibrant, addictive puzzle game where you slide colored blocks to matching doors. 

Swipe and slide through hundreds of creatively designed levels, featuring arrow blocks, layer blocks, freeze blocks, lock blocks, and more. 

Plan your moves to overcome barriers and clear each board using the fewest moves. 

With intuitive controls, smooth animations, and mind-bending challenges from easy to extreme, Wood Block Jam delivers endless brain-teasing fun!

title: Capybara Suika
description:
Capybara Suika is a fun and relaxing food merge puzzle game starring adorable capybaras!
Inspired by the viral Suika Game, drop and merge food to grow bigger and score higher.
With colorful visuals, cozy vibes, and a tiny game size, it’s the perfect lite game to enjoy anytime!

title: Train Master
description: All aboard for an exciting ride in Train Master! Tap and hold to control your train, race through stunning tracks, pick up passengers, and dodge obstacles. Navigate bustling cities and peaceful countryside as you master the tracks, upgrade your train, and become the ultimate conductor. Simple controls, thrilling challenges, and endless fun await. Start your adventure now!

title: Lost Things - Hidden Objects
description:
Embark on an exciting adventure where your powers of observation are your main tool!
This is a relaxing hidden object game created for those who appreciate slow-paced gameplay and enjoy exploring detailed worlds. Forget about time pressure! Here you can explore huge, colorful maps filled with hundreds of artfully hidden objects at your own pace.

title: Stardom Alt-Girls Fashion Duel
description: Welcome to the world of daring alternative glamour! Meet two star heroines - Sydney and Sabrina. Help them go beyond the usual and try on the most daring alternative images: from a gentle soft-grunge princess to a gloomy rock diva. In the game, you can make bright makeup with arrows and sparkles; create unusual hairstyles; collect memorable outfits from tops, corsets, mini skirts and oversized jackets. Create your own collection of stunning Alt-girl looks!

title: Cake Link Master
description: Cake Link Master is a fun puzzle game where you tap two matching cakes to connect them with a line. The line can turn up to two times but cannot go over other tiles. The game has 120 challenging levels, and the difficulty grows as you play. Clear the cakes, solve the puzzles, and enjoy hours of sweet, relaxing fun!

title: Survive The Night
description: Are you ready for the most terrifying night of your life? Survive The Night is an intense horror survival game where you’re trapped in a dark, creepy room with something lurking in the shadows. Choose between Normal Mode or Horror Mode to challenge yourself. In Normal Mode, you'll receive more hints, fewer rooms, and standard monsters.

title: Catch a Fish Obby
description: Catch a Fish Obby is a chaotic collector raider set in a bright obby world full of Fish and Brainrot Fish characters. Build a money making base with your favorite sea creatures, sneak into rival bases to steal their fish, and protect your own tank from greedy bots and other players.

title: Water Sort
description: Experience the simple yet addictive water sorting puzzle game! It’s the ultimate free game for training your brain, killing time, and relaxing!

title: Archery Master
description: With a dynamic progression system, players unlock powerful bows, master challenging mechanics like wind and moving targets, and climb the leaderboards. From stationary targets to tricky trajectories, each level will test your reflexes and skill.

title: Shopaholic Black Friday
description: Experience fashion fun like never before with the Shopaholic Black Friday game! Navigate through makeup products, and indulge in chic fashion pieces. Hit the mall, shop as many items as you can before the time runs out, and then return for another styling adventure. Explore an array of lipstick hues, experiment with smoky eyes, or go for colorful shadows, and browse through fashionable dresses, trendy tops, and stylish shoes. Complete the look with dazzling accessories and designer bags.

title: Fireside Solitaire
description:
Fireside Solitaire is a cozy card puzzle that combines logic and relaxation by the warmth of a crackling fire.
Place cards in sequence — one rank higher or lower than the current open card — to clear all columns.
Think ahead: once the draw pile runs out, it can’t be reshuffled, and the game ends.
Enjoy calm music, soft light, and the comforting atmosphere of a winter evening by the fireplace.

title: Mathematical crossword
description:
- Math crosswords are randomly generated.
- You can choose the difficulty and turn on or off arithmetic symbols as you wish.
- Arcade mode is a mode in which you need to solve crossword puzzles step by step to gain ranking points. Also in this mode, after each completed crossword puzzle, the difficulty will gradually increase.
- You can exit arcade mode at any time through the game menu and save your game.

title: Arrow Wave
description: Explore a world where a wave moves through various obstacles, overcoming challenges along the way. Test your reaction and perseverance!

title: Parkour Block 6
description:
Skill game, classic mode from your favorite games right in the browser on your computer and phone!
More levels, more mechanics and new hardcore mode await for you

title: 100 Doors Challenge
description:
Do you like puzzles and hidden object games? Do you play games from the 100 Doors series? Then this point-and-click game is just what you need! Use all your skills to complete all levels and get all achievements.
The main goal in the "100 Doors Challenge" is to get out of the room. Using all the capabilities of the device, you need to open each of the 100 doors and move the elevator to the next floor. Find hidden objects, solve puzzles and use objects to do it!

title: Grill Party
description: Welcome to Grill Party! Step into the exciting world of grilling and become a master at crafting tasty skewers! In Grill Party!, you’ll experience a thrilling match-3 puzzle game where you’ll arrange meats, seafood, and veggies to create perfect combos. Serve up mouthwatering treats and show off your grilling skills!

title: Highschool Mean Girls 3
description: Play the Highschool Mean Girls 3 game and get ready to join 6 unique characters in the wild world of fashion drama in this brand-new dress-up game for girls. Test your fashion guru skills and transform high school wallflowers into show-stopping style icons. Rack up those style credits with a fabulous curated wardrobe and accessories. This dress-up game is where high school drama meets fashion week, straight from your screen. Happy playing!

title: Fire Ball and Water Ball: Parkour Love Balls
description:
Fire Ball and Water Ball: Parkour Love Balls is an interesting parkour adventure and addictive ball game in the platform genre where orange fire ball and blue water ball running races. 

Help orange ball to get to the portal faster than the blue ball doing parkour tricks! The game is similar to mario.

Game Features:
- Multiple levels with colorful balls
- Various biomes
- Secrets in the back
- Orange fire and blue water ball skins
- The water ball girl goes through the levels with you!

title: NinjaRoof
description: NinjaRoof is a fast-paced and addictive arcade game where players control a nimble character jumping from rooftop to rooftop while avoiding deadly obstacles and aiming for the highest score. Test your timing, precision, and reflexes in this endless jumping adventure built with smooth physics and clean visuals.

title: Fruit Merge Arena
description: Fruit Merge Arena is a fun and relaxing game where you drop fruits and merge the same ones to create bigger fruits. Keep merging step by step and try to reach the ultimate fruit — the watermelon! But be careful, space is limited and the board can fill up quickly. Plan your moves wisely and keep merging to stay in the game.Feeling stuck or running out of space? Don’t worry! You can watch a reward ad to remove all instances of a selected fruit and make room for new moves.

title: 2-3-4 Player Games
description: These games can be played with 2, 3, or 4 players. You can play 21 unique games with your friends, each with different scenarios. The objective of each game is to either score or be the first to reach the finish line. Move swiftly and outpace your opponents! It's time to enjoy with friends!

title: Bubble Shooter Pet
description: Bubble Shooter Pet features Three star ranking system in level mode Endless mode  Many levels to play Awesome new bubbles and power ups

title: Body Care Simulator
description: ASMR Cleaning is a fun simulation game on yad.com. There are four sections: foot spa, manicure, lip care, and clean inside the ear. You will enter a quiet and comfortable environment and experience different care processes. Have fun!

title: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online
description: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online game takes the familiar lucky box idea and turns it into a more active risk-and-return loop. You move through 14 areas, open boxes, collect brainrots, and decide whether to head back safely or keep pushing for rarer finds. Online play is available through 1 Player mode, while local 2-player adds a same-screen option for faster, more chaotic sessions. Rebirth, speed upgrades, better boxes, base expansion, and roaming bosses keep every run moving forward.

title: Farm Defense
description: Farm Defense is a fast, arcade-style shooter where you guard your ranch from waves of quirky mutants. Move between lanes, aim, and blast anything that crawls out of the burrows before it reaches your crops. Earn coins, unlock new weapons and gadgets, and power up your electric fence. Bright visuals, snappy controls, and escalating waves make every run tense and satisfying.

title: Football Superstars 2026
description: Ready for your next football challenge? Test your skills in a friendly match, or jump right in and lead your dream team in the World Tournament against international teams. Remember, no one ever drowned in sweat!

title: Hotel Manager
description:
Have you ever dreamt of being one of the biggest landowners in the world?

Get your (virtual) chance in this extremely addictive game!

Build hotels all over the world, upgrade them and crowd your opponents out of the market, leaving their customers to come to you!

title: Mojicon Emoji Connect
description:
A fast, fun twist on classic Onet puzzles!
Get ready to match and relax with Mojicon: Emoji Connect – the cheerful tile-linking puzzle bursting with personality!
Connect identical emoji tiles, clear the board, and enjoy satisfying spark effects with every perfect match.
With hundreds of cute icons, calming backgrounds, and rewarding combos, Mojicon delivers endless relaxing fun for all ages.
Play anywhere, anytime – no downloads, just pure emoji joy!

title: Happy Glass Puzzles
description: Three puzzle modes with a variety of levels to complete

title: Rolling Balls Sea Race
description: Designed for those who love ball games with realistic physics and elements, the goal of this game is to roll to the finish line without falling into the water. Master the control of the ball and collect coins on your route to unlock new balls, tail tracks and sky packages. You can play the game in 1 player mode or 2 player racing mode. Enjoy realistic nature, physics and effects in dozens of different levels!

title: Klondike Solitaire
description:
Test your skill and logic with Klondike, the classic solitaire game loved by generations!

Stack the cards in ascending order, alternating colors, and complete all four suits to win the game.

With clean graphics, intuitive controls, and the option to play with one or three cards, Klondike offers hours of fun and relaxation.

Perfect for a quick break or a long strategic challenge!

title: Rock Crawling
description: Welcome to the thrilling world of 3D Rock Crawling Racing, where speed meets strategy and off-road dominance is your only goal. In this high-adrenaline off-road simulator, players take the wheel of powerful 4x4 rock crawlers and navigate some of the most extreme and rugged terrains ever designed in a browser game. From sharp mountain ridges to slippery mud tracks, this is not your average racing game—it’s a true test of control, timing, and grit.

title: Parkour Block 7
description:
Skill game, classic mode from your favorite games right in the browser on your computer and phone!
More levels and more mechanics await for you

title: Idle Hotel Empire
description:
Grow your hotel empire in this idle tycoon simulation game.

Construct different hotel floors to suit the needs of your customers. This includes construcing standard hotel rooms, cafe bistros, deluxe rooms, meeting rooms for corporate customers, vip rooms, infinity pools, gym and fitness rooms and of course, the bougee presidential suite.

Control hotel employees, move them up and down the elevators to move the cash, and finally CASH it in the reception office.

title: Passenger Sort
description: Play Passenger Sort free online and take control in a fast-loading browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Guide travelers to the right buses, planes, and trains in a clever logic puzzle that works as a fun brain game for all ages. This unblocked game runs smoothly at school or home and is perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for smart sorting challenges anytime.

title: Last Day On Earth Survival
description: Last Day on Earth: Survival is a 2D survival simulation game. In this large ruined city, you have 51 locations to discover. When you collect some wood and metal, you can make weapons on the Workbench. When you win enough experience and level up, you can check your Attribute and upgrade HP, ATK, Speed, and Search. In the day, explore and go to places you have never visited. I hope you will survive 50 days and explore all 51 locations.

title: Hyper Cars Ramp Crash
description: "Hyper Cars Ramp Crash" is a 3D stunt and crash simulation game with realistic physics and graphics. You can perform incredible stunts in many different modes with great looking cars. 7 different super-sport car models are waiting in the garage for you to try them. Open world, stunt modes and fall mode can be played in 1-player and 2-player modes.

title: Airport Master Plane Tycoon
description: Airport Master - Plane Tycoon is an airport management simulation game. With 3D stickman models, you can control the manager of a larger airport. Each level has a target passenger for you to complete. You can unlock the gate, scanner, security check, and lounge in the tutorials.

title: Falling Blocks Puzzle
description: Falling Blocks Puzzle is a timeless puzzle game where players arrange falling geometric shapes, to form complete horizontal lines. As lines are completed, they disappear, and players earn points. The game ends when the stack of shapes reaches the top of the screen. It’s a test of strategy and quick thinking, beloved by gamers worldwide.

title: Run 3D
description: The infinite running platformer game Run 3D takes place in the immensity of space. The character must be navigated by players through the constantly shifting space. Go, leap, and keep yourself from plummeting into the chasm!

title: Pixel Art 2
description: Get rid of stress by coloring by numbers! Choose from a huge new collection of FREE 2D and 3D images. Paint by numbers and have fun!

title: Jelly Block Puzzle
description: Dive into the fun with our vibrant jelly merging game! Explore a world filled with countless levels, merge jellies, use power-ups, and stay entertained. Challenge your brain and see how far you can go in this delightful, jelly-colored adventure!

title: Head Basketball
description: With exceptional shots, Head Basketball is a simple yet entertaining basketball game. The ball must be shot into the hoop of your opponent. Two points for each shot. It is imperative that you surpass your rivals in points before the time runs out.

title: Ultimate OffRoad Cars
description: Give it a try to this new Ultimate OffRoad Cars game, become a better online driver, and play this OffRoad game to survive every obstacle that comes your way.

title: Shape Transforming: Shifting Run
description: Get ready to dive into the exhilarating world of Shape Transforming: Shifting Run, where the power of transformation is in your hands! This game is a thrilling journey across diverse terrains, challenging players to adapt, transform, and conquer. If you have a knack for quick thinking and love dynamic gameplay, this is the perfect game for you! ??

title: Cooking Fast 3 Ribs And Pancakes
description: Cook & serve tasty Ribs And Pancakes FAST as a chef in Cooking Fast 3 – the fun new kitchen game! The high tense and awesome gameplays brings you a fascinating experience and makes your time full of awesome cooking moments.

title: Mahjong 3D Candy
description: Have you ever thought about what would it be like to play your favourite mahjong 3D game with candies? Mahjong 3D Candy is exactly that! It takes our popular Mahjong 3D game into the world of sweet candies and cookies for you to match! So what are you waiting for? Play Mahjong 3D Connect now and solve the puzzle!

title: Math Obby
description: Combine your math skills with parkour prowess in Math Obby, an engaging Roblox experience that challenges players with arithmetic problems amidst obstacle courses. Navigate through stages that test both your agility and your knowledge of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Earn badges as you progress and showcase your mastery in this educational adventure.

title: Connect Animals : Onet Kyodai
description: In CONNECT ANIMALS ONET KYODAI game, your goal is to find all matching pairs. It's a kind of matching game or connect game ("linker"), that is very fun to play, really challenging and very addictive. If you like cute animals and if you like puzzle games, you will love CONNECT ANIMALS ONET KYODAI, by far the best deluxe version of the Onet type games.

title: Sprunki Mini Games
description: We present you a compilation of several games with the famous characters Sprunki. The first game is the classic Sprunki game but with an expanded orchestra, that is, with 9 singers. In the second game, you are presented with 10 pictures to color. While the third is a game of finding differences where you have 20 levels with 10 differences on each level.

title: Collect Em All
description:
Collect Em All! Is a puzzle game where you connect all the adjacent same colored blocks. Make long chains of colors to create beautiful sounds and unlock explosive power-ups!

Connect the dots to crush them. You can make a limited number of moves, and you cannot go back on yourself, so make sure to plan your path. Create the longest chains for the biggest reward!

 Come back every day to unlock new daily bonuses !

title: Anime Dress Up - Doll Dress Up
description: Anime Dress Up - Doll Dress Up is a fashionable and wonderful dress-up game with shocking graphic effects that will provide females with an unforgettable dress-up experience! This game is ideal for everyone who enjoys fashion and adventure, thanks to its amazing graphics and simple UI.

title: Fish Love
description: Save fish from danger, bombs, lava and crab and give the fish just love. They cannot live without each other. Beautiful and pleasant music, sound effects, bright and colorful graphics accompany you through all the puzzles of this game. Start your adventure now. Good luck in love !!!

title: Tower Defenders
description: Fight the undead viking warriors and upgrade your defenses. Use the rewards you get for victories to your advantage. Hold out for as long as you can!

title: EQ Test Puzzle
description: A puzzle game that tests emotional intelligence through emotion recognition and jigsaw puzzles. Match emotional icons, scenarios, and puzzle pieces to train your emotional awareness and problem-solving skills.

title: Merge 2048 Cake
description:
Merge 2048 Cake is a colorful and relaxing puzzle game where you merge matching tiles to create higher numbers!
Combine three or more identical tiles to form a new one with double the value. Plan your moves, trigger satisfying chain reactions, and aim for the ultimate 2048 tile!
Enjoy smooth gameplay, vivid visuals, and a cozy, casual vibe that’s easy to play and hard to put down.

title: Popping Candies
description: Match and crush candies to achieve goals in this addictive puzzle game! Swap adjacent candies to form rows of three or more and clear the board. Create special candies like striped, wrapped, or color bombs to enhance your progress. Overcome obstacles like chocolate and blockers while completing each level's unique objectives. Be mindful of your limited moves! Use boosters for extra assistance and advance through challenging levels to unlock new stages.

title: Red Light Green Light
description: Step into the thrilling world of Red Light Green Light, a fast-paced and addictive game inspired by the classic playground challenge! Test your reflexes, strategy, and timing as you race against others to reach the finish line without getting caught.

title: Draw Bridge Puzzle
description: Draw Bridge Puzzle is a creative and exciting puzzle game that combines drawing and rescue gameplay into one addictive experience. You become a bridge designer, using your finger to draw safe paths and complete thrilling rescue missions. Enter the car mode, draw a strong bridge to help a motor cross gaps, broken roads, and dangerous obstacles to reach the goal.

title: Skip Love
description: Ready for a funny, brain-teasing love adventure? Play an addictive brain teaser puzzle game in Skip Love. A funny little stickman hero trying to win the heart of his beloved while dodging all sorts of dangers! Each level has unique puzzles that make you think and laugh! Think and use your brain to overcome each challenge, helping the man overcome his sexy wife and lover. For example, help him disguise himself as a clown, disrupt, create chaos, etc.

title: TicToc Braided Hairstyles
description: Do you want to get in on the coolest hairstyles out there? We've got a braided hair game that'll blow your mind. Meet our two main characters: Regina and Kiki. They're here to show you the hippest braids around—and Brian, the hairstylist who will create them, will tell you how it's done. Once you've got the perfect braid for your girl, customize it even more! And when you're done with the hair, dress your girl up in some cute clothes! This is your moment to shine, what are you waiting for?

title: Muscle Challenge
description: Run, eat healthy foods and proteins and avoid harmful foods, drinks and obstacles in the Muscle Challenge game! Defeat your enemies with the strength and muscular body you gained at the end of the race! The enemies get stronger in each level, so you have to get better too... If you want, you can also play the game in challenge mode with your friend in 2 Player mode.

title: Arrow Escape: Master
description: Solve funny brain puzzles by moving the arrow and finding the correct path. Each level challenges your logic, reflexes, and creativity in a light and addictive way.

title: Triple Cups
description:
Triple Cups is a bright and dynamic puzzle game where your goal is to flip colorful cups and arrange them to create rows of matching colors!
Every move requires focus and strategy: pick up cups from the top and place them on the stand below to form groups of three or more of the same color. When identical cups line up, they disappear, freeing space for new moves.

title: Colossatron
description:
Take charge of a giant robotic snake and smash through cities with ease as you fight to create the most fearsome weapon of all time.
Unleash the power of Colossatron! A unique combination of Match 3 and Snake gameplay allows you to build a devastating machine by merging colored power ups to create new and more powerful weapons. With thousands of potential combinations, the key to victory lies in mastering the art of building Colossatron to take down formidable bosses.

title: Thrill Roller Coaster
description: Thrill Roller Coaster is a fun 3D roller coaster simulator game. Press and hold to accelerate forward, your speed and acceleration is fast enough for you to reach the other end of the track. Watch out for the brakes in the middle and drive the roller coaster at breakneck speeds now! Experience speed and passion!

title: Hidden Object Great Journey
description: “Hidden Object: Great Journey” is an engaging game that invites players to scour various themed levels for cleverly concealed items. With multiple modes, a lot of challenges, and a treasure trove of objects to find, this game promises endless fun for hidden object enthusiasts. Sharpen your observation skills and embark on a delightful search with every play!

title: Sprunki Phase Brainrot
description: Sprunki Phase Brainrot is a chaotic and hilarious reskin of the original Sprunki game, now powered by Italian Brainrot energy! Play as absurd meme legends like Tralalero Tralala, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Frigo Camelo, La Vaca Saturno, Lirili Larila, Burbaloni Luliloli, and many more. Run, jump, and lose your mind through surreal levels packed with brainrot humor, crazy visuals, and unpredictable madness. Enjoy custom sound effects and music that match each character’s bizarre personality!

title: Knife Madness
description: Aim, throw and survive! Watch out — avoid hitting other blades. The spinning wheel gets faster, the stakes get higher and only your quick reflexes will keep you in the game. Can you defeat the boss levels and unlock epic knife skins? The challenge is on!

title: Robot Awake
description: Robot Awake is a puzzle game to wake the robots by directing the laser to power them to complete the level. There are 100 challenging levels that get more difficult as you proceed. Can you solve all levels?

title: Idle Factory Domination
description: Embark on a journey of industrial dominance in Idle Factory Domination. Click on cells to purchase land, invest in businesses and resources to initiate production, and steadily expand your empire to unlock new territories, all while amassing wealth and asserting your manufacturing prowess.

title: Magic Finger
description: Magic Finger 3D is a casual physics game where you use your magical powers to defeat alien foes creatively. Use your magic touch to throw enemies at each other, utilize explosive barrels for big impacts, and send adversaries off platforms. Control your surroundings by picking up and manipulating objects, becoming the ultimate magic user.

title: Idle Pizza Business
description: Grow your own pizza empire by hiring staff, expanding your shop, and earning more money in this 3D idle business simulator!

title: K-Pop Hunters Valentine Style
description: K-Pop Hunters Valentine Style brings romance, fashion, and K-pop glamour together in one stylish dress-up experience. Help your favorite K-pop hunters transform their looks for Valentine’s Day with stunning outfits, flawless makeup, and charming accessories.

title: Jetpack Jump
description: Jetpack Jump is a fun and simple casual jumping game that lets you perform Olympic-style jumps with a little help from a jet pack strapped onto your back. Your aim is to jump as many meters as possible, constantly beating your best score. Your athlete will be rewarded generously in coins, which will help you upgrade and fly to even greater heights.

title: Bowling Stars
description: Enjoy a classic game of bowling with simple and fun gameplay. Earning trophies will unlock better bowling balls and help you win against more skilled opponents.

title: Stand on the Right Color, Robby!
description: “Stand on the Right Color, Robby!” is a fast arcade race on shifting colored tiles. React to color changes, jump from tile to tile, and stay on the right color to avoid falling. Beat rivals to the finish, earn currency, and unlock fun Robby skins, items, and effects as you climb the leaderboard!

title: Hazel Tangle Rope 3D: Sorting Puzzle
description: Untangle colorful twisted ropes in this satisfying 3D brain-teaser puzzle game. Strategically select and move rope endpoints to separate tangled knots and sort them by color. Use logical thinking and spatial reasoning to solve increasingly complex rope puzzles and become a tangle master.

title: Mahjong Zen Garden
description:
Do you like relaxing games? Or do you prefer a challenge? Try Mahjong Zen Garden and choose the way you want to play!

*Hone your attention to detail and planning skills in this classic Chinese puzzle game by choosing the best mode for you.
*120 unique campaign levels!
*Show your skills and unlock Endless Mode!
*Unique design with an Eastern atmosphere!

title: Hidden Object Adventure
description: Are you ready to solve puzzles and uncover hidden secrets? Become a detective in Find Hidden Object Game and test your observation skills! Explore detailed scenes in schools, houses, amusement parks, and zoos. Search for cleverly hidden items, challenge your brain, and enjoy fun, relaxing gameplay. Perfect for casual players and puzzle lovers alike. Train your mind and become the ultimate detective!

title: Glossy Bubbles Challenge
description:
Dive into our bubble shooter! Burst bubbles, match colors, and rack up points in this addictive arcade game.

In the Glossy Bubbles Challenge, you'll encounter an incredibly colorful interface! The simple game mechanics combined with precise aiming create an atmosphere of complete control. Your task is to pop as many bubbles as possible with a single shot to achieve a high score. The ability to react quickly is crucial because the bubbles are relentlessly approaching!

title: Ballerina Cappuccina First Date
description: Tonight’s a big night—Cappuccina and Tung Tung Sahur are heading out on their very first date, and they want to look perfect. In Ballerina Cappuccina First Date, you’re the stylist behind their special evening. From choosing outfits to adding finishing touches, it’s up to you to make sure both of them shine.

title: Classic Sudoku Puzzle
description: A sudoku classic game that meets a sudoku grid. Whether you want to train your brain or pass your free time. It’s a calm but challenging puzzle that you’ll be addicted to in no time!

title: Christmas Float Connect
description: Connect 2 same christmas items with a path that no more than two 90 degree angles. Clear the board by removing all pairs of identical christmas items. Becareful, in some levels the christmas item tiles can float ( to bottom, to uper, to left, to right, to center or split). There are 27 challenging levels in this game. Complete a level before time bounds to get extra bonus.

title: Sneaker Art
description: Sneaker Art is a creative casual art game where you become a pro sneaker designer. Grab your paintbrush, unleash your imagination, and craft unique shoe designs. Choose from a variety of laces, showcase your artwork, and sell your masterpieces in your sneaker shop. Pack your custom sneakers in stylish boxes and grow your business with every sale!

title: Idle Cat Diggers
description: In this charming game, operate cat-shaped diggers to mine gold within a vast underground cave. As you progress, unlock different types of cats with distinct abilities and use your gold to upgrade their digging ability for more efficient mining.

title: Baby Hazel Ballerina Dance
description: Cheerful morning of Baby Hazel starts with surprise gifts. While having shower, she is given interesting tasks to complete and on winning receives ballerina toys from mom. Another reason for Hazel to be very excited is that she is going to learn ballerina dance. But our little doll is feeling bit nervous and uneasy in her dance class. Can your encourage Hazel and make her comfortable so that she follows the instructions of teacher carefully.

title: Real Flight Simulator
description: Real Flight Simulator plays like an airplane driving simulation game with 3D models. In 6 levels, you can learn how to drive an airplane including starting, steering, and landing. All of the complicated instrument panels are simplified for players to learn. The more expensive the airplane you drive, the better acceleration of it you can enjoy including the Power, Speed, Solution, and Brake. Good luck in the sky!

title: Pixel Art 3D
description: Let’s play with tons of amazing 3D pixel arts! Pixel Art 3D has an incredibly wide range of categories of arts that you can color, like animals, vehicles, foods, and much more! Chose an amazing 3D pixel art that you want to color. Select a color and simply press and hold the blocks with the same number to fill.

title: Carnage Battle Arena
description:
Get Carnage now and discover a new kind of racing game! Driving fast and getting to the finish line is only one of the multiple challenges that await you. Wreak havoc on the streets thanks to the extensive destruction model that lets you not only damage vehicles, but also cause visible changes in the environment. After a long battle, the location will look nothing like it used to at the start!

Whichever mode you choose, get ready for loads of adrenaline-pumping action! Play Carnage now!

title: Arrow Count Master
description: Arrow Count Master is a fast and satisfying runner where every choice changes your firepower. Swipe to move and choose between gates that add, subtract, multiply, or boost your arrows. Build the biggest arrow count possible while avoiding penalties and obstacles along the way.

title: 2048 Cube Merge
description: How far can your skills take you? Target, shoot and merge cubes while unlocking exciting upgrades and customizations. Enjoy captivating gameplay and stunning visuals with every move you make. The 2048 cube challenge begins now!

title: Boss Market
description: You are the owner of your market. Customers are coming to buy various products. Collect these products and place them into correct stands so that customers can buy them. Collect money from customers and open new markets and become a market boss!

title: Happy Bubbles
description: Boom! Hear that pop? The bubbles are calling! This classic bubble shooter blends quick reflexes with clever strategy. Spin the Lucky Wheel for extra rewards, claim weekly bonus and dive into a bright, cute world that never runs out of fun.

title: Xmas Mahjong Trio Solitaire
description: Embark on a festive adventure with 'Xmas Mahjong Trio Solitaire.' Arrange Mahjong tiles in a horizontal stack of 9, strategically making trios disappear for extra cheer. Be cautious of overflowing stacks, as it signals the end of the game. Unwrap the joy of Xmas in this simple yet engaging holiday experience!

title: Gold Mine Strike Christmas
description: Gold Mine Strike Christmas brings a new way of playing Gold Strike with a Christmas flavor. Throw candy canes, get rid of packages and use powerups to enhance your progress. The gold you acquire is used to upgrade the powerups.

title: Number Master Run And Merge
description: Number Master: Run And Merge is an awesome number racing game that lets you run, merge, and upgrade on a parkour platform to become a true number master! Control your number character as you run through dynamic tracks. Keep collecting more numbers and expanding. Merge with matching numbers to grow stronger. The bigger your number, the more unstoppable you become! Pick the smartest paths, hit speed zones, and keep your speed maxed out!

title: Italian Brainrot in Geometry Dash
description:
Italian Brainrot in Geometry Dash:
