Explore a world where a geometric wave rushes through crazy obstacles, overcoming challenges one after another. Rhythm, chaos, and a splash of Italian madness — test your reaction and endurance in this geometric trial!

On different levels, you’ll encounter various Italian Brainrot animals: Tralalero Tralala, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Brr Brr Patapim, Lirili Larila.

title: Sea Match
description: See Match is a challenging match-3 puzzle game. Connect 3 or more of the same fishes horizontally or diagonally. The more fishes you match, the higher your score! Keep an eye on the time. You will fail to pass the level if you do not gather sufficient grids in time. The faster you complete the task, the more stars you earn! If you find yourself stuck, you can always use the special bonuses to help you.

title: Knife.io
description: Knife.io is a fast-paced 2D battle game where you throw knives at your enemies to eliminate them! Dodge incoming attacks, aim precisely, and take down as many opponents as possible without getting hit. With vibrant worlds to explore and tons of unique characters to unlock, every match is a colorful and action-packed challenge. Play solo or team up with a friend in local multiplayer, only the sharpest player will survive!

title: Noob: parkour tricks
description:
Welcome to Noob: Parkour tricks!

This is a runner and timekiller in the minecraft universe about the adventures of Noob. Do parkour tricks and complete challenges.

Monster School kicked out Noob, and Herobrine turned him into a Gigachad!

Game Features:
- Run through the village with trials.
- Do parkour tricks.
- Complete challenges and avoid traps.
- Collect diamonds.
- Unlock new skins.

title: Funny Zoo Emergency
description:
Be the best veterinarian by taking care of these baby animals.
Help them to cure their sickness and solve every animal's problems.
Treat injured animals, clean all the dirt, dress them up with unlimited outfit
combination, and make them perfect again.

title: Sorting Sorcery
description:
All the pots, crystals, mushrooms and other magical ingredients have been mixed up! Brush up your organizing skills and sort the witches’ and wizards’ items in the magic castle.

The fewer moves you use, the higher your score per level will be. You can earn three stars in every level if you solve the puzzles efficiently, so plan your moves! Sorting Sorcery includes a total of fifty levels with witchy, spooky and magical ingredients to discover and organize.

title: IDLE Pet
description: Anatomical clicker. Start with one cell and create a whole animal! You will see what the body is made of from the inside, gradually growing bones, organs, skin and wool!

title: Free Hoops
description: Welcome to Free Hoops, the ultimate puzzle game that combines creativity, humor, and strategic problem-solving! Dive into a world of quirky challenges where your goal is to skillfully adjust iron bars and guide elastic bands into predetermined boxes. Once the bands are in place, use them to tie around objects and destroy them to advance to the next level.

title: Idle Trade Routes
description: Command a growing fleet of merchant ships across a shimmering ocean in Idle Trade Routes. Link bustling islands, auto‑dock at busy ports, and optimize trade lines to keep goods flowing. Unlock new ships, hire captains, and chase bigger contracts as your profits grow even while you’re away.

title: Color Block Jam
description: Play Color Block Jam free online and enjoy a vibrant browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Slide and match colorful pieces in a clever logic puzzle that feels like a rewarding brain game for all ages. Plan your moves, clear the board, and tackle trickier levels as you improve your strategy. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game perfect for quick.

title: Brawl Stars
description: Welcome to a multiplayer arena game! Brawl Stars will take you into a world full of action .io battles! You will experience nervous PVP battles and a unique evolution system. Choose your favorite hero including fire dragons, electric dogs or flower spirits.

title: Gas Station - Stick Simulator
description: You start with a small gas station in the middle of the highway, where everything depends on you. Service cars, fill up with gas, earn coins, and build even bigger! Over time, your gas station will grow into a true empire: with a store, restroom, cafe, and even a hot dog delivery service. The more customers, the more profit, upgrades, and fun!

In these races with hundreds of different levels, each new track creates a completely different excitement with its special design. You can play Epic Car Stunt Race Obby against AI racers or with your friend in 2 player mode. Start the endless racing excitement now!

title: Tap To Color: Painting Book
description:
Unleash your inner artist and paint your stress away with Tap to Color: Painting Book Game! Dive into a vibrant world of color where creating a masterpiece is as simple as a single tap. Forget the mess of crayons and paints; this is the ultimate digital coloring book for all ages.

Find your calm and enter a state of flow as you bring beautiful illustrations to life. It’s the perfect way to relax after a long day, pass the time on your commute,

title: Wordling: Daily Word Challenge
description: Wordling is a fun, free daily word puzzle game where you guess the hidden word in 6 tries using color-coded clues. Perfect for adults and seniors who love brain games, spelling challenges, and relaxing, ad-free gameplay. Explore all game modes!

title: Bloxorz - Block Puzzle 3d
description: Roll your block across challenging 3D platforms and drop it into the goal hole to solve each puzzle. Bloxorz - Block Puzzle 3d is an addictive block puzzle game that tests your logic, spatial thinking, and problem-solving skills across dozens of mind-bending levels.

title: Marble Blast
description: Ready to match, blast, and conquer? This vibrant marble shooter game offers endless fun and challenges that test your skills and strategy. title: Planet Demolish
description: Planet Demolish is a fun simulation game. The universe is a mysterious existence. In the distant outer space, there are many asteroids. They reflect the light of the sun and are the stars we see in the night. Humans have discovered and named Mars, Mercury, Venus, Jupiter, etc.

title: G Wagon City Driver
description: Dive into city driving with four game modes. Navigate busy morning streets, managing fuel and realistic traffic. Venture beyond the city to tackle rugged offroad terrain. Customize your G-Wagon's look and performance, and enjoy the ride with your loyal dog. Whether evading cops or exploring trails, G-Wagon City Driver offers a thrilling experience.

Woody Tap Block is an addictive puzzle game where you have to use logical thinking to move and remove wooden blocks in the right direction. With simple yet challenging mechanics, the game offers a relaxing yet engaging experience.
Plan your moves in the correct order to clear all the blocks.
As you progress through levels, the puzzles become more challenging with new obstacles and block types to overcome.

title: Kitty Match 3 puzzle game
description:
Kitty Match is a fun and addictive match-3 puzzle game with adorable cats. Match tiles, create combos, and clear levels in a relaxing and colorful world.

Easy to play and perfect for all ages. Enjoy smooth gameplay and endless puzzle fun.

Start your cute cat adventure now!

title: Ultimate Sudoku
description:
A puzzle game from Japan that has conquered the whole world.
Fill in the empty cells with numbers from 1 to 9. In each row, column, or 3x3 block, each number can occur only once.

3 different game modes:
Cell first: First click on the cell you want to fill in, and then select a number.
Number First: first click on the number, and then on the cell in which you want to enter this number.
Note Mode: Write down the option in an empty space using the keyboard or the number buttons.

title: Math Runner
description: Challenge your mind and reflexes in this fast-paced arithmetic adventure! Solve math problems on the run, dodge obstacles, and race against time to achieve the highest score. Perfect for players of all ages looking to sharpen their math skills while enjoying thrilling gameplay.

title: Huggy Mix Sprunki Music Box
description: Welcome to the wonderful world of Huggy Mix Sprunki Music Box. This music game is filled with energy and rhythm. Follow the beats, tap along to the music, and have fun with casual gameplay.You can choose three modes: health, ice, and bad man. You can make unique tunes that reflect your personality.

title: Stack Fall
description:
Smash the floor! 
Are you under stress? Maybe Stack Fall can help you to release the stress. 
As your ball keep breaking the floors to get to the goal, every smashing will ease your stress. 
It's time to break some stacks!

title: Dog Escape
description: Dog Escape is the best dog simulation game with twists and turns that will keep you busy for hours. Whether you're a dog or cat lover, this game is perfect for everyone. Each level is a maze of challenging obstacles, security guards and rooms full of traps. The game becomes more challenging as you progress to higher levels.

title: Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D
description: Challenge your mind with Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D! This relaxing logic game offers a satisfying brain teaser. Your mission: tap blocks to clear the screen. It's tricky blocks only move one way! Swipe to rotate the puzzle, find the right order, and watch them fly away. Puzzles get tougher as you go, perfect for training your brain. This free-to-play 3D puzzle is your ideal mental escape. Ready for the challenge? Start tapping now!

description: The elusive 2048 block is almost within your reach. Combine and count up your blocks. Reach higher and higher scores, sharpening your mind in the process.

title: Celebrity Cute Couple
description: Join this celebrity couple in their Cute Couple dress up routine! Go with them to a party, school, the dance studio, outside and others. Follow them through their make up and dress up.

title: Flower Shop
description: Match 6 of the same flowers to ship them! You can place your flowers in any empty spot on the board. Place a flower next to a tray with the same kind to make them merge. When the right conditions are met, customers will come by to visit! Complete their requests to earn rewards. The game ends when there’s no more space left to place flowers.

title: Train Driver Simulator 3D
description: Amazing train simulator game fun for everyone who have a passion for trains, locomotives, steam engines, rail and all things railroad. do not forget to signal oncoming passenger trains and freight trains!

title: Hill Station Bus Simulator
description: "Hill Station Bus Simulator" invites players to step into the shoes of a skilled bus driver navigating the challenging terrains of picturesque hill stations. As the primary protagonist, your mission is to efficiently transport passengers through winding roads, steep ascents, and captivating landscapes, while managing a thriving bus service. The game offers an engaging blend of realistic driving simulation, strategic decision-making, and immersive experiences.

title: Wave Road 3D
description: Wave Road 3D is a fast-paced reflex game that challenges your focus, timing, and precision. You control a sleek arrow gliding through a floating road filled with gears, traps, and collectible gems. Whether you’re chasing high scores in endless mode, conquering 20 handcrafted levels in classic mode, or racing head-to-head with a friend in 2 player mode, Wave Road 3D offers a refreshing and dynamic experience.

title: Zen Tile
description: Are you a master player of matching games? Do you enjoy matching puzzle games? Come to challenge this addictive puzzle game: Zen Tile - Relaxing Match!

title: Pixel Number - DIY Coloring
description: Unleash your creativity with Pixel Number – DIY Coloring! Choose from a huge collection of pixel art images – from cute animals to cool patterns – and bring them to life with color.

title: Unicorn Dress Up - Girls Games
description: Girl games with unicorns - magical horses with a horn on their head. In dress up unicorn games for little girls you can create a huge number of pony outfits from over 180 fantasy items. A real feast to all cute horses, glitter fashion clothing, animal outfits and fairy tales lovers! It’s your perfect time to be a fashion designer. Enter the wonderful pony dress-up world full of super clothes.  Children love dressing up such mythical animals as dragons, elves, fairies, mermaid dolls and, of course, colorful unicorns! Perhaps before going to bed you listened to fairy tales about them or read books about how beautiful these creatures are? In fact, if you dress up little ponies and attach a long stylish horn to their forehead, you can make your own unicorn! All you need is adorable ? games: make as many fantasy characters and decorations as you want, create your unique rainbow pony, become the cutest unicorn makeover artist.

title: Bus Color Jam
description: Welcome to Bus Color Jam, a lively and colorful online game that challenges your coordination and quick thinking. Guide passengers to the right buses by matching their colors and keeping the station running smoothly. Every level brings new challenges that test your timing and attention. It’s a fun mix of strategy and reflexes — easy to learn, satisfying to master, and completely free to play on both your phone and computer.

title: Ragdoll Parkour Simulator
description: "Ragdoll Parkour Simulator" is an adrenaline-fueled parkour game that challenges players to navigate through urban environments with precision and style. With improved graphics and mechanics, players can expect an even more immersive experience than its predecessor.

title: Real Cars Epic Stunts
description:
Flashy and modified super-sports cars and their drivers are ready for the show in Real Cars Epic Stunts game. Play against time in dozens of different stunt tracks and try to complete the show. Unlock new cars or upgrade your car with the coins and diamonds you collect.

Game Features:

● Realistic car physics and appearance. ( Cars get crushed and smashed )
● Upgradeable cars
● 1 Player and 2 Player modes
● Mega ramps for epic stunts

title: Pool Merge
description:
This is an arcade puzzle with billiard physics and 2048 merge mechanics. Shoot balls, combine identical ones and score points!
Game modes:
Classic: plan your moves, avoid overflowing the field. With each new open ball level, the limit of allowed balls on the playing field increases.
Arcade: play for time, do not let the balls fall into the holes. Merging balls adds time to the timer, balls that fall into the holes take time away.

title: Ice Princess Pregnant Caring
description: Elsa is pregnant. Today she is the only one at home, but she makes an appointment to go to the hospital for examination. Can you take care of Elsa on this day? Please help Elsa to freshen up and then accompany her to the hospital for examination. After Elsa returns home, please help her make a delicious dinner.

title: Organizer master
description: An engaging 3D puzzle with numerous levels. Find pairs and arrange objects so that everything fits. Develop spatial thinking and solve challenges. Enjoy high-quality 3D graphics in this captivating browser puzzle game.

title: Cubes 2048.io
description: Begin an exciting .io battle where Snake meets 2048 in a nervous arcade showdown. Control your cube snake, collect, merge, and grow bigger while outsmarting opponents in this classic action-puzzle game. Control your snake to navigate around the map. Collect more cubes and merge the same numbers to reach 2048. Match the same number to make it bigger.

title: Santas Magic Christmas
description: Relax in this simple and fun jewel game. Help Santa collect lost gifts in the magical environment of the Christmas landscape. Use various power-ups to complete levels.

title: Super Billy Boy

Embark on this adventure full of enemies and dangerous traps and help our hero bring his friend back home. This is a complete platform game and a lot of fun! Good luck!

Instead of a pistol, a powerful shotgun was used. Every pull of the trigger is a choice of fate. The winner lives, the loser dies. You will begin a Turn-Based shooting roulette game. Each round will have a fixed number of bullets and blanks.

title: Frost Land - Snow Survival
description: Frost Land - Snow Survival is a strategic base-building game where you battle the harsh cold to stay alive. You’ll wield a flamethrower to melt snow, uncover hidden resources, and expand your shelter. Every choice matters—manage supplies wisely and decide which frozen zones to explore as you carve out survival in a relentless winter.

title: Powerful Punch
description: Ready to let off some steam? Powerful Punch is the perfect game to brighten your day and release your frustrations. Rescue the weak, take down villains, and unleash your spooky punch, sprunky punch, or even a spranky punch in levels filled with surprises and hilarity

title: Word Search Universe 2
description: Word Search Universe 2 is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you find hidden words across many themed levels. Explore categories like science, history, food, nature, and more while sharpening your focus and vocabulary. Simply swipe letters to form words, complete challenges, and unlock new chapters. With clean visuals, smooth controls, and hundreds of words to discover.

What you need to do is to connect the pipes in the right order, so that the hero can take the hidden treasure and save the princess away from the dragons, wolves and monsters safely.

title: 100 Rooms Escape

Interact with objects and solve puzzles to complete the tasks in the escape game. Solve the puzzles, and take inventory of the hidden items. You may use them to open the room, move on to the next level, use your skills, and do whatever it takes to escape.

description: Experience the joy of festive makeovers with Ellie Christmas Makeup game! This fun, holiday game lets you guide Ellie to create three Christmas-themed makeup looks: Candy Cane Queen, Christmas Queen, and iconic character-inspired. Perfect for makeup lovers and enthusiasts of holiday-themed games alike, this girl game takes you on a journey filled with creativity, color, and Christmas cheer! Craft Ellie's look using assorted eyeshadows, lipsticks, patterned blushes, accessories, and more.

Begin an exciting game of “hide and seek”, successfully hide and collect seals to defeat the boss, or find all the hidden escapees to stop their plans?

Enjoy this nice version of the classic Tic Tac Toe Game. 3 Game’s Mode: 
- Multiplayer mode 
- Play against the pc 
- Challenge a friend playing on the same device

title: Epic Stunts PvP 3D
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning muscle car through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Battle Racing Stars
description: Join an epic racing adventure where you can unlock and upgrade iconic characters from beloved Halfbrick games, including Barry from Jetpack Joyride, The Ginger Ninja from Dan the Man, and the nimble ninjas from Fruit Ninja.

title: Construction Set
description: Lego games are popular all over the world. You can use all kinds of small parts to form incredible three-dimensional puzzles, such as cars, bicycles, houses, etc. If you are a big fan of Lego, don't miss the Construction Set! There are many unopened Lego toys on the shelf. Your task is to unpack, take out all the parts and follow the instructions to join together. You can choose your favorite Lego or share this game with your friends!

title: Stickman Escape School
description:
You have to play a student stick who does not like to go to school. Student stickman tired of so much to learn and listen to boring instructors from the stereotypical thinking that the student decides to escape.
While the teacher left the class student teacher decided to see a box and terrified. In the box were a lot of different items. The student not long thinking decided to take advantage of these tools to escape from the school.

title: Butterfly Triple
description:
Butterfly Tripple is a bright and relaxing puzzle game where you merge cute butterflies!
Place the shapes on the board so that three or more butterflies of the same color touch each other. When they connect, they’re released and gracefully fly away. Vivid graphics, smooth animations, and a cozy atmosphere make the game a true pleasure to play.

title: Math Lava: Tower Race
description: Test your math skills under pressure in Math Lava: Tower Race, a fast-paced Roblox style web game where quick thinking and accurate answers are your keys to survival. Answer math questions correctly to build blocks beneath you, racing against opponents and rising lava. The faster and more accurate you are, the higher you climb!

title: Stickman Weapon Master
description:
Fight as a lone brave stickman against the tyranny and Evil
Fight as a lone brave stickman against the tyranny and evil Lord in the land of Stickman Weapon Master.

title: Draw To Fly
description: Ready for a game that’s as creative as it is challenging? Draw Fly brings your imagination to life, turning simple drawings into pathways to solve puzzles and conquer obstacles. Whether you’re flying past traps or dodging tricky obstacles, this puzzle game will keep you entertained for hours.

title: Mojicon Garden Connect
description: Looking for a relaxing puzzle break? The 6th Mojicon game is here to help you unwind! Mojicon Garden Connect brings the beauty of spring right to your screen. Connect colorful tiles at your own pace and watch the garden come to life. As you play, you'll unlock 20 fun, hidden Discoveries featuring adorable garden friends. Now lighter and smoother than ever, it’s the perfect polished puzzle for your downtime.

title: Vampiric Roulette Romance
description: Experience Gothic romance in "Vampiric Roulette Romance"! Help the Vampire Prince choose a date for the eclipse night party from four stunning beauties. Dive into Gothic dress-up and makeup levels, and witness the suspenseful roulette revelation under the moonlit eclipse.

title: Mushroom blocks
description: Meet colorful and diverse mushrooms! Collect mushroom blocks, earn points and win the rankings! On the way you will encounter all kinds of obstacles: lightning, bombs, frozen cells and others. Try to overcome all obstacles and hold out as long as possible, plunging into the cozy atmosphere of mushroom picking, accompanied by pleasant music!

title: Hospital Game Happy Clinic
description: Welcome to Hospital Game: Happy Clinic, a casual hospital simulation game, where you run a hospital and give treatment to all your patients. Want to elevate your hospital services and cure more patients? Start with your first treatment in the clinic! The more patients you have cured, the more coins you get to update your hospital.

title: Merge Brainrot
description:
Drop and merge the most cursed Italian Brainrot memes!
From "Trallallero Trallala" to "Tum Tum Tum Saur! and "Boneca Ambalabu", they’re all here.
What final Brainrot will you unlock? Dare to find out!

title: Monkey Bubble Shooter
description: Mama monkey needs your help Pop the bubbles to rescue the bananas Features  challenging levels Solve bubble sets using a variety of tactics Use theory of angles target higher bubbles and other tactics

title: Screw Jam!
description:
Let's embark on a mechanical journey like no other in Screw Jam Puzzle. Your mission is to untwist screws and put them in the right screw boxes. You win when completing all the screw sets.

FEATURES
- Addictive gameplay, help you relax and train your brain
- ASMR Screw game: Beautiful design with satisfying in-game sounds

This challenging and addictive Screw jam game will put your problem-solving skills to the test as you twist, turn, and put all the screws into right screw boxes.

title: Catch The Goose
description: Catch The Goose is a puzzle elimination mini-game. Players can tap identical items to automatically send them to the bottom slot - when three matching items gather, they get eliminated. When players successfully clear all items arranged in the grid, they get to "catch" a mischievous goose. Its addictive simplicity, stress-relieving design, and playful art style have made it a cultural phenomenon.

title: Friday Night Sprunki
description: Take on the challenge of a rhythm-based rap battle against many famous characters and hit the correct arrow keys in time with the music that starts playful and energetic but takes on a haunting vibe halfway through. Complete every level to beat the other characters and reach the best score on every Friday weekend. Complete all weeks and be part of the memorable and immersive experience.

title: Save My Pet Party
description: Cute pets need protection, would you like to help them? Draw protection walls for bees coming from different locations in each level and stop them. In levels you find difficult, you can get hints or skip the level directly. You can play Save My Pet Party game in 1 Player or 2 Player modes.

title: Murderers VS Sheriffs Duels
description:
Love Roblox-style action games? Get ready for the ultimate showdown!

Jump into fast-paced 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4 duels where every second counts. Play as a Murderer or a Sheriff, master unique abilities, and outplay your enemies in style.

If you enjoy games like Murder Mystery or Arsenal in Roblox, this is made for you!

title: Draw Bridge Puzzle
description:
Drag to create a path and guide the bike to the goal.
To draw the bridge, you need to line over the open areas and your vehicle will go over them. there will be multiple vehicles in the same level make sure you don't make them collide each other.
You can only draw the line once
You can only draw it once, make sure the bike bridge you create is strong enough. Safety comes first, make sure your bike gets to the finish line safely.

title: DOP: Draw One Part
description:
► Can you see what’s missing? 

What a pretty picture, but don’t you get the nagging feeling that something’s not quite right? What’s the final touch that will make the image complete? 

Engage your brain, your imagination and your artistic talents to identify the missing element and add it to the drawing in this delightful puzzle game that will get you thinking and make you smile time and time again.

title: Jungle Solitaire
description: Jungle Spider Solitaire is an adaptation of the classic card game Spider Solitaire with a jungle theme. It is optimized for short games and encourages strategic planning of moves with an original system of collecting diamonds.

title: Labubu And Me
description: Play this fun game for girls where you style your own Labubu monster and yourself! Customize Labubu with fur colors, eyes, tops, stickers, and accessories. Then, match your makeup and outfits to create the ultimate twin look. From trendy dresses and cute bags to stylish hairstyles, show off your fashion skills and creativity. Perfect for fans of Labubu games and makeover fun!

title: Building Mods For Minecraft
description: Building Mods For Minecraft is the ultimate game for those who love to build and fight. If you’re a Minecraft fan looking for a new adventure, this game takes the building mechanics of Minecraft to the next level, combining construction with action. You’ll have access to a wide range of building tools and guns.

title: Escape or Die - Troll Devil Levels
description: Escape or Die: Troll Devil Levels, you’re thrust into a nightmarish world where trolls, twisted by ancient demonic curses, guard labyrinthine dungeons filled with deadly traps and unspeakable horrors. Your mission? Escape each level with devil alive— or end up as another soul devoured by the Troll Devil’s wrath. With ever-changing challenges and escalating danger, only the quickest, smartest, and bravest will survive.

title: Cube Drop Puzzle
description:
Colorful bears are waiting to splash water!

Welcome to Cube Drop Puzzle!

Are you ready to start puzzle solving? Play Cube Drop Puzzle now and make a splash!

title: Toy Claw Simulator
description: Toy Claw Simulator is a fun and addictive arcade game where you take control of a virtual claw machine to collect a wide variety of adorable toys! Carefully aim and time your claw to grab plushies, action figures, and surprise collectibles. Once you've stocked up your toy inventory, head over to the factory to sell them for shiny coins! Use your earnings to run the machine to use the crane to unlock new toys. It's a charming blend of skill, strategy, and rewarding progression!

title: Kawaii Claw Merge
description:
The cutest merging adventure has arrived, featuring some of the most colorful Kawaii plushies around! 

Show off your merging skills by combining smaller Kawaii plushies to get a bigger plushy! Can you discover the biggest plushy of them all?

Ready for a serious dose of cuteness?
Play Kawaii Merge now - and let the merging magic begin!

title: Drunken Fighters
description:
Are you ready for an adrenaline-filled fighting adventure?

Step into the ring in Drunken Fighters’ single-player mode and face opponents that will test your reflexes, or grab a friend and fight in two-player mode on the same device.

Master ragdoll physics and boost the thrill with Funny Mod options: Stretch Kick, Stretch Punch, Big Punch, Super Punch, and Big Head or let Random Mode surprise you with chaos!

title: Air Hockey Cup
description: Fasten your skates and winter jacket. Your favorite ice sport is here in a new fun form. Move your tokens like real players and get the puck under control. Climb the ranks and destroy the tournaments!

title: Fashion Challenge: Catwalk Run
description: Fashion Challenge: Catwalk Run is a stylish dress-up game where you join glamorous catwalk competitions. Pick the perfect outfit, match accessories, style your hair, and impress the judges. Travel to fashion shows around the world, earn points, unlock outfits, and become a global trendsetter. Win challenges to climb the leaderboard and prove your fashion sense. Every level brings a new style theme to conquer!

title: Save the Bees
description: In "Save the Bee", you will play as a hero in the unique world of bees. Bee, the cute and necessary bee, is facing despair and your mission is to solve puzzles by drawing to the rescue. You will have to confront unpredictable threats that seem easy but are difficult but extremely attractive

title: Beaver Weaver
description:
Beaver Weaver is a colorful cross-stitching game, where you can not only relax and take a break from the hustle and bustle of the day, but also get acquainted with stories of the fabulous city - Beaver Ville. And also get to know the main characters better: Gloria and her grandson Mikey.
Fanpage: https://www.facebook.com/nordbeavergames/

title: Sort Puzzle - Nuts and Bolts
description: Play Sort Puzzle - Nuts and Bolts, a free and addictive sorting game! Train your brain by stacking nuts of the same color. Simple yet challenging, it's the perfect casual game to relax and sharpen your logic skills. Play now and start sorting!

title: Car Eats Car: Arctic Adventure
description: Up for a fight against rivals in a dynamic race on the highway? Overtake enemies and create your own car in the incubator in Car Eats Car: Sea Adventure! Your friends are put to prison - do everything you can to free evil cars! Good driving skills and turbo speed come in handy in this crazy driving simulator and a police chase game. Become a car tycoon, upgrade cars, and play for monster cars against the cops! Fight the boss to survive in these ultimate crazy races!

title: Block Color Puzzle Blast
description: Immerse yourself in the explosive fun of Block Color Puzzle Blast, a thrilling puzzler where strategic block placement is key. Drag and drop vibrant blocks to fill gaps, unleash combos to earn massive scores, and experience the satisfying blast as completed lines clear the board, challenging you to reach new heights in colorful puzzle mastery.

title: Maze Craze
description: Step into the captivating world of Maze Craze, a puzzle game that combines creativity, humor, and strategic problem-solving. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts and casual gamers, Maze Craze offers an endless journey through a variety of mazes, each with its own unique set of challenges and surprises.

title: 3D Block Gladiator: Sword Draw
description:
Sketch Your Path to Fight and Become the Ultimate Champion!

Step into the gladiator arena where only the strongest and smartest warriors survive! In 3D Block Gladiator: Sword Draw, you don’t just fight—you draw your attacks and dodges, controlling your gladiator’s every move with precision. Swipe, slash, and outmaneuver your enemies to claim victory!

title: Poptropica
description:
Join millions of players in the adventures of Poptropica!
Complete unbelievable quests, written by Jeff Kinney, author of the Diary of a Wimpy Kid series!
Customize your character and adopt pets! Decorate your clubhouse and hang out with friends! There's so much to do in Poptropica!
And don't forget to collect prizes and compete with your friends - will you be the island champion?

title: Wheelie Challenge
description: How long can you hold that wheelie

title: Office Spider Solitaire
description: Your objective in Office Spider Solitaire is to clear the table by creating suited sets from king to ace. The game has either one, two or four suits depending on the difficulty setting.

title: Words Search Classic Edition
description: No more magazines that take up too much space in the bag You can now play your favorite games on mobile This word search on mobile delight all styles of players Observe and highlight the words before time runs outWord Search classic edition is a game that tests your intelligence and your sense of observation Complete all levels but especially have fun

title: Halloween Magic Connect
description:
A fun and addictive hyper casual game. Matching all the pairs of Halloween Magic tiles to clear the board. Complete as many levels as possible to get high scores and raise your name on the global leaderboard. Each hint will reveal a pair of Halloween Magic tiles, use it wisely. Pay attention on the timer, don't let it end before clearing the board.
When being out of moves, the board will be shuffled automatically if there is any Shuffle item left, if not, the game will be over.

title: Labubu and Treasures: Fun Adventure
description: Collect bright combinations, pass hundreds of levels together with amazing characters from the Labubu universe! In this exciting Match-3 puzzle you will find bright adventures, interesting puzzles and fluffy magic.

title: Code Maze
description: Master programming logic with Code Maze! Use code blocks to navigate mazes, overcome obstacles, and reach goals. Each level challenges your problem-solving skills. Ready to code your way out?

title: Panda Restaurant
description: Welcome to Panda Restaurant and build the cutest food empire in the forest! In this exciting restaurant adventure, you play as an adorable panda trying to survive in a world where endangered animals no longer receive special treatment. Run your own restaurant and earn more income! It is a fun mix of simulation gameplay and addictive time management game mechanics. The cute art style, satisfying progression, and exploration features make it one of the most enjoyable animal games online.

title: Nuwpy's Adventure
description:
Nuwpy’s Adventure is a classic pixel-art platformer inspired by retro arcade games!
Help Nuwpy explore colorful worlds, collect coins, jump over enemies, and avoid traps.
Each level offers new challenges, hidden secrets, and a fast-paced journey full of charm and nostalgia.
Dive into the pixel world and enjoy simple yet addictive gameplay!

title: Mega Shark
description: One shark and a sea full of delicious fish. How hungry are you? You’ve got 60 seconds to prove it! Feed nonstop, survive the deepest waters and rely on your shark’s speed, strength and invincibility to complete each hunt. Collect coins and trophies to unlock and explore new stages.

title: Sweet Merge
description: Dive into 'Sweet Merge', a relaxing and delightful game where your goal is simple: merge and combine an assortment of sweets like jellies, cakes, and candies to create a new bigger sweet. How large can you make your sweet merge?

title: Funny Pet Haircut
description: Take your messy pets, alpaca and cat to the hair salon. Wash and dry your pets before giving them a brand new look by changing their colors and giving them pattern look. Dress up too. And turn them into a stylish beauty!

title: The game 13
description: "13: the game", is simply one of the most simple and fun puzzle games in the world. To play you just have to click on one of the boxes on the board, and all the adjacent similar boxes will merge with it to form the same +1 digit. Your goal is to create a box with the number 13. It's super easy at first, but only 0.3% of players are able to reach a box with the number 13 ... Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Build A Queen 2025
description: In Build a Queen 2025, you will embark on a fun journey to become a real queen. You will need to make your way through different platform levels with your opponents. Choose outfits, skin colors, and more according to your goals. Dress up in the most glamorous queen look, meet the prince, and win. You can collect money to unlock more dance steps.

title: Crowd Lumberjack
description:
Chop trees, collect wood to build a house on an island in this fun idle tycoon!
Grab your axe and go to explore the world! Add new lumberjacks to your crowd team to construction of amazing buildings. Run with the crowd and chop down trees. I am exploring a huge world. Build beautiful cities and discover new islands! Ready! Set! Chop & Build!

title: Puppy Treat Sorting
description: Puppy Treat Sorting is a Sorting game where you must grab and sort identical bones to create a new and bigger one. Puppies will fall automatically into the arena; what you must do is drag the puppies around and choose them into identical ones.

title: Stickman escapes from prison
description: New prison escape adventures welcome you! Your task is to play as a Stickman and find all the ways to successfully escape from prison. 10 different items to choose from are hidden in a secret place. Some items will lead you to victory, but many other items will lead you to death. Interesting animations and jokes will delight your attention. Check out all the items and enjoy the different situations in the zone.

title: Block Puzzle Adventure
description: Block Puzzle Adventure is a wood style block game. Easy to play, but difficult to be a master. It’s free, no download, endless, high quality, and easy to play for brain training.

title: Noob Draw Punch
description:
Play this fascinating game and enjoy yourself. The Imperfect Punch Enjoy yourself as you sketch out the path of your character's punch. Assist the rookie player in surviving the onslaught of monsters (such as huggy, kissy missy, catnap, and more) that they encounter throughout the game.

Luckily, you'll have a strong fist that can track the monsters, so you can assist the young newbie escape alive from this trap. He's afraid when he meets all the creatures in Poppy Playtime.

title: Words from Words
description: "Words from Words" is an exciting game, the purpose of which is to create as many different words as possible from the letters given to you. You can create 29 words from the word «example», «maverick» includes 71 words, and "chalkboard" stores as many as 142 words. Can you solve everything?

title: Devil Duck : Not a Troll Game
description: Devil Duck is an action-packed platformer game that challenges players to navigate through treacherous levels teeming with danger. Set in the fiery depths of the Devil's Domain, you play as a fearless adventurer on a quest to reclaim stolen treasures guarded by the sinister Devil King.

title: Superstar Family Dress Up Game
description: Design luxury outfits and amazing looks for a superstar family of 4 gorgeous virtual models on the same screen! Each character have their own wardrobe with 200+ items of apparel, makeup and accessories. Add cute pets, fireworks and various cool stickers to get the final picture ready for a photo album. Grab a screenshot by pressing the "Camera" button inside the game and share the picture with your friends and family online to show off your fashionista talents. For each doll, there is a huge collection of fancy garments and trendy options for makeup. You can customize literally everything: from eyes shape and iris color to dresses to glam accessories like Swiss hand watches or golden necklaces. Who are these dolls: movie stars, famous supermodels from a glam magazine cover, Internet celebrities, prince and princess, theater actors and actresses, rich business people or something else?

title: Twisted Rope
description: Get ready for a mind-bending challenge! ? Twisted Rope Puzzle 3D is a captivating game that will put your problem-solving skills to the test. Dive into a colorful world of tangled ropes and work your way through increasingly complex puzzles.

title: Orbiting Xmas Balls
description: This is a very nice 'Xmas theme bubble shooter game' where you will shoot balls towards swinging wheel of balls. To win a level you need to achieve target score. Surplus of your score will help you to pass the next levels.This is an ad free game.

title: CarJamcolor
description:
There was a long queue of passengers at the public station platform with a "car jam" in the parking lot! what to do?

Now it's time for the cars to transport passengers, you need to move them...but wait! You need to do it in the right order. Because other cars in the parking lot that become an obstacle! Can you solve this tricky parking puzzle and get all the cars on the road?
what are you waiting for? Challenge your brain with this tricky game now!

title: Mafia Sniper Crime Shooting
description: Ready to become the coldest, deadliest sniper in the entire city? Mafia Sniper Crime Shooting is a FPS action shooting simulator where you complete high-risk missions. Use powerful guns to eliminate dangerous mafia targets.

title: Anime Doll - DIY Cosplay Girl
description: Dive into the enchanting world of Anime Doll - DIY Cosplay Girl, where you can live out your fashion dreams and become a master of anime dress-up!

title: Blocks and that's it
description: Welcome to “Blocks and That’s It” — an addictive Tetris-style puzzle! Drag and drop blocks onto an 8×8 grid, clear lines, and trigger satisfying combo blasts to score points. Simple rules but deep strategy: plan ahead and create chains. No timers, lives, or limits — just relaxing, endless gameplay for all ages. Compete for high scores, enjoy colorful visuals, and master the puzzle. Play now and prove you’re the champion!

title: Pop Culture Halloween Makeup
description: Immerse yourself in Pop Culture Halloween Makeup, where you can transform into your favorite icons. With a wide array of hairstyles, eyeshadows, mascaras, lipsticks, neck paint, tops, and accessories, you can create stunning Halloween makeup looks that will leave everyone in awe. Unleash your imagination, experiment with different styles, and become the ultimate makeup artist. Tap into the spirit of Halloween and play Pop Culture Halloween Makeup now to embark on a spooktacular journey!

title: Screamals
description:
Change the shape of the characters with simple up-and-down manipulations
Even if obstacles get in the way, they can change their shape and pass through.
Break through the obstacle, collect the notes and fire them at the boss!

title: Super Onion Boy 2
description: Super Onion Boy 2 is a 2D retro-style adventure game where your mission is to save your friend, who has been captured by a terrible monster with psychic powers. Defeat enemies along the way using superpowers and epic transformations, collect coins and stars to earn extra lives, find chests with magic potions, and defeat all the terrible bosses until you reach the final showdown.

title: Idle Baseball Tycoon
description: Play Idle Baseball Tycoon free online and step into a fast-loading browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Build your dream team, upgrade stadiums, recruit players, and grow profits in a smart manager sim that blends idle strategy with brain game decision-making. This unblocked game runs smoothly at school or home and is fully mobile-friendly, working perfectly on desktop and mobile. It’s a free online game made for quick breaks and long-term domination.

title: Golf Mini
description: Golf Mini is a fun and addictive game in which your goal is to get the ball to the hole in the minimum number of strokes. Complete levels, each of which is a unique golf course with various obstacles and traps.

title: Bubble Shooter Gold
description:
It's a beautiful and exciting balloon shooter. Perfectly relaxing and calms the nerves.

You are waiting for various levels and a sea of colorful balls and bubbles. Shoot them, and they will burst. Choose the trajectory of the shot wisely to burst more balls at once, or even unhook a whole bunch from the ceiling of the level and destroy the entire wall of balls!

Gain reward stars by passing the levels for the allotted number of shots!

Play and relax!

title: Moto Cabbie Simulator
description: Welcome to Moto Cabbie Simulator, where the thrill of the open road meets the fast-paced world of urban transportation! In this exhilarating and immersive gaming experience, players take on the role of a daring motorcycle taxi rider navigating the bustling streets of a vibrant city.

title: Gloves of Block
description:
Become the last line of defense and lead your nation to World Cup glory!

Step into the gloves of your national team’s goalkeeper in this thrilling reflex-based football game. Your mission is simple: protect the net, stop the shots, and carry your team to the top. Choose your country and dive into a series of high-stakes matches where each save counts!

Opponents get tougher as you advance, stronger nations will demand sharper reflexes and quicker decisions. Can you lift the World Cup trophy?

title: Fashion Nail Art
description: Do you like Girl games? Fashion Nail Art is waiting for you.

title: BFFS Night Out
description: Have a fun night out with the princesses in this cool new game called "BFFs Night Out"! Help them pick the best oufits and put on their best make up!

title: Marble Bubble Legend
description: Marble Puzzle Quest is a fun and addictive casual puzzle game where your task is to sort colorful marbles into the correct slots. With each new level, the challenge grows — chains become longer and more colorful, while the space for moves gets tighter. Use logic, plan ahead, and clear the board! Watch out: the marbles fill four slots at the top, and only three of the same color will disappear. Place them incorrectly, and you lose the round.

title: Happy Jump
description: Bounce into blissful heights with Happy Jump! Guide the cute chicken on its springy pogo to leap skyward amid lush trees and fun obstacles. Smash your personal best, snag stars, and chase trophies in this addictive, one-tap thrill. Endless jumps, soaring scores—pure joy awaits!

title: Fruits Mahjong
description: Connect the all fruits mahjong tiles and clear the board in this html5 mahjong games. What's the max level can you play?  You can use the "Hint" and "Shuffle" buttons for help.

title: Bubble Shooter Pirate Treasures
description: Set sail in Bubble Shooter Pirate Treasures, an endless pirate-themed bubble shooter! Aim, match, and pop bubbles to build combos, chase your best score, and fill the Treasure Progress bar. Unlock pirate backgrounds, matching bubble skins, and useful boosters as every run brings you closer to the next reward. Easy to play and fun to master—keep the bubbles away from the fail line and hunt for treasure!

title: Fashion Stylist
description:
Start your amazing fashion journey with Fashion Stylist! A game where you can mix and match outfits, compete with players around the world and be the ultimate Fashionista.

Make your fashion adventures more interesting by being a judge and voting for other's outfits! Take part in the Multi-player challenge and prove that you have the best sense of style of them all!

title: Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle
description: Dive into the relaxing world of Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle! Your goal is simple: sort the colored liquids into the flasks until each flask contains only one color. With over 1000 levels and unique modes like Color Fusion, Mystery, and Time Trial, this puzzle game will test your logic and patience. Unlock new themes and achievements as you play!

title: Excavator Simulator 3D
description: Drive and operate realistic 3D construction vehicles in Excavator Simulator 3D. You can choose from different trucks, excavators, and Pincer Jaws to complete various missions and tasks. Whether you need to dig, clamp, lift, hammer, or forklift, you can switch the attachments easily and quickly. Learn how to control these powerful machines and enjoy the realistic physics and graphics. Complete the levels faster and earn more money to buy more vehicles and unlock new challenges. Have fun!

title: 21 Cards
description: 21 Cards is a fun and addictive blackjack-style puzzle game where your goal is to reach exactly 21 points in each column. The game combines the thrill of classic card play with a cozy, home-style atmosphere. Place cards wisely, complete columns, and aim for the perfect 21!

title: TearDown - Destruction SandBox
description:
The player is given complete freedom of action. You can explore various locations filled with structures. The main feature of the game is the ability to destroy everything you see.

Have you ever wanted to level a multi-storey house with your own hands? Now you have the opportunity to do just that! The physics of destruction is close to reality. You can use a variety of weapons to destroy objects, from a hammer to a powerful bazooka.

title: Ultimate Flying Car 2
description: The ultimate adventure continues with the super flying cars in a huge city with lots of features in the 2nd chapter of the series! This version will bring more features, more stable and fun car physics, more explosives, and more actions. The fastest cars of all time will meet you in this game!

title: Soccer Euro Cup 2025
description:
Can you hear the deafening cheers of a mighty crowd? Get pumped for the Soccer Euro Cup 2025!

Pick your favorite country to represent and get ready for kickoff. Do your best to kick or headbutt the ball into your opponent's goal!

How many did you manage to score? Play now, and let's find out!

title: Flick Shot Soccer
description: Flick Shot Soccer is a fun and addictive soccer shooting game where every goal is all about precision. Simply drag to aim and position your shot, then release to kick and send the ball flying into the net. Easy controls make it perfect for anyone to pick up and play, while smart angles and timing are needed to score consistently.

title: Money Factory - Earn a Billion
description: Prepare for a thrilling journey into the world of finance! As the owner of a money factory, you'll build and link mechanisms to boost your earnings with every step. Overcome exciting challenges where strategy is crucial to your success. Collect powerful boosters, create combos, and unlock new levels to discover even more ways to grow your fortune. Upgrade your factory to fast-track your rise to riches and become a financial powerhouse!

title: Ultimate Tower Defense
description: Ultimate Tower Defense is an exciting strategy game that perfectly blends tower defense, battle, and fast-paced action into one addictive experience. In the game, you must carefully protect defense towers and deploy powerful heroes to stop endless waves of enemies. Each tower has unique attack abilities. Select your preferred mode to begin the challenge.

title: Mind Games for 2-3-4 Player
description: Mind Games is a huge game where you can find 2-3-4 player games while playing. The game consists of 27 games under various categories like skill games, Brain Games, matching games, pop-it games, mancala, ludo, and Tic Tac Toe games. Each of these games is fun and made for kids and it is safe to play. Most of these games can be played 2 player, 3 player or 4 player.

title: Tap Bead
description: Tap Bead is a relaxing puzzle game. Arrange beads by color to match patterns and clear levels. Simple controls, soft visuals, and many levels make it a soothing, satisfying experience.

title: Bubble Shooter Valentine
description: "Bubble Shooter Valentine" is a delightful twist on the classic bubble shooter genre, set in a charming Valentine's Day theme. With its vibrant romantic aesthetics, players shoot and match colorful bubbles to create clusters and clear the screen. A perfect treat for bubble game enthusiasts, it offers a love-infused take on the familiar gameplay mechanics, ensuring an enjoyable experience for fans of the genre, particularly those who appreciate the engaging dynamics of Bubble Game 3.

title: Mahjong Lines
description: Mahjong Lines is a relaxing logic puzzle in the mahjong connect style. Find matching tile pairs and clear the board by linking them with a valid path. With classic mahjong tiles, simple rules, hints, and lots of levels, it’s perfect for both quick sessions and thoughtful puzzle-solving.

title: Collect Brainrot Arena
description: Collect Brainrot Arena is a chaotic multiplayer collecting and stealing game where luck, strategy, and timing are equally important. Enter the arena, gather valuable Lucky Blocks, unlock rare Brainrots, upgrade your collection, and protect your base from rival thieves. Every Lucky Block can contain a surprise, and every opponent is looking for an opportunity to steal your most valuable Brainrots.

title: Solitaire Quest
description:
Solitaire Quest is a beautifully designed classic Klondike solitaire game.

Enjoy smooth gameplay, elegant visuals, and a relaxing card experience optimized for TV and desktop.

Whether you're a beginner or a solitaire master, challenge yourself and improve your strategy with every game.

title: Bloons Survival.io
description:
Bloons Survival. io is a fast-paced survival arcade game where you fight off endless waves of balloons!

Control your monkey hero, throw darts automatically, and pop incoming enemies before they get too close.
Collect coins and power-ups to grow stronger, but stay alert — one hit can end your run!

How long can you survive?

title: Animal Transform Race
description: Animal Transform Race is a fun game based on reaction where different types of animals compete. Each animal is fast in some areas and very slow in some tracks according to their abilities. Try to lead the race by making the right choices. The faster you make animal choices, the more advantages you gain. You can unlock new animals from the market section with the coins you earn from the races.

title: Save the Baby. Home Rush
description: “Save the Baby: Home Rush” is an entertaining puzzle game that involves drawing. The main goal is to bring a lost child back home to their mother while avoiding various obstacles. What are you waiting for? Save the child now!

title: Farming Life
description: Start afresh in a small town with a tiny farm. Build it up and sell your goods on the local market. Become the most popular local farmer with the biggest and best farm around!

title: Sugar Mahjong
description: Connect all the candy mahjong stones. Sugar Mahjong has a hundred levels for you to enjoy.

title: Formula Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 stunning F1 cars with modified body kits and drive them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself in F1 Traffic Racer

title: Hidden Object Rooms Exploration
description: Explore a variety of rooms and find hidden items! With 18 levels and 6 items to discover in each room, enjoy the thrill of searching through different spaces like living rooms and more. Drag the screen to explore them. Get ready for an exciting adventure in 'Hidden Object Rooms Exploration'!

title: Fruit Candy Merge
description: Welcome to Fruit Candy Merge, where juicy fruits and sweet candies come together in a delightful merging puzzle! Combine matching candies to create delicious fruit combos and watch them burst with flavor. With addictive gameplay and colorful challenges, can you merge your way to fruity success?

title: Easter Pop
description: Tap on groups of 3 or more eggs in the same color to make them disappear. Collect different bonuses and try to get the highest score before time runs out.

title: Cards 2048
description: Are you looking for a fresh twist on a familiar game? Cards 2048 is the perfect blend of classic solitaire and the popular 2048 puzzle game! This unique combination creates an engaging brain teaser that's highly addictive. As you merge cards with matching numbers, the challenge intensifies, offering a true test of your skill and strategy. Sharpen your logic and enjoy hours of fun with Cards 2048, the ultimate card merging game for puzzle enthusiasts!

title: Ludo Fever
description: Destroy enemy tokens in this modern Ludo. Play it alone, or with friends and family on one device. Roll the dice and go through the entire playing field with all the tokens. Will you come to the home area first?

title: Tralala La La La italiano
description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure! In this game you will have to connect Italian animals. Collect a collection of rare animals, discover new species and create your own virtual zoo!

title: Screw Sort 3D: Screw Puzzle
description: Ready to challenge your mind and intelligence in the Screw Sort 3D: Screw Puzzle. This casual 3D Screw Puzzle game will take you into a world of creativity and puzzle solving fun. Here you need to match the screws of the same color and move them to the correct box. You sort screws by their colors. Keep moving the model to find the corresponding color.

title: Mastermind
description:
Mastermind is a HTML5 Logic Game.
Guess the exact positions of the colors in the sequence. 
But be careful! You have only few attempts before the sharp Mastermind will blame on you!

title: Happy Town
description:
In Happy Town you have to lead your own city and make its inhabitants happy!

Becoming the mayor of your happy city is very simple! Combine items, upgrade buildings, complete tasks for residents, communicate with them, expand and enjoy a vibrant style and soundtrack. Residents are waiting for you!

title: Wordmeister HD
description:
Create words in the English dictionary to score points. Drag and drop the tiles to form words.

Take advantage of bonus tiles such as double letter scores, triple word scores and more. How well-versed are you with the English vocabulary?

The highest score wins!

title: Rocket Sky!
description: In Rocket Sky! you tap and hold the screen to launch your rocket as far into the sky as you can. Make sure not to overheat though, otherwise it’s game over!

title: Italian Animal Alchemy - Brainrot
description:
Dive into a world of crazy Italian creatures, where logic meets memes! Combine animals and objects to create the strangest and funniest Italian mutants!
A true meme zoo awaits you here, where creativity knows no bounds! Experiment, discover rare mutants, and share your results with friends to prove you have the most epic brainrot.

title: Candy Maker: Dessert Games
description: Do you like match-3 games, candies, and delicious cakes? Solve sweet riddles, move puzzles, and collect culinary masterpieces! Train your brain by solving exciting puzzles! Rich graphics and pleasant music will help you relax to your advantage!

title: Music Cat! Piano Tiles Game 3D
description: Discover a wonderful world of music and fun with this new free online game! Looking for a cute cat game? Do you want to feel the rhythm of the music in your every move on the tiles? Then this dance runner with cute dancing cats is exactly what you need!

title: Dogs Spot The Differences
description: Immerse yourself in the charming world of 'Dogs: Spot the Differences,' a puzzle game featuring scenes filled with adorable companions. Challenge your observation skills, uncover subtle differences, and unlock new levels. With stunning visuals and escalating challenges, become a detective in a captivating journey of discovery and fun. Can you spot them all and become the ultimate enthusiast for your lovable companions?

title: Jigsort Puzzles
description: Jigsort Puzzle is an app that is art puzzle and lets you complete jigsaw puzzle game for free! Various difficulty levels for casual and experiences puzzlers!

title: Robocarpoli
description:
In Brooms Town, you must solve four amazing adventures:

Problems with the pipes: 
In Brooms Town, a water pipe broke and the road is getting flooded. Help the Rescue Team to solve these situations completing 6 games: 
    • Connect the wires in Jin’s invention
    • Block the water leaks as soon as possible.
    • Solve Poli’s maze.
    • Work in a team with Micky.
    • Help Roy with the hoses.
    • Make Bruner as clean as a whistle.

title: Mahjong Riddles: Egypt
description:
Welcome to the mysterious world of Ancient Egypt! Find matching tiles, solve mahjong levels and collect artifacts to uncover secrets of Giza valley, Old city, Desert and Nile.
Discover how the Great Pyramid of Giza was constructed, how Egyptians learned to read hieroglyphs, why only the pharaoh could own a cat in Ancient Egypt and many more. 
Simple and engaging gameplay of mahjong solitaire is the best way to relax. You will find huge treasures, tricky locks, new bonus tiles and more.

title: Mine Quest Daily
description: Uncover safe squares, avoid mines, and test your strategic insight in this massively addicting puzzle game!

title: Idle PinBall - Merge Clicker
description: Welcome to an exciting mobile game for those who love to combine elements and enjoy simple but addictive gameplay. Minimalistic 3D graphics, dynamic combinations and the ability to play for free, even without an Internet connection are waiting for you.

title: K-Wedding Dream
description: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of Korean love with the heroes of this dressup-game. Become a part of a magical story where bright K-Pop stars are preparing for the most important day of their lives - Wedding day! Combine tradition and modern fashion by creating wedding looks for lovers. Choose the perfect makeup, hairstyle and jewelry to highlight their unique style and charm. Let each of your choices reflect the emotions and dreams of the characters, turning this day into a real fairy tale!

title: Phone Case Diy 5
description: Phone Case DIY 5 is a popular Art Game. For children who like this series very much, you must be eager to play this game! In this new DIY phone case game, we changed the style of the game, changing the previous 2D style to the current 3D style. At the same time, we have also added patterns, decorations, stickers, etc. that can be selected. At the same time, we have also added an album function, you can save your masterpieces to the album, and you can view your own artworks at any time.

title: Word Mania
description:
Can you not get enough word puzzles? It sounds like Wordmania is the game for you!

Wordmania is an engaging word game that invites players on an extraordinary journey into the world of letters. Your goal is to extract words from massive stacks of letters and connect them to create astonishing phrases. The game combines challenges related to solving puzzles and creativity in the realm of words.

title: Cow Jam Farm puzzle
description: In Cow Jam Farm Puzzle, the peaceful farm turns into a tricky traffic jam that only your logic skills can solve. Cows are stuck in crowded paths, and your mission is to help every one of them escape safely.

title: Fish Stab Getting Big
description: These fishes have knives in their mouth and they are trying to kill each other with it. Try to kill as many as fishes and try to make your fish the biggest in the ocean. Each kill will give you a score and you and your sword will grow according to it. You can embark on this adventure with your friend in 1 Player and 2 Player game mode. Pick your game mode and fish, and let the action begin in the ocean.

title: Hunter Underwater Spearfishing
description: Hunter Underwater Spearfishing is an immersive simulator hunting game that takes you deep beneath the ocean for an exciting underwater adventure. Grab your spearfishing arrow, dive in, and experience the thrill of becoming a true underwater hunter!

title: Spot Differs
description: A new exciting game "Spot&Differs" for children and adults! Find differences between two pictures and train your brain and mindfulness.  Relax with an exciting game, compare beautiful pictures and find the differences!     ? Features of the game: ? Bright and beautiful pictures of different subjects: animals, style, delicious food, nature, interiors ? Trains attentiveness ? Suitable for children and adults. Play with the whole family! ? Over 1000 different levels! ? Develops logic and contributes to a fun pastime!

title: Taylor Dress Studio Preppy & Wild West & Glam
description: Welcome to the dress-up game, in which the pop diva tries on three completely different fashionable looks: a youthful preppy bow, a cowboy outfit and a glamorous stage look. In addition, you can experiment with hairstyles and change the makeup of the heroine. Complete the images with accessories: glasses, hats and jewelry. Choose clothes and combine elements from different sets to create delicate, daring or superstar bows. Turn Taylor into an icon of any style!

title: Space Bubbles
description: Space Bubbles is a fun bubble burst game with 70 unique levels!

title: Color Wavee
description: Color wave game is very challenging and tests adrenaline. The ball will continue to move without stopping, and you will control the ball to avoid direct collisions with various ball movements so you don't get bored playing this game

title: Girls Photoshopping Dressup
description: Today the girls are going out for a very special photoshoot! Enter the photostudio and complete all tasks that photographer is giving you. Use the money to purchase nice clothes and dress them up! Choose between Lisa and Maria, both have a different set of items to wear. Become a princess, a skater or maybe even pikachu.  Have fun in this Girls Photoshopping Dressup game!

title: Hexa Sort 3D
description: Hexa Sort 3D mixes puzzle challenges, strategic matching and a satisfying merging experience.Involving clever puzzle-solving and logical manoeuvres, this game is ideal for those seeking a mental workout. As the levels progress, players will find the game both addictive and calming, striking the perfect balance between challenge and relaxation. Put your skills to the test with tasks such as sorting, stacking and merging hexagonal tiles.

title: Obby Parkour Ultimate
description: Obby Parkour Ultimate 3D is a fun skill game. Enjoy 35 unique levels with varied mechanics and a real hardcore parkour jumping game experience. Make your way to the end with your favorite Obby and Mine characters, jump platforms, evade spikes, and find your way to the end to complete all levels and unlock new characters.

title: People Playground 3d
description: Playground 3D is an exciting physics-based 3D battle simulator where you can create and customize epic fights between two teams: Blue and Red. Featuring ragdoll physics and dynamic fighter movements, the game lets you design thrilling combat scenarios.

title: Traffic Jam Hop On
description: In Traffic Jam: Hop On, challenge your strategy thinking and quick reflexes! This wonderful puzzle game will take you into a colorful parking lot. Your task is to help all kinds of vehicles get out of traffic jams and start smoothly.

title: High School Teacher Games Life
description:
Welcome to the High School Teacher Games Life, where you can experience the real life of a high school teacher. 
Career Mode: Experience the full journey of a high school teacher and manage your daily school life.
Mission Mode: Complete exciting and challenging tasks to test your teaching skills. 
Quiz Mode: Take quizzes and conduct practical sessions with students as a teacher.

title: My Perfect Farm
description:
Begin with a tiny patch of arable land and build a full farm tycoon. What was tiny becomes something powerful through smart decisions and careful resource management.
This interesting farming simulator game allows you to have fun while planting seeds, raising animals by feeding them, and enjoying a full harvest like a true farm owner.
This farming game lets you unlock new areas and earn rewards with every upgrade.

title: Winter Differences
description: Welcome to Winter Differences, a captivating spot-the-difference puzzle game! Challenge your observational skills as you seek out the distinctions between two nearly identical images. Put your hawk eyes to the test and tap the differences you spot, or use hints when needed. Remember, any unused hints and saved time will boost your bonus score. Enjoy the challenge and dive into the world of Winter Differences!

title: Iconic Halloween Costumes
description: Get ready for a spooky and stylish adventure in Iconic Halloween Costumes! Help three BFFs pick out their perfect Halloween looks, from royal Glinda and Bridgerton-inspired outfits to edgy Beetlejuice vibes and cowgirl-chic styles. Customize their costumes with tops, bottoms, accessories, and makeup to create iconic Halloween outfits. Play now and let the fashion fun begin!

title: Coin Merge
description: Coin Merge invites players into a captivating challenge of organization and strategy. Begin by sorting coins by color into designated slots, strategically merging them once a slot is filled to create new, uniquely colored coins. As levels progress, the pace quickens and the challenge intensifies, demanding swift decision-making and careful planning to keep up with the increasing complexity. Engage your mind in this addictive puzzle game where efficiency and foresight lead to mastery.

title: Liquid Sort Deluxe
description: Liquid Sort Deluxe is a relaxing and addictive color sorting puzzle game where you sort colorful liquids into tubes until each tube contains only one color. Plan your moves carefully and challenge your brain with unlimited levels. Unlock an extra tube by watching a short reward ad to make the puzzle easier, or get unlimited time to complete tricky levels.

title: Yummy Donut Factory
description: Let's be a donut chef! Mix all ingredients by following the receipt to make the dough. Create different shapes and bake the donuts. Decorate and throw on some sweet goodies, such as candies, sprinkles, frosting, and many more. You'll be the best donut baker ever!

title: Super Droid Adventure
description: Super Droid Adventure is an arcade game where you help the little Robot to defeat a powerful boss that has destroyed his castle. During your journey, you'll encounter different traps and dangerous enemies that will try to stop you from reaching your goal. Break blocks to find power-ups, coins and other surprises. Use firepower to make the job easier and good luck!

title: Scary Teacher 3D Returns
description:
Start with the size of a board. A faint sound echoes through the hallway. You freeze, the heart is beating, and the house seems to breathe with you. You are inside the mansion of the old teacher once again.

In the 3D fear teacher, every shadow, every echo matters. Your goal is not to escape; it is mischief. But make an error, and you will become its next goal.

title: Pin Master
description: Pin master: Screw puzzle quest & brain games challenges your problem-solving skills in a captivating pin puzzle adventure. Strategically tap to unlock screw holes on products, guiding metal plates to fall in the correct sequence. Navigate through intricate mazes of nuts, bolts, and plates. With each level presenting new challenges, immerse yourself in over 100 brain-teasing stages. Need a hint? No problem! Utilize the hint feature or remove random screws to progress.

title: Jewel Christmas Mania
description: Try this Christmas puzzle game with a Christmas theme. Enjoy the holiday adventure full of snowmen, gingerbread, and Christmas balls. Be rewarded with combos and finish all Christmas levels.

title: Escape & Steal Brainrot: Sahur Hills
description:
Escape & Steal Brainrot: Sahur Hills is a tense survival horror where you roam a fog-covered forest to steal brainrot pages while being hunted by the relentless Sahur entity.
No weapons, no escape-only rising whispers, shifting woods, and the race to survive before the echoes of “TUNG TUNG TUNG SAHUR” close in.

title: Meme Wars
description: MeMe Wars is a strategy battler with US-style Shanhaijing flair. Build a quirky hero lineup with unique roles and stats. Place them on the board for max power, adapt to new foes each stage, and win.

title: Solitaire Classic
description: The most popular card game in the world, classic Solitaire, also known as Patience, is a great way to relax and train your brain. With beautiful graphics, fun animations, new features, custom backgrounds and offline play - Solitaire by Albayoo is the ideal game for the best casual gaming experience, however, most importantly – this online strategy game helps TRAIN YOUR BRAIN and KEEP YOUR MIND SHARP!

title: Volley Beans - Volleyball Game
description: Get ready to become the best volleyball player of all time! Jump right now into this cute and simple, yet challenging volleyball game!

title: Gloomy Princess Favorite Toy
description: Immerse yourself in the mysterious world of the Gloomy Princess and her strange but touching teddy friend. Create unique images for the heroine of the game: choose makeup, outfits and accessories - from witch hats to lace corsets in the Gothic spirit. Add personality to her favorite toy. Assemble the perfect duo - a princess hiding her feelings behind a flawless image, and her beloved companion reflecting the inner world of the hostess!

title: Dont Tap
description: Don't tap condenses the basic idea of ground breaking game hits like rock band or guitar hero into a simple yet genius free online game that you can enjoy, whether you play on your phone, a tablet or on your desktop.

title: Hungry Snake Io
description: Hungry Snake.io is a classic game. Here you can try three game modes, Endless mode, Toilet Man, and Monster Brawl. Please note that there can be no collision between worms! In addition, our team takes user experience very seriously, we are always happy to improve the game so that every player can have a better gaming experience, if you encounter any difficulties during the game, please feel free to leave us a message!

title: Mini Market Tycoon
description: A new Market Tycoon Idle adventure is now beginning with the experts of this job. You have just opened a new supermarket in your town and you should manage there. There are lots of customers visiting your supermarket daily. You can earn good money and you can open new departments inside your supermarket. More departments mean more income. Don't forget to do your upgrades within the upgrade menu. You can buy helpers and do your work faster.

title: Mommy BFFs Pregnant Check Up
description: Go to the doctors with two cute BFFs who are about to become mommies for the first time! There are a lot of fun tools you can use to take their temperature and measure their heart beat. After you've made sure everything is going well, go ahead and give the two mommies fresh fruits and healthy shakes to keep their vitamin levels up. Play some music for the babies and choose a fun belly tattoo for each of them! This will be a fun day that will both remember dearly.

title: Pyramidz
description: Unleash the power of the gods in PyramidZ, a twist on the classic Match-3 genre where you slide entire rows and columns to align sacred hieroglyphs and trigger ancient magic.

title: Tictoc KPOP Fashion
description: Help this cute girl to become tictoc kpop star by helping her to choose the right make up and clothes by following the hint. Make her look stylish on every reel. You can buy new items by getting many likes after posting the photo.

title: Escape the Alien Prison
description:
You have suddenly woken up trapped inside a massive, high-tech spaceship deep in the cosmos, and there is only one objective: break out! Escape the Alien Prison is an epic sci-fi survival and parkour adventure where you must fight your way to freedom. Navigate dangerous obstacle courses, hack complex security systems, and take down extraterrestrial threats. 
The complete story campaign, puzzles, collectibles, and progression are available in Single Player Mode.

title: 1010 Golden Trophies
description: 1010 Golden Trophies" is an intriguing puzzle game where your objective is to gather all the trophy blocks on the board. To achieve this, you must complete the row or column containing the trophy block. To fill these rows or columns, select and place block sets from the left panel. You can continue placing block sets until there's no more space left, at which point the game will conclude. Challenge your puzzle-solving skills in this unique and engaging game!

title: Lovely Cat Pet Life
description: Call for all pet lovers! If you are a DIY enthusiast or enjoy playing with cute animals, join Lovely Cat: Pet Life, a casual DIY cat game online. Dive into this adorable, fun-filled, and creative game that combines the elements of cats, pets, fashion, and DIY all in one perfect package! Play dress-up game: Try out charming suits on your pet. Decorate an ideal look for your kitten. Enjoy minigames unblocked: Join mini animal parkour games with your little cat.

title: TimeWarriors
description:
Lead your army to glory through the ages! Embark on an epic journey through history. From primitive battles of the Stone Age to the futuristic wars of the future — become the greatest commander the world has ever known.

Become a great commander and lead your army to victory! Play “Time Warriors” now!

title: Two Supra Drifters
description: Drift through 3 stunning drift tracks and show how well you can steer the wheels of a powerful supra. Go head to head with your friend in a drift battle and see whose a better drift racer, customize your ride with stunning body colors, underglows and cool rims. Are you ready to showcase your drifting skills?

title: Real Driving Simulator
