description: Real Driving Simulator is a realistic driving simulation game that lets you fully enjoy the thrill of driving and racing! In this game, you can unblock various vehicles and drive them through cities and tracks. Experience the real feel of being behind the wheel.

title: Real Construction Excavator Simulator
description:
Real Construction Excavator Simulator is a driving simulator game where you get to experience a day in the life of a truck driver. In this online game, your driving skills will be put to the test as you will have to drive through some of the most challenging terrains you ever saw.

The main objective of this game is the delivery of construction materials to building sites. For this task, your driving skills will have to be sharp and you'll have to stay focused, as even a small mistake could cost your cargo. 

You will have to maneuver an excavator to load your truck. This task can be challenging, but if you're focused, it can be done. Once your truck is filled, you will have to drive all the way to the construction, where you will have to carefully dump what you're carrying in a designated spot.

title: Zen Cube 3D
description: Zen Cube 3D is a relaxation match 3d puzzle game. Not like classic match games, Zen Triple 3D not only a time-killing game but also is a zen & relaxation matching puzzle game which is easy for everyone to play.

title: Mahjong Tour
description: Mahjong Tour game is a cool mahjong game with colorful graphics,  challenging levels and appealing themes. Match tiles of the same type and watch them flutter away. Once you clear the screen, the level is finished and you can move on to the next.

title: Unicorn Chef Design Cake
description: Tons of realistic cooking tools to play with: oven, piping bags, spatula, bowls, plates, cream mixer, food processor, induction cooker, ice cream dispenser, knife, cutting board, slushy dispenser, straws, cake molds, and so much more.Tons of food materials and decorations to try: fruits, candies, sprinkles, milk, flour, salt, butter, eggs, chocolate, ice cream, cream, water, cotton candy, cookies, caramel and so much more. Join us to make a mermaid cake. Have fun!

title: Majestic Dragons Merge
description:
In the days of old, dragons wander the lands as the master of all. Breathe fire and plunder all the riches in Majestic Dragons!

Majestic Dragons is an idle merge game where you merge together similar objects to obtain new things. Help your baby dragons grow into fearsome, majestic beasts! Watch them roam freely across the lands and accumulate riches for you.

Do you know how to train a dragon? Come play now and let's find out!

title: Mow It
description: Mow It Harvest is a colorful simulator in which you will have a farm and your own harvester at your disposal. You need to cut grass, sell colorful hay and move on to new levels. Cut grass like a real farmer and become a millionaire in this bright, exciting game!

title: Yummy Super Pizza
description: Making pizza has never been more fun! Yummy Super pizza lets you make a delicious pizza by adding the ingredients for the dough, cooking the sauce, adding a variety of toppings and baking it. The best part is after u make a pizza, you can serve it to your customers, and don't let them wait too long.

title: Stickman Troll Thief Puzzle
description: Thief Puzzle is a funny and addictive casual puzzle game. Here you should help a clever stickman with many funny ways to solve puzzles and steal target items. The rich and varied game scene contains many unexpected obstacles and traps, testing your intelligence and logical thinking. Each level of the game is a unique challenge. To make flexible movements of the character to overcome obstacles, avoid enemies, and successfully steal the target item.

title: Pinball Basketball
description: A captivating fusion of classic arcade pinball excitement and thrilling sports gameplay. Flip your paddle skillfully to keep the ball in play, aiming for the basketball hoop while enjoying the stunning minimalist art and responsive design that make every moment electrifying and addictive.

title: Farm Animal Sort Puzzle
description: Welcome to Farm Animal Sort Puzzle, a fun and relaxing casual puzzle game set on a lively farm. Your mission is simple but addictive: match the appropriate animal or vegetable to the customer's needs. Sort adorable farm animals into the correct spaces and enjoy the satisfying challenge of smart organization.

title: Protect My Dog 3
description: Protect My Dog 3 is a fun casual puzzle game. The aim of the game is to protect our cute dog from bee attacks. For this, you must create a defensive drawing line at the levels. You should also protect your dog from lava, thorns and different environmental hazards. Fighting the Bees will continue for 100 Levels and things will get a little more difficult with each level.

title: Hero Tower War
description:
Many monsters and enemies in the tower. You need to defeat them, get treasures and save hostages.

You can play everywhere ,every time. It is a boring killer game.

title: Pottery Master
description: Pottery Master invites you into a peaceful world of creativity and clay. Shape, sculpt, and refine your pottery using intuitive tools, then add your personal touch with vibrant colors. Each creation is a moment to unwind, express your style, and transform simple clay into a stunning masterpiece in a relaxing, artistic flow

title: Meme Mukbang ASMR Game
description: Welcome to Meme Mukbang ASMR Game, the ultimate livestream mukbang experience! Step into the world of a quirky mukbang streamer, where you’ll indulge in delicious dishes and share your mukbang ASMR moments with a growing audience. The more you eat and interact, the more you earn, all while building your fame in the livestream world!

title: Merge Galaxy
description:
The famous merge game is arrived!
You can shoot the planets like balls to throw, and when the same planets touch each other, it becomes bigger planet!
Cute planets want to be bigger, so keep merge the planets until you make the sun!

title: Boat Battles
description: Boat Battles is based on the classic board game Battleship, also known as Sea Battle. Boat Battles features great graphics, nice animations and fitting music and sound effects. The ships are placed on the playing board using drag & drop. English, German, French, Dutch, Spanish, Portuguese, Polish, Turkish and Russian translations included.

title: Fabulous Cute Unicorn Coloring Book
description: It’s time to draw, young artists! This time we have to color fabulous cute unicorns. Use the slide bar on the right to select the desired color. The palette of this game contains wonderful pastel shades. Drag the panel with the palette using the left mouse button. Enjoy this new game «Fabulous cute unicorn coloring book»!

title: Skinfluencer Beauty Routine
description: Embark on an extraordinary journey of self-expression and embracing imperfections with Skinfluencer Beauty Routine. Guided by Emma, discover the true meaning of beauty from within and embrace confidence in your own skin. Dive into the enchanting world of beauty, fashion, and self-discovery. Unleash your creativity, join Emma's quest to become the ultimate #skinfluencer, and conquer the virtual realm! Experience this brand-new makeover game for girls and let your unique beauty shine through.

title: Break Beat
description: Break Beat is a fast-paced and colorful brick-breaker game with a pixel art/neon aesthetic and an electronic music soundtrack.

title: Get Ready With Me: Concert Day
description: Join us in the excitement as you follow the thrilling journey of teen Riri, who is preparing for the concert of a lifetime. From choosing the perfect outfit to applying stunning makeup, you'll get to walk her through all the steps of this beautifying process. But before you start the fun, be sure to help her customize her cowgirl hat, a signature item for the concert she will attend. Then go crazy with the makeup, dress her up in a jaw-dropping outfit, and accessorize for a complete look.

title: The Sort Agency
description: You are the head of the best object sorting agency. Your goal is to bring order and cleanliness to the world. On the many levels you will be able to test your attentiveness and tactical thinking. Look for the right items in a pile of other items. But keep track of how many items you already have in your hands!

title: Cannon Shooter
description: Cannon Shooter is an exciting arcade shooter where you can have endless shooting fun in fast-paced combat! You will control a cannonball firing hordes of heroic characters, facing many enemies. A quick click to launch more heroes and help you generate more heroes through the digital gate.

title: Fishing: Catch the Secret Brainrot
description:
Explore a large sea world where fishing is the core of the adventure ??
Sail across the sea, travel between islands, and fish in many different locations. This online fishing game lets you catch fish, brainrots, and mysterious creatures while exploring a living ocean world filled with secrets ?️
Use your boat to move between islands and search for the best fishing spots ?

title: Xmas Magic Tiles
description: Try to tap on the green tiles without missing any A fun Christmas themed music game

title: Spider Solitaire
description: Experience Spider Solitaire, one of the popular single-player card games. Arrange cards in descending order and form complete sets of the same suit from King to Ace to remove them. The challenge is to organize two decks into eight tableau piles. With strategic thinking and skill, try to uncover all cards and complete the eight sets. There are varying difficulty levels based on the number of different suits (Diamonds, Spades, Hearts, Clubs) you choose to play with.

title: Spider Solitaire
description:
Challenge yourself with this captivating solitaire inspired by the classic Spider card game!

Arrange all the cards on the table into complete sequences of the same suit (from King to Ace), testing your logic, strategy, and patience.

Choose your difficulty level, play with one, two, or all four suits, and prove your skills with the deck.

Every move counts—can you complete all the sequences before running out of options?

title: Tile Connect - Pair Matching
description:
Tile Connect is a tile-matching game for both kids and adults. Play and relax in your free time!  

It offers beautiful themes and music for much fun! With the memory of your brain and concentration of your mind, you search pairs and connect to turn them into stars! The higher level you get more challenging it is, but various tools and treasure boxes are there for help! So play and enjoy it now! Classic and boring merging games. This is a new, free, and cool game for boys and girls.

title: Merge Fellas Online
description: Enjoy the Italian Brainrot meme world in this Merge game. Immerse yourself in the Italian Brainrot world and merge identical characters to accumulate points and reach the highest score. A simple and easy mechanic, drop characters together to form higher-value ones, providing rewards with each successful merge.  Solve the puzzle and merge all the pets!

title: Quizmania: Trivia game
description: Sharpen your mind across exciting levels. Answer a variety of questions from different topics and use strategic hints to guide your way. As you progress, the difficulty increases, offering a rewarding and challenging experience with every round.

title: Sniper Elite 3D
description: Prepare to enjoy the finest 3D sniper experience ever with the most thrilling and action-packed shooting game! Sniper 3D is the ultimate free gun game that immerses you in the life of a lethal assassin. Immerse yourself in high-intensity offline missions and test your shooting abilities in this adrenaline-fueled sniper experience. Have fun playing Sniper Elite 3D, a free online game!

title: Panda Shop Simulator
description: Do you love shopping at supermarkets? Now you can build your own! Play as a cute panda owner and grow your store from a small corner shop to a bustling retail empire. Earn money to hire assistants and upgrade facilities to the max level. Enjoy playful twist with adorable panda characters that make running your shop even more fun and exciting!

title: Extreme Offroad Cars 3: Cargo
description: You're tasked with cargo delivery, a job that'll take you through some difficult environments, and you'll have to complete each delivery without losing your cargo.

title: Farmer Pedro
description:
Get ready to till the soil and reap the rewards in Farmer Pedro!

In this charming 3D farming simulator, you’ll take on the role of Pedro, a humble farmer with a big dream - to build the most bountiful farm in the countryside. Start by driving your trusty tractor around the initial plot of land, harvesting a variety of crops like corn, tomatoes, carrots, and more.

As you grow and harvest your crops, you’ll earn cash that can be used to expand your farmland and unlock access to new crops.

title: Candy Star
description: Hundreds of levels and challenges are waiting for you only need to eliminate three or more same candies to score Find a way that you can finish all the levels in a short time Have fun with Candy Star

title: Fishing Baron Real Fishing
description: Fishing Baron Real Fishing is a casual fishing simulator that offers a realistic fishing experience. Enjoy a relaxing and challenging fishing journey. Become a fishing master. Start a fishing adventure across various beautiful fishing locations. From lakes to oceans, you can unlock different areas to fish. Each location has unique fish species and environments.

title: UNO Heroes
description: UNO Heroes is a fun version of UNO with unique features Your main goal will be to free the locked Superheroes  you must win as many games as possible to do that The rules are simple especially since many of you already know how to play The player who is first left with no cards wins Dont forget to tap that UNO button when youre ready to let your second to last card go

title: Capybara Go!
description: Enter the wonderful world of Capybara. In Capybara Go, begin a strategic adventure. You'll be forming and commanding your own little Capybara army. Defeat your opponents and conquer everything through strategy and combat. Lay out your Capybara's to take advantage of each one's strengths and use strategy to defeat powerful enemies.

title: Magic Kingdom. Hex Match
description: Magic Kingdom: Hex Match is a game where you are the third son of a great king, sent to a distant land to prove your worth. Collect six vital resources—food, water, stone, wood, workers, and metal—to construct new buildings. Unlock all structures and create a stunning, magical kingdom!

title: Match 3D Puzzle Saga
description: Ready to match and collect? Solve puzzles to earn coins, unlock powerful power-ups and complete daily challenges to grab extra rewards and sweet bonuses. The more you play, the more opportunities you have to boost your score!

title: Bowmasters
description: Bowmasters is a fun and action-packed game that combines creative physics with exciting Archery gameplay. Use different types of bows and weapons. Draw your weapon, judge the angle, and fire arrows to hit all enemies. The game shines with its physics-based mechanics, where timing, distance, and trajectory matter. You’ll need real skill and smart thinking to solve each shooting puzzle and land accurate hits. Every match feels different thanks to unique characters and varied weapons.

title: Checkers Deluxe Edition
description:
It's a clash on the battlefield! Draw up your plan and defeat your opponents with finesse!

It is also known as the draughts game, and it is an interesting test of strategy. Compete with an opponent and dominate their pieces as best you can.

What happens when you manage to move a piece to the other end? Come play now and let's find out!

title: Mad Truck Challenge Special
description: Gear up for roaring, action-packed race battles against the meanest Monster Trucks you’ve ever seen! They’re waiting for you at the Mad Truck Challenge starting line. Strap up for a relentless racing simulator that will have your adrenaline pumping. Select your truck, armed with rockets, and race against the toughest off-road drivers on the planet. Crush and blast your way to victory while you perform extreme stunts and make your opponents bite the dust to earn the coveted MTC trophy.

title: Police Car Real Cop Simulator
description: The Police Car Real Cop Simulator has a user-friendly environment with realistic driving, police-station control, various weapons, and modern vehicles. Drive your police car, drive with other vehicles and be careful! The game has many missions, each with different tasks for you to complete. You will have to drive carefully on the roads, park your car safely, stop violators, chase them and finish your assignments.

title: FlowBall
description: Feel the adrenaline in an exciting 3D arcade game where you control a glowing ball racing through an endless tunnel! Avoid traps, chasms and obstacles, defying the laws of gravity. Your goal is to collect glowing dots to unlock new levels and set records! But be careful: falling into the abyss takes away lives, and losing them leads to defeat!

title: Conquer.io
description: Expand your zone and assert your dominance over every territory on the map. Plan your moves to outmaneuver opponents and gain as much space as possible. But beware, your rivals will stop at nothing to thwart your plans. Are you ready to claim your space?

title: Bubble classic
description: The goal of the game is not to lose as early as possible and to score as many points as possible. Improve your accuracy thanks to very competent rolling of balls. The more blocks with balls you destroy, the more points you accumulate. Check your results in the world rankings, maybe you are already number 1.

title: ZooCraft
description: Zoocraft is an addictive game that will let you create your very own zoo! A world inhabited by various kinds of animals. In this game you have to tame animals, improve your skills, build aviaries and travel to different corners of the earth! Take an unforgettable journey from the village meadow to the hot desert and cold Antarctica!

title: Fashion Famous
description: Step into the stylish universe of Fashion Famous! Compete in glamorous fashion contests, pick outfits that match each round’s theme, and impress the judges to earn high scores. Travel across global fashion capitals and showcase your look on dazzling runways. Explore makeup, hairstyles, and accessories to build the perfect outfit. Will your sense of style stand out among players from all around the world?

title: Lion Family Sim Online
description: Step into the wild and rule the savannah in Lion Family Sim Online. It’s a full animal simulation adventure where you live the life of a mighty lion. Build and grow your own lion family, explore vast open landscapes, and face thrilling challenges. Hunt for food to survive, protect your territory, and lead your pride with strength and strategy.

title: Aloha Mahjong
description: Collect all the Hawaiian items in this daily Mahjong at Home game. Try to clear all tiles by pairing the same free Aloha tiles. A tile is free if it is not covered and has at least one free side.

title: Blue Mushroom Cat Run
description: Catch the mischievous thief in Blue Mushroom Cat Run! A cunning thief has snatched your gold, and guess what? Unlock vibrant worlds and zoom through endless obstacles in this action-packed runner. From sun-kissed beaches to neon-lit night streets, every map offers fresh surprises and heart-pounding thrills.

title: Dazzling Divas Makeup
description: Test your makeup artist skills in Dazzling Divas Makeup! Inspired by My Little Pony, this colorful dress-up game lets you create magical makeup looks for three fabulous girls—Lila, Mimi, and Roxy. Style each diva with Fluttershy, Pinkie Pie, and Rainbow Dash–inspired makeup, then complete their look with trendy tops and accessories. With endless outfit combos and sparkling vibes, this is the ultimate glam experience for fashion lovers!

title: Fish rain
description: Fishing game is a full-fledged fishing simulator and makes it possible to fish in real existing places from life and catch the fish that lives there.

title: Hard Puzzle
description:
Enter a vibrant, calming world of geometry where your goal is to build perfect squares from colorful pieces. Fit the shapes together, unlock new levels, and challenge your logic and spatial skills. Need help? Use a hint to keep going!
? Easy to play, hard to master
? Relaxing visuals
? A quick, fun brain boost anytime
Start puzzling and become a geometry master!

title: Schoolboy Runaway: room escape
description: Step into the gripping adventure of Schoolboy Runaway: Room Escape, where strategy and mystery go hand in hand. A young schoolboy finds himself locked in a strange room, full of tricky puzzles and hidden clues. Help him think fast, solve each challenge, and escape before it’s too late. Play for free on both mobile and desktop and see if you can unravel the secrets of every room.

title: Board Kings Board Dice
description: Board Kings: Board Dice is a classic multiplayer strategy board game. Do you like to play Monopoly,Board Kings: Board Dice is similar to Monopoly. Become the real Board King by building and upgrading your empire with dice points, building and upgrading your board, or infiltrating other players' boards and attacking their buildings. This is a game where luck and strength go hand in hand to win,how is your luck today? Join us for more surprises waiting to be unlocked!

title: Yes or No Challenge Run
description: This time you will not only run over the platforms and pass through the gates for the next version of yours, but you will also answer questions and earn rewards. Yes or No Challenge Run game comes with lots of features, surprises, and cool questions! Some helper machines or pets will be with you during this adventure. You can embark on this Yes or No adventure either single-player or 2 player. Pick your game mode and let the adventure start!

title: Snake and Ladders Multiplayer
description:
Snake and Ladders Multiplayer is a HTML5 Board Game. 
Enjoy this funny version of the classic Snake and Ladders Game. 
3 Game’s Mode: 
- Multiplayer mode 
- Play against the pc 
- Challenge a friend playing on the same device

title: Free the Ball
description: Try out Free the Ball, a super fun puzzle game! Your job is to guide the ball to its goal by moving blocks around. And get this – there are a whopping three thousand levels to play, and they're all free! No need to buy anything.

title: Zombie Siege.io
description: As a soldier at the last base with unlimited potential, you must arm yourself and battle against dangerous zombies! Use your wisdom to select the best weapons, skills, and talents to defend against waves of zombies. How many maps will you be able to save?

title: Dinosaur Rampage
description: When the rampage ends, you’ll compete against other dinosaurs in the same arena and get ranked based on your destruction performance. Unlock many different dinosaur types, collect cool skins in the shop, and prove you’re the ultimate king of chaos. Fast, satisfying, and perfect for stress relief—just stomp, smash, and climb the leaderboard!

title: 3D Ball Balancer
description: 3D Ball Balancer is a fun 3D rolling ball game. Control the ball to roll on the floating bridge. There are obstacles all over the floating bridge, including broken bridges, ramps, single-plank bridges, etc. Not only do you have to control the direction of the ball, but you also have to control the speed of the ball. How far you can go? Have a try!

title: Beggar Clicker
description: Beggar Clicker is a casual game. It is unimaginable that a beggar living on the street can make money so quickly. A few thousand dollars in just one minute. Just tap the screen to generate a steady stream of money. Enjoy!

title: Domino Adventure
description: Discover three match durations to suit your style. Showcase your skills and logic in each round, and use strategic moves to outplay your opponents. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts seeking endless fun and challenges.

title: Climb Up!
description: In this challenging adventure, you'll embark on a perilous ascent up a massive, treacherous mountain. Navigate slippery surfaces and unpredictable obstacles as you make your way towards the summit, where eternal glory and a rewarding gift await. Will you be able to overcome the many hurdles and reach the top, or will the climb prove too daunting? Your determination and skill will be tested as you brave the unknowns of this grueling climb.

title: Sudoku Classic – Daily Brain Puzzle
description: Enjoy the ultimate Sudoku experience for players of all skill levels! Challenge your brain with classic Sudoku puzzles from easy to expert difficulty. Improve your logic, focus, and problem-solving skills while relaxing with a clean and intuitive interface. Features include multiple difficulty levels, a helpful hint system, auto-save, and smooth gameplay on both desktop and mobile. Play anytime, train your mind, and become a true Sudoku master!

title: Block Blasty Saga
description:
Place the blocks on the board and crush them all! Complete the lines with the various block shapes and blast them all! Get ready to become the block master!

Play the game in two modes: classic way and adventure mode. Try to achieve the highest score in Classic mode by blasting the most block amount, it is an infinite game mode and increases the fun with ASMR sounds. In Adventure mode, complete the tens of chapters and improve your block-crushing skills step by step. Join the saga now!

title: Sudoku Brain Blocks
description: Sudoku Brain Blocks is a relaxing yet addictive online puzzle game that blends classic Sudoku logic with block-fitting challenges (Tetris style). Drag and drop various shaped blocks onto a 9×9 grid to complete full rows, columns, or 3×3 squares to clear the board and earn high scores. Use strategy and planning to avoid running out of space and test your brain with every move!

title: Stack Up
description: Stack Up is a vibrant puzzle game where strategy meets fun. Connect stacks of the same color to form long chains, reach level goals, and climb through increasingly challenging puzzles. With colorful visuals, smooth gameplay, and intuitive controls, Stack Up offers an addictive experience for players of all ages.

description: Welcome to Capybara Mukbang ASMR, a casual cooking ASMR game that you can play for free. Dive into a delicious world where you cook hamburger, pizza, and ice cream recipes. Dress up and taste your dishes one by one. Share your food with the audience by eating and drinking in the Mukbang livestream, and see how many likes you can receive.

title: World Flags Memory
description: We are with you in the game World Flags Memory. Together with you we will try to find all the pairs of some world flags. In front of you on the screen will be visible cards lying on a wooden background. You will need to open two cards simultaneously and try to memorize them. As soon as you find two identical ones, open them together and get points for this turn. Remember that the assignment is given a certain time.

title: Xmas Bubble Frenzy
description: Welcome to 'Xmas Bubble Frenzy'. It will make you feel the joy of the festive. In each level collect the required number of bubbles. Don't let the bubbles touch the border. Catch special bubbles for more points. See how many levels you can reach.

title: Land Cruiser Offroad Driver
description: Take your cute dog along for a thrilling offroading adventure, and complete 4 awesome game modes across the city map with your awesome SUV. Customize and Upgrade it to your liking and ride in style across the giant offroading map. If you create nuisance in the city, the cops will be on your tail to chase you down. Drift the tires off the SUV and make as much money as you can. Are you ready for this thrilling adventure?

title: Hexa Sort
description: Hexa Sort offers a delightful blend of puzzle challenges, strategic matching, and satisfying merging experience. Engage your mind with stimulating brain games that involve clever puzzle solving and logical maneuvers, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a mental workout.

title: Catch The Snowflake
description: In Catch The Snowflake, be prepared to test your attention! Snowflakes and Christmas trees  decorate the tiles in this game, and all you have to do is to link them together. How many points do you think you can earn before the timer hits zero?

title: Girl Coloring Dress Up Games
description:
Brand new girl games are already waiting for you! Start creating your own coloring pages by dressing up dolls and painting pictures for backgrounds. You’ll get hundreds of color options, textures and patterns, glitter and gradients. Create your coloring book from scratch, color dresses, and improve your clothes designer skills. If you like drawing that’s the free coloring apps you’ve been looking for!

✪ Play as a doll designer: select hair, dress up, and pick accessories

The Mojicon series returns for the holidays! Match festive tiles, break the new Ice Sheet blockers, and enjoy a relaxing winter puzzle adventure. ❄️
Mojicon Winter Connect takes the classic Onet matching fun you love and covers it in a layer of fresh snow. Immerse yourself in a cozy holiday atmosphere, connecting festive icons like reindeer, gingerbread men, and happy snowmen.
Fast, satisfying, and full of seasonal charm – it’s the perfect winter puzzle for all ages. ✨✨✨

title: Madness Driver Vertigo City
description: Mad drivers meet in the vertigo city with their cool super sport racing cars. The city offers a plethora of exciting activities and races. Fly through the ramps and collect gems to double your fun. Enjoy amusement park activities and play single or 2 player mode to challenge your friend in races or free drive activities. Begin the supercar simulator and customize your cars with unique designs.

title: Lady Popular
description:
Create the lifestyle you always wanted and live а life of beauty and high fashion! Customize every aspect of your personal avatar by choosing the tone of your skin, your hairstyle, eyes, makeup, clothes, shoes, accessories, and more.
Design the apartment of your dreams, get the cutest pets you always wanted to have, and find the perfect boyfriend.
Become a member of a lady's club today, and make long-lasting friendships with other girls that love
fashion, beauty, and competition as much as you do!

title: Yummy Ice Cream Factory
description: What makes your summer more vibing? Yes, Ice cream! Create your own ice cream cones. Yummy! Go through every step of the making of ice cream with unique and delicious recipes. Pick your favorite flavours, choose from different cones, and finish it with a combination of toppings. Don't forget to pick out the perfect outfits for the girls. Have fun with Yummy Ice Cream Factory!

description: Do you like puzzle games? Bubble Shooter Pet Match is waiting for you.

description: The biggest world tennis tournaments would be nothing without the best player around. So pick up your racket and show everyone just what you are made of!

title: Card Solitaire: Word Game

Train your brain in a fun new way with Card Solitaire: Word Game — a clever blend of card sorting, word puzzles, and logic challenges!
Explore the exciting world of word solitaire, packed with clever associations, tricky word sort levels, and fun topic sort puzzles.

description: Unblock Metro is a fascinating puzzle game. You need to move all the vehicles in front of the metro so that the metro drives smoothly along the track. You have to be careful that the head of the vehicle is facing that way and you can't change the direction of the vehicle. There are cars,trucks, ambulances, and so on. Lovely pictures and a wide variety of cars give you a refreshing gaming experience. The intricate vehicles placed in front of the metro will dazzle you. Waiting for your challenge！

title: Polygon Space
description: Polygon Space is an intense shooting challenge. Fly a laser cannon in space, battle attacking sci-fi shapes, keep firing, upgrade weapons with resources, destroy them all, and stay safe.

Whether you're passionate about fashion, beauty care, or just looking for a fun, relaxing game, this is the perfect app for you. From designing acrylic nails to creating stunning makeup looks, step into a world of endless beauty transformations in 3D! ??

title: Help Me: Tricky Brain Puzzles
description:
Put your mind to the test in this fun and challenging brain puzzle game! ?
Solve tricky riddles, make tough decisions, and uncover mysteries in each level. From saving lives to solving absurd situations, every case challenges your logic and creativity.

title: Hidden Horrors
description: Ready to explore the haunted Halloween world? Play a hidden object game with 30 Halloween levels. Each level has 6 hidden objects. Find all objects before time runs out. If you need help, use a hint. The game is easy to play. Enjoy colorful Halloween scenes and fun gameplay.

title: My Little Farm
description: Welcome to My Little Farm! Roll up your sleeves and dive into the world of planting, harvesting, and selling to meet daily demands. Upgrade your tools, nurture your crops, and keep the farm flourishing. Can you handle the never-ending requests and become the ultimate farmer?

title: What's In My Bag?
description: Unpack style and surprises in What’s In My Bag? – the ultimate dress-up and makeup game for fashion lovers! Choose cute outfits, glam makeup, and trendy bags, then reveal what’s inside each one. From influencer props to girly goodies, every bag tells a story. Get creative, show off your style, and join the viral “what’s in my bag” trend now! Perfect for fans of dress-up games, makeup fun, and aesthetic vibes.

title: Rent out - Landlord Tycoon
description: In this captivating world of landlord games, you'll start with a modest property portfolio and a dream to become the ultimate real estate and house tycoon. Your goal is to buy, sell, and manage properties to maximize your profits and become a successful business and house tycoon in this rent game. Whether it's residential apartments, commercial complexes, or luxurious villas, it's your chance to be rich in this rent game.

title: Fruit Match Juicy Puzzle
description: Fruit Match Juicy Puzzle is an irresistibly fun puzzle casual game that bursts with juicy visuals and addictive gameplay! A brilliant combination of puzzle and match mechanics. From the moment you start, you’ll be hooked on its satisfying matching mechanics and clever level design.

title: Real Drive 3D
description:
Are you ready to experience unique car-driving gameplay? Start with your SUV and unlock new vehicles as you progress through the game, playing different and unique levels. Drive your favorite vehicles, and navigate your way around new challenging environments.

We welcome all racing car game fans to experience this new driving game! Real Drive 3D is a car simulation game which will give you a unique arcade experience.

title: Scorpion Solitaire
description: Scorpion Solitaire is a solitaire card game in which the goal is to build 4 columns down by suit from K to A. If you do not have a step to move the card, you will lose the game.

title: Winter Soccer
description:
Winter season is here, but the soccer game must continue. Drag, aim and release to shoot the soccer ball.

The first person to score 3 goals wins.

Features:

- Winter theme with snow and pine trees, perfect for the winter / christmas audiance
- Choose your side, from 32 nations. 
- Smart and calculative AI. Be prepared to think, plan and play hard
- Tutorial to learn the ropes
- Exciting soccer stadium environment, perfect for soccer or football nuts

title: Noob in Geometry Dash
description: Move to the rhythm and help Nubik navigate challenging levels! Collect keys to unlock skins, complete courses, and see how high you can rank among the best players. Step into the beat-driven adventure!

title: Autumn Glam Gala
description: Get ready for the ultimate fall beauty adventure at the Autumn Glam Gala! Help three BFFs create stunning makeup looks for the most anticipated gala of the season. From soft, natural tones to bold, sparkling colors, you’ll have endless fun choosing makeup, hairstyles, and glamorous outfits. Experiment with fall-inspired looks and fashion trends to ensure each girl shines at the gala. Are you ready to showcase your makeup artist skills? Play Autumn Glam Gala now and let the glam begin!

title: Goods Sort Master
description: Goods Sort Master is a fun sorting game. Have you ever fantasized about spending money in the supermarket? How much can you take away in a limited time? In this game you can sort snacks, drinks and fruits and have fun exploring triple matches in 3D cabinets to unlock more of your favorite products. The game is simple, just drag the same 3D products onto several shelves to match or triple match them. If you're a fan of matching games, why not give it a try?

title: Parking Fury 3D: Beach City 2
description: Parking Fury 3D: Beach City 2 takes you to a vibrant town by the beach where you can test your driving and parking skills in a variety of supercars. Complete challenging parking missions while exploring the scenic coastal streets. You can switch cars on the map, but watch out for the police - get caught stealing a vehicle, and it’s game over! Can you master the art of parking in Beach City without getting busted?

title: Red Escape
description: In Red Escape you must search for useful items in the series of rooms to help you escape. Look carefully around the rooms, and use your logic to solve the riddles. Find your way to escape!

title: Color Sort Puzzle
description: Spend your time wisely, relaxing and training your mind all at once! Put the water in the most strategic flask and enjoy when everything falls into place.

title: Tennis Masters 2026
description: Become a tennis master and show all your competitor talents to beat your opponents in the game Tennis Masters.  You can play against the computer, or against a friend in 2 player mode! Collect power-ups and funny transformations.  Have fun!

title: Offroad Muddy Trucks
description: Embark on a great adventure with huge trucks featuring massive tires and bodies in the Offroad Muddy Trucks game! You can play in either the 1 or 2 player career mode or explore a vast free map with a friend. The game offers surprises and entertaining terrain for you to discover. Let the monster truck simulator begin on muddy ground and experience all the various terrains on the map.

title: Sand Blast
description:
Sand Blast – A Satisfying Flowing-Sand Puzzle Experience, a relaxing yet strategic puzzle game built on soft, flowing sand physics!
Every block is made of loose, unstable sand — place it, and it instantly crumbles and shifts with gravity. These pieces won’t stay still, so you’ll need to think ahead and plan every move carefully.

title: Offroad Life 3D
description: A life on the mountains with huge vehicles with huge wheels is beginning with the Offroad Life 3D game! This adventure will be in the different places of the world under the different seasons from autumn to summer. Various offroad vehicle options and various wheel options are available with this great adventure. Embark on this adventure with your friend in 2 player game mode and discover new areas together!

title: Fish Love Pins
description: Fish Love Pins is a physics-based game that requires players to actively use their brains to figure out how to complete each level. The game is very easy to play, but as you progress through the levels, the difficulty gradually increases.

title: Halloween Scarry Heads
description: Play the newest Halloween puzzle game Halloween Scarry Heads. In this hypercasual puzzle game, you have to solve the puzzle, so that you arrange the blocks in the same order with the scary heads that fall from above. Try to solve as many as you can. Have fun!

title: 2048 Run Gorgeous Balls
description: 2048 Run: Gorgeous Balls is a fun arcade game that invites you to chase high scores in a delightful environment! In this creative 2048-style game, you’ll control a colorful array of balls as they race along a dynamic track.

title: Mr Long Hand
description: Immerse yourself in the quirky and delightful world of Mr Long Hand, where you take on the role of a stickman with incredibly long arms. Your mission is simple yet endlessly entertaining: use your elongated limbs to swing through obstacles, solve puzzles, and embark on thrilling rescues. Mr Long Hand offers a unique blend of creativity, challenge, and humor that is sure to captivate players of all ages.

title: PaperWar.io
description: There are so many unexplored areas! Conquering them is the key to mastering the game. Expand your territory, eliminate other players who threaten your progress and aim to conquer 100% of each new map. Choose from 9 special skins to express your style!

title: Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo
description: Welcome to Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo, a unique and immersive game that lets you unleash your inner tattoo artist. This isn't just any game; it's your gateway to a world where art meets relaxation, and where your creativity can truly shine. Prepare to immerse yourself in the satisfying and intricate process of tattooing, all at the tip of your fingers!

title: Backyard Dig Hole 3D Simulator
description:
Become a Gemstone Hunter in Your Own Backyard!

Ever dreamed of being a real miner and digging for treasure in your own backyard? Backyard Dig Hole 3D Simulator brings that fantasy to life with realistic graphics that make you feel like you're truly digging deep to find valuable gemstones and metals hidden beneath the earth!

title: Baby Chicco Adventures
description: Baby Chicco Adventures is a platform game in which you'll help our little penguin escape the dangers of the video game world. Have fun playing and completing all the challenges in this fantastic game!

title: Winter Maze
description:
Step into a frosty puzzle adventure with Winter Maze! Explore icy, snow-covered mazes and guide your ball through slippery, twisty paths that fill up with every move. Each level challenges you to think ahead, plan your route and clear the entire field to unlock the next stage.
Simply swipe to roll the ball in any direction and watch the maze come to life beneath you. Your goal is clear: cover every tile and leave no space untouched.

title: Dalgona Master
description:
Welcome to Dalgona Master, a thrilling game for those who loves dalgona, honeycomb, cookie game, and dalgona challenges.

This engaging sweet game challenge invites you to carve delicate shapes out of honeycomb candy, immersing you in the delicate skill required to perfect each piece without breaking it.

title: Kitty Quiz
description: Guess the Kitty in Kitty Quiz! The game will show you all kinds of cats and you must make a choice between three answers. Only one answer, is the correct answer.

title: Packing Line
description: Ship all the cans. Choose a box of the same color as the can. The game is over if you run out of space for boxes and the line stops.

title: Shoe Designer
description: Wonderful news for all of you fashion divas who are obsessed with designer shoes! Fabulous new shoes designing game “Shoe Designer” is here to let you design your unique pumps, sandals or stilettos!

title: Dumb Ways Jr Zanys Hospital
description: From the creators of Dumb Ways to Die the hit brand with over  million downloads total on Google Play and Apple App Store  we present to you an exciting spinoff brand called Dumb Ways JR Zanys HospitalVisit Dumb Ways Hospital with Doctor Zany Explore three main areas of play a waiting room full of surprises to discover a checkup room where children can play the role of doctor and an ambulance that visits the hospital featuring fun guest appearances from the original Dumb Ways cast

title: AquaPark Fun Loop
description: You are an aquapark operator in the Aquapark Fun Loop game. In order for the pool to receive more customers, you must make it make more profit. Continue making upgrades with the money you earn to make Aqupark bigger and better. You can finally have a very big and fancy Aquapark!

title: Murder Stone Age
description: Test your instincts in Murder Stone Age, a suspenseful tap-based thriller. Watch your back as mysterious figures follow you. One of them may mean harm. Tap to glance behind just in time: guess wrong and it's over. Can you outwit the stalker and survive?

title: Planet Merge
description:
Embark on an interstellar journey in the most thrilling puzzle game of 2025! Merge planets in a cosmic challenge and create a universe of fun.
imple Yet Addictive Gameplay: Just drag and release to align the planets. Watch as they combine into spectacular new celestial bodies.

title: Pop Blocks
description:
Addictive match 3 game genre game in style of famous Facebook franchise, featuring easy game play, and cute music for player to come back for good time.
Basic Tap on two or more items of the same color to destroy them.
Easy game mechanics, make every one happy!
​

title: Stack n Sort
description:
Welcome to Stack n Sort, the ultimate color stack game that combines precision, hoop sort strategy, and excitement in one addictive experience.

Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant stack color and dynamic hoop sort challenges as you test your skills and aim for high scores. Whether you’re a casual gamer or a competitive enthusiast, hoop stack offers endless fun and engagement.

title: New Year Balls Merge
description: ● A game with a New Year's atmosphere! Compete with friends and colleagues?! In the game you have a play area? where balls fall and connect if they have the same color! Connect as many balls as possible to make the biggest one, save up points?! Be the first on the leaderboard?! Play and relax ?!

title: Flower Collection
description: Flower Collection is a poetic casual adventure game where players explore a beautiful natural world to collect various rare and beautiful flowers. The game combines exploration, collection, and light puzzle elements to bring players a peaceful and delightful gaming experience.

title: Basketball Rush
description: This isn’t just about shooting — it's about precision, patience and strategy. As you score, the game intensifies, but with helpful power-ups at your disposal, you’ll be ready for anything. Unlock a variety of unique ball skins to customize your game and add even more excitement.

title: Math Wall Simulator
description: Combine brainpower and action in this math-based Roblox adventure! Solve equations to break through walls, collect coins, and unlock new challenges. Progress through 20 classes of increasing difficulty, from basic arithmetic to extreme math puzzles

title: Power Light
description: Move the tiles around until the power can flow freely to the light bulb. Power up the light bulb to complete each level in this fun online puzzle game

title: Mahjong Match Club
description: Select 2 identical mahjongs and eliminate them. After elimination, a green movable area will appear. Move a piece of mahjong until there is no obstruction in the horizontal or vertical direction. It is facing an identical mahjong. Let go and they will disappear automatically. You will gain points and enter the next level. . The game is a test of vision and strategy. Can you complete the challenge?

title: Race Clicker
description: Race Clicker is an action-packed idle clicker racing game that'll pump up your adrenaline. Customize, upgrade, and speed your way to victory. Each click pushes your limits, every upgrade unveils new possibilities, and each race dares you to click faster. Leave rivals in the dust and satisfy your need for speed with endless excitement. Start your engines and hit the track now!

title: Soccer Arena X
description: Soccer Arena X is an exciting football game that delivers dynamic matches, simple controls, and colorful arcade gameplay. Every match is fast, fun, and full of energy, giving you the ultimate multiplayer football experience. As you progress, you’ll collect coins and gems to unlock powerful abilities like freeze, lightning, super kick, or a giant head, adding a bright and entertaining arcade style to the gameplay. Step onto the pitch, score goals, and become a football star!

title: Drift Donut
description: Drift into action with this exhilarating 3D car drifting game! Master the art of drifting as you take control of a variety of cars and navigate through uniquely designed donut-shaped roads. The challenge is simple: click or tap to start drifting and keep your car on the road to earn points. With every donut road you clear, your score increases, challenging you to push your drifting skills to the limit.

title: Sandbox - Destroy the Ragdoll
description:
Ready to destroy and earn? In this sandbox clicker, it's simple: choose your weapon, attack characters, and get paid for the damage you deal. The stronger your attacks, the bigger the reward!  

Use different tactics, unlock new gear, and upgrade your firepower. The further you go, the more powerful the weapons and the greater the possibilities. Ready to become the strongest fighter? Then tap, destroy, and earn!

title: Pancake Tower 3D
description: Do you like delicious pancakes? You can add delicious fruits on top of the pancakes, such as strawberries, bananas, and blueberries! Try to stack your pancakes as high as possible! Then give the pancakes to your guests! Be careful of the traps and gluttons on the road!

title: Bubble Plopper
description: In Bubble Plopper you can either try to prevent the bubbles from filling the playfield in Classic mode or try to clear the playfield within the given time in Time attack mode. Shooting bubbles has never been so fun. Plop plop!

title: GT Cars Mega Ramps
description: Exotic cars, mega ramps, colorful giant bosses and face to face races all come together in this game. GT Cars Mega Ramps invites you to a fantastic driving experience with its completely unique game-play. Fly over mega ramps with your customized exotic car, destroy giant bosses or try to finish the stages first in face to face races!

title: Fashion Heroes Academy
description: Welcome to the Academy of Fashion Heroines, a place where style and superpowers go hand in hand! Three brave girls entered the academy in order not only to reveal their abilities, but also to create their own unique image. And you will help them in this. Choose outfits for studying, training and super battles. Experiment with makeup and accessories. Let each schoolgirl become a superhero and a style icon at the same time!

title: Mojo Match 3D
description: Discover the ultimate Match 3D experience in Mojo Match 3D! Dive into a world where colors collide and puzzles await at every turn.

title: Remove The Blocks
description: Challenging 3D puzzle game where you strategically clear the blocks from complex formations. Click blocks to slide them out in their facing direction, but choose wisely - each move affects the entire structure. With increasingly difficult levels, time-based scoring, and smooth 3D graphics, test your spatial reasoning skills!

title: Festival Vibes Makeup
description: Join Ellie in Festival Vibes Makeup, a vibrant game radiating the spirit of the summer festivals. Delight in creating neon, boho-Aztec, and grunge makeup looks as you test your makeup artist skills in this colorful makeup game for girls. Mix, match, and shine with stunning eyeshadows, mascaras, lipsticks, and glitter eyebrows!

title: Ice Cream Fever Cooking Game
description: In this frozen treat game, embark on a delightful journey through a world of creamy concoctions, toppings, and the most scrumptious sundaes you've ever dreamed of. If you're a fan of cooking games and have a soft spot for delectable desserts, "Ice Cream Fever" is the game you've been craving!

title: Barber Shop!
description: Your barber shop has opened! Help the guest to cut their ideal hairstyle! Be careful not to hurt customers by touching other places with the clipper!

title: Sudoku Master
description: Sudoku by in8finity is a classic puzzle game with a sleek dark theme, offering a smooth and enjoyable experience. Flexible settings let you adjust the difficulty to match your skill level. With intuitive controls and eye-friendly visuals, you can focus on solving puzzles without distractions. More than just a game, Sudoku trains logic, concentration, and memory. Challenge yourself and enjoy relaxing, distraction-free gameplay!

title: Adam and Eve Go Xmas
description: The new Christmas episode of Adam and Eve: GO is here! Help Adam and get in the Christmas spirit.

title: 3D Basketball.io Dunk Sport
description:
Sports Basketball is a thrilling 3D basketball game that will keep you entertained for hours. Whether you're a basketball fan or just love fast-paced Sports games Fun

Powered by R.bin Sarl Developer

title: Idle Supermarket Tycoon
description: Build and manage your dream shopping mall! Expand by adding new shops, upgrade interiors, serve customers, and boost your reputation. Invest wisely, assign priority shoppers, and earn extra income with delivery vehicles. Complete missions to unlock rewards!

title: Strawberry Shortcake
description: Strawberry Shortcake has big dreams. She wants to be the BEST baker that Big Apple City  has ever seen and that's why she packed her bags and went to live with her Aunt Praline to the only place where a baker can go if they want to become the best in the whole world: the BIG APPLE CITY!

title: Mini Obby War Game
description:
Manage your little character and see him through the never-ending conflict in Mini Obby War Game, an action-packed 3D game set in a Roblox environment.

With over ten unique and challenging levels, this amazing game is within your reach. Keep sprinting to avoid being caught by the waves of enemy troops who will shoot you if they see you, and aim and fire at all adversaries.

As you defeat enemies, you'll find coins that may be used to unlock additional characters with unique abilities.

title: Bolts and Nuts - Puzzle
description:
An educational and exciting game in which you can test your logical and strategic thinking.
Solve unique puzzles to while away the time and relax with excellent soundtrack. A bright and exciting game is perfect not only for children, but will also give you the opportunity to test your skills in solving difficult problems for adults.

title: Dream Room Makeover
description: Welcome to Dream Room Makeover, part of the beloved Room Makeover game! You've just purchased a charming old house with a sprawling garden, but it's in need of some TLC. Get ready to renovate with stunning graphics and fresh furniture. Your dream home awaits – play Dream Room Makeover for free today!

title: Find & Steal Brainrot: 67 Game
description: Find & Steal Brainrot: 67 Game is a chaotic puzzle hunt where you track a target brainrot through surreal, meme-soaked worlds. Each level pushes you to spot the same creature across dense, absurd scenes packed with icons like 67, Strawberry Elephant, Dragon Cannelloni, Spaghetti Tualetti, and La Supreme Combinasion. Fast-paced scanning, wild details, and pure internet nonsense create a frantic, high-energy experience for fans of intense spotting and brainrot chaos.

title: Merge the Coins USSR!
description: ● Game in an unusual setting! Compete with friends and colleagues?! In the game you have a playing area? where coins fall and are connected if they are the same! Connect as many coins as possible to make the biggest one, save up points?! Be the first on the leaderboard?! Play and relax ?!

title: Word Search Universe
description: Word Search Universe is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you search for hidden words in a grid. The game has 20 chapters, and each one comes with easy, medium, and hard levels to match your skill. In every level, you need to find 6 hidden words. If you get stuck, you can use a hint to help you out. It's a great way to have fun, improve your vocabulary, and keep your brain sharp!

title: Sleepy Princess Twins Birth
description: The sleepy princess is having twins! Call an ambulance and make sure the princess has enough water and oxygen while waiting. In order for her to also relax, call the prince before time runs out. Some cute kisses will help the future mommy for sure. Once you are at the hospital, you will meet the two cute babies. Take care of them by changing their diaper and feeding them. Soon the new family will be home, healthy and happy!

title: Merge Fruit Time
description: Drop fruits and stick them to the same fruit. Drop the fruit carefully so as not to fill the stage. Use bombs in a pinch! Can erase fruits in a certain area. Aim for a high score by attaching lots of fruits!

title: Highway Bus Rush
description: Welcome to the heart-pounding world of "Highway Bus Rush" – a game that propels you into an exhilarating journey along infinite highways. Brace yourself as you surge forward, navigating the ever-changing landscapes with precision and speed. The relentless pursuit of adrenaline awaits, as you weave through traffic and conquer challenging obstacles.

title: Math King - Math Skill Game
description:
Math King is the perfect game to help your kids to improve their Math skills in easy & fun way!
This game even helps you to develop calculation speed with high accuracy!

title: Drive-in Cinema: Idle Game
description: Drive-in Cinema: Idle Game lets you build your perfect movie theater and run a profitable business. Choose the best films to satisfy guests and increase income. Expand parking, open snack kiosks, automate processes, and hire employees to optimize operations. Complete over 50 missions, enjoy colorful 3D graphics, and immerse yourself in a unique atmosphere. Buy movies, prepare snacks, and grow your theater to attract more viewers. Ready to become the top drive-in owner?

title: Capybara Screw Jam
description: Welcome to Capybara Screw Jam! This is a cute and brain-teasing puzzle game. You’ll join a lovable capybara on a journey of problem-solving and strategy. With simple gameplay and increasing challenges, it’s the perfect game for anyone who loves casual puzzles and brain workouts. Your goal is to help the capybara solve various puzzle challenges. Each level presents various colors of capybara.

title: Funny Dentist Surgery
description: Leah has always had a sweet tooth. She loves candies, ate them a bunch, and end up with some horrible teeth problems now. Help fix her teeth problems. You can also decorate her teeth at the end with funny stickers!

title: Neon Dash: Cyber Run
description:
Neon Dash: Cyber Run is a high-speed endless runner set in a glowing cyber world.
Jump over deadly spikes, pass through portals to shift themes, and survive as
the game speed increases over time.

The game is designed for short, replayable sessions with instant restarts.
Perfect for both desktop and mobile players.

title: My Happy farm
description: Welcome to farm land game – the ultimate farming adventure that brings the beauty of rural life, the challenge of resource management, and the excitement of running your very own farm straight to your browser. The game is not just about clicking and waiting; it’s about strategy, timing, and smart decisions. Do you invest in farms first or focus on crops? Should you expand your land or upgrade your equipment? Every choice matters.

title: Color Nonogram Puzzle
description: Play Color Nonogram free online and uncover hidden pictures in a relaxing browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Solve each grid using logic clues in a satisfying logic puzzle that doubles as a focused brain game. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game made for calm thinking and colorful puzzle fun anytime.

title: Cycle Extreme
description:
Take part in a mountain bike downhill racing challenge. 

You control a bicycle rushing down from the mountains. Be careful - the track is very steep, and there are several obstacles and deadly holes ahead. Be careful and finish each of 20 levels as fast as you can to gain 3 stars!
1.0.16

title: Bang Bang Mahjong
description:
In Bang Bang Mahjong, we mix classic Mahjong with a sliding puzzle twist. It might seem simple at first, but as the levels get trickier, every move counts. Move the tiles around and match identical ones.

Power-ups like shuffle, remove, or hints can help when things get tough. With each completed level, the challenge grows—but so does the satisfaction of solving it. Who can master every puzzle and clear the board like a pro?

title: Eating Simulator
description:
Eating Simulator is a funny clicker game.
?GROW BY EATING! ?
?LEVEL UP AND UPGRADE BY SELLING YOUR FOOD ?
?Can you become the most substantial of them all??

title: BTS House Coloring Book
description: BTS House Coloring Book is an online game that you can play for free. In this coloring book that belongs to you, you can create your own color world. Choose any image you want to paint to fill it, then use the brush to choose the color you like. I believe that you can make a colorful and perfect painting. Enjoy this game and have fun!

title: Doggi
description:
The Doggi is Adventure with Hidden Objects and Puzzles. Easy controls, simple game mechanics. Play to kill time and relax. The game doesn't require a super force and ability. This game won't bring you to hell and make you sweat. The game has hints.
The game performs in the genre of finding hidden objects with puzzles. The game has nice hand-drawn graphics. The player needs to help a little dog named Doggi collect all the hidden bones.

title: Darts Master:Cartoon 3D
description: Dear dart experts and those who want to become dart experts. Please showcase your talents to the fullest on this thrilling dart journey. Collect and enrich your dart warehouse with the goal of overcoming all challenges. Experience the joy of different dart competitions.

title: Geometry Rush
description: Geometry Rush will take you to a world of challenging and treacherous platforming. Are you ready to run through trap-filled passages, jump and dodge death? Learn from your mistakes, perfect your reflexes, master the path without a single slip and advance to the next level.

title: Vice City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning sports car through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Dream Mania Happy Match
description: Ready to begin a fantastic match-3 puzzle adventure? Dream Mania - Happy Match is a fun puzzle game that you won't be able to stop playing. It's easy to play, yet the challenging level design. It's a casual game you don't want to miss! Match 3 or more identical items to clear the board and hit your level goals.

title: Math Master
description: Unleash your inner math whiz! Math Master turns numbers into art—solve fun math problems to unlock drawing tools, sketch colorful shapes, and bring numerical puzzles to life. Perfect for learners and creativity lovers alike!

title: Bento Match
description:
Slide the blocks to line them up straight and clear them!
If there’s space, you can move multiple blocks at once.
You can also move blocks without clearing them, but you’ll lose 1 life.
Earn coins based on your score and use them to collect new blocks!
Collected blocks will appear randomly in the game—rare blocks give higher scores!

title: Bubble Spin
description: Try to remove all of the bubbles

title: Mini Planet - Kids & Toddlers Educational Games
description:
An amazing planet full of various interesting and unique games and activities! Games that will help your kids learn lots of new things about different subjects while having fun!

Want to learn the English letters? Eager to learn about domestic and wild animals and even dinosaurs?! That’s nothing! In Happy Planet, there are lots of places that kids can go to and play fun games to learn new things about fruits, colors, vegetables, home appliances, mathematics, vehicles and etc.! 

This is just the beginning and we have lots of new features in mind that we will add gradually to the game!

title: Baby Hazel In Preschool
description: Today is Baby Hazel s first day at the preschool.  Baby Hazel is in a playful mood and not interested to go. Convince Baby Hazel and get her ready to go to the preschool.  When she is in the preschool with other kids, help them perform different activities by fulfilling their needs.

title: My Manga Avatar
description: Would you like to have your own manga avatar? In this fun new game you can create your own cool avatar, by exploring the options and choosing the features that represents you the most. You can play with shapes and colors in order to create the cutest face features and colorful, bold hair styles. Start by picking one of the characters and choose the eye, nose, mouth and eye brow shape. Make sure to chose a nice and expressive eye and lip color and when you are done add a nice skin tone before moving to the hair style. Your manga avatar would look great with pink or purple hair but pick the one you like the most. Make sure to create an expressive face with cute features, then move to the next part and dress up you lovely avatar. She can wear a glitzy pink top or a cool Mickey Mouse tank top. There are so many cool outfits so choose the one that represents you the most. Finally, you can select some nice accessories such as nerdy glasses, necklaces, headphones or shiny colorful bracelets. When you created the perfect avatar select a nice background and you are done. Don't forget to download your new avatar! Have fun playing this brand new My Manga Avatar game!

title: Sweet Candy Mania
description: Little Fluffy needs your help!  His family was captured after crash landing on the Candy Planet. Shoot and match colourful candies to progress further. Overcoming various obstacles to free them you will enter the tasty world of candy, chocolate and the goofy indinginous! Can you free all family members and collect all items needed to progress to the end?

title: Home Run Boy
description:
There is a boy who wants to become a home run king.
He's been practicing his batting and his dream is to hit the ball to the end of the world.
Hit the ball, build up your strength, and hit it farther and farther!

title: Playground- Parkour
description: Jump and break bones, destroy enemies and unlock new levels! Ragdoll physics is what you need for parkour lovers. Train, participate in the battle and upgrade your hero! You will enjoy the game if you are a lover of the playground and stick games. Run, jump and maim the heroes. Ragdoll-style physics is what you love. Deals damage and unlock new levels! Stick and Ragdoll fans will be happy.

title: Mahjong 3D Match
description: Welcome to the 3D Mahjong adventure! Challenge your mind with speed and precision. Plan your moves, view the board from all angles and remove pieces intelligently. Beat increasingly difficult levels, play offline and relax with immersive music.

title: Italian Brainrot: Puzzle & Battle
description:
You have many parts of the same picture. Drag and drop the parts and assemble the character picture.

A game about Italian animal characters. Each level is a new character.

Unlock them all!

title: Idle Egg Farmer
description: Step into the world of Idle Egg Farmer, a relaxing and rewarding farm simulation game where you hatch animals, collect eggs, and grow your farm empire! Start by clicking on an egg in the pen to hatch a new animal. These animals will continuously produce eggs over time, which are then collected by trucks and delivered for profit. The more animals you have, the more eggs you generate, leading to bigger earnings and endless expansion.

title: Hair Challenge
description: Do you want to have flowing waist-length hair? You could have longer hair in this game. What you need to do is just to keep walking and touch the buttons with the mark of plus one.

title: Puzzle Masters: Travelers
description:
Puzzle Masters Travelers is a relaxing and colorful jigsaw puzzle game where you assemble beautiful landscapes from dozens of pieces.
Travel across stunning locations around the world, unlock new sceneries, and enjoy the soothing atmosphere of discovery!
Use helpful boosters to finish each picture before the timer runs out. Challenge your focus, patience, and speed — and become a true puzzle master!

title: Ludo Play
description:
Old Classic Board game is back "Ludo Play". So like old times choose your color Red, Green, Blue and Yellow. 
Start getting into your own house. Enjoy!

title: Airplane Parking Mania 3D
description:
Become the best pilot and fly your own selected Airport plane to the parking destination.
Explore the World of airport airplanes and learn parking skills. Parking an huge plane is not so easy, face the difficulties of plane parking on the right slots. Use WASD or Arrows to drive and fly. Mouse to manage Throttle.

title: Trucktopolis Cooking Chaos
description: Ready for some cooking chaos? Hop into your food truck and serve delicious meals across New York, Italy, and South Korea! Cook tasty dishes, serve customers before they lose patience, and keep the orders flowing. Complete daily goals, unlock new recipes, upgrade your kitchen, and keep customers happy before time runs out. Can you handle the rush and become a world famous chef?!

title: Fruit Bubble Shooters
description:
This is a brand new and super addictive fruit bubble shoot game, once the start, there is no way to stop.
Aim and match fruit bubbles where you want to shoot them. Match 3 or more identical fruit bubbles.
Use less shots to complete a level and try to earn full stars on every level.

title: Mermaid Wonders Hidden Object
description: Find hidden objects in the beautiful world of Mermaid! Featuring gorgeous hand-painted scenes from world-class artist: Robert-YKG, this game will walk you through mesmerizing world of the Mermaids!

title: Cyberpunk City Fashion
description: Belle, Ariel, Moana, and Elsa are willing to give up their stunning princess dress and have the full cyberpunk experience in this online dress-up game for girls. Surrounded by futuristic neon lights, the royal BFFs wait for you to join the fun and help them decide on the winning looks. Are you ready to join them in the Cyberpunk City Fashion game?

title: Sort Game Toy Sort
description: Enjoy some adorable sorting fun in Sort Game: Toy Sort. This delightful match 3 puzzle and casual sort game challenges you to organize colorful dolls and toys. Match and eliminate all dolls within the limited time. When you encounter difficulties, use items to help you quickly clear the level. Such as Convert, Eliminate, Refresh or Break.

title: Royal Kitchen: The Lost King
description:
In a lost kingdom, disaster has struck! During a knight’s tournament, a mysterious figure in a black cloak suddenly appears. The stranger casts a spell on the king, causing him to vanish without a trace right before everyone’s eyes!

The princess manages to escape from the castle, but where should she go now? How can she save her father and the entire kingdom? Will she be able to overcome all the challenges, find her father, and defeat the evil wizard?

title: Hit Knock Down
description: Hit & Knock Down is a fun casual game where you aim to throw baseballs. Shoot as many targets as possible. Test your precision, reaction speed, and throwing skills. You aim to hit the right targets in each level. The goals at the level are very varied, such as wood, stone, etc. Each level presents different targets. You should hit with a baseball.

title: Practice On Me
description: Get ready for a glamorous summer adventure with Practice On Me, the ultimate makeup game! Transform into a festival goddess, beach babe, or blooming flower child in three exciting themed units. Grab your brushes, swipe on lipstick, and let your inner artist shine. Dance at festivals, relax by the beach or embrace nature's beauty. With Practice On Me, the possibilities are endless. Make waves, channel your inner mermaid, and bloom like a flower. Experience a summer adventure like no other!

title: Monsterella Fantasy Makeup
description: Step into the monstrous world of beauty with "Monsterella Fantasy Makeup". This spookily engaging game lets you work your makeover magic on three iconic cartoon characters. In Frankie's unit, electrify her look with eerie eyeshadows, neon lipstick, shockingly cool hairstyles, and otherworldly outfits. Next, embrace Clawdeen's earthy mystique with jewel-toned makeup and howl-inducing wardrobe choices. Finally, express Draculaura's vamp chic vibe with dramatic makeup and goth-glam ensembles.

title: Snake King
description: Get ready to slither your way to the top in this addictive take on the classic Snake game! As the Snake King, you’ll navigate through a maze-like arena, avoiding collisions with the four walls and your own tail.

title: Chess Duel
description: Master the art of chess with three exciting modes, each offering flexible time settings to suit every player. Take your chess skills to the next level, climb the ranks from Bronze to Diamond and strive to become a top chess player.

title: Numberz!
description: Enjoy a math puzzle game for all players. The 2-player game can help kids and adults learn to count fast, as you try to solve the brainteaser quicker than your opponent. Highlight the chain of digits to make the required number, and thus paint the tiles white. Join great mathematical adventure and train your logic with the progressively challenging Math puzzles!

title: Guess it
description: Guess it is an addictive word game where you have to guess the hidden word. Based on short clues, guess the letters and their positions. Uncover mysterious words and earn points using your creativity and logical thinking. Can you solve the puzzle and beat your best scores?

title: Solitaire Klondike - Treasure Island
description:
Set sail on a thrilling pirate adventure! Explore mysterious islands, uncover hidden treasures, and help a fearless heroine escape ruthless villains.
Customize your experience with beautifully illustrated card decks, stunning animations, and magical boosters to tackle challenges.
Relax between games with mesmerizing music and lively animated characters. Dive into a world of adventure, mystery, and enchantment!

title: DOP 2 Delete One Part
description: DOP 2: Delete One Part is a fabulous puzzle game. Are you seeking ways to help your children devolop their thinking ability and improve their intelligence? This game might do you a favor.

title: Hexa Tile Trio
description: Welcome to Hexa Tile Trio! Your goal is to clear the board by sorting hex tiles into groups of three. Tap a tile to move it to an empty or matching spot below. If no tiles fit, or you run out of space, the level fails. With a ticking clock and unique  puzzles, can you master the hex tiles before time runs out?

title: Cinema Business - Idle Games
description:
Build and manage your own cinema empire! 
Unlock movie rooms, snack and burger corners to attract more customers.
Hire staff, upgrade facilities, and keep your theater running smoothly.
Earn cash even while you’re offline and grow your business.
Become the ultimate cinema tycoon in this fun idle arcade game!

title: Looper
description:
Looper is a joyous and melodious music game that tests your sense of rhythm and timing. Get ready to start tapping your way through a colorful universe of beats and melodies! With hundreds of unique levels, Looper is the perfect game to soothe your puzzling needs.

As you progress, the constellations become more complex, and the beats more satisfying. But be warned, mistiming a tap could lead to an epic crash and burn - so make sure to bring your A-game!

title: Airport Simulator Plane Tycoon
description: Want a fun airport management experience in the Airport Simulator: Plane Tycoon? You're in charge of your bustling airport! Always dreamed of building and running your international airport? Now's your chance in this exciting and highly addictive management game! You will build your airport kingdom from scratch.

title: Fruit Block Tetra Puzzle
description: Fruit Block Tetra Puzzle is a fast and fun block puzzle game where you place fruit-shaped blocks to clear lines and collect target fruits before time runs out. Complete each fruit goal to level up and unlock new challenges. Easy to play, satisfying to master, and perfect for quick, brain-boosting fun!

title: Goods Sorting Shopping Master
description: In Goods Sorting Shopping Master, you organize messy goods by moving and matching them into neat groups. It’s a fun puzzle game that combines smart thinking with relaxing gameplay. In the game, you’ll face shelves filled with mixed goods such as drinks, snacks, and daily items. Match and sort three identical items to clear the space and proceed, based on the customer's needs. Manage space carefully to keep sorting.

Baby Adopter is a babysitting, nursery and dress up game for people who love to take care of little babies.

Adopt and feed a cute little baby! Earn points by feeding the child, taking care, hunting for eggs and playing mini games. Spend points by buying items for game locations (the Baby Room, Bathroom, Playground, Playroom, Family Room, Game Center, Music Room, etc) and toys.

 Swipe on the items of the same type to destroy them and unlock all levels.
 Try to remove all casket and make the bats and ghost fall to the bottom row.
 Complete all the requirements within the given move and time.

 See how far you can get. Play NOW!

 Features:
 * cute characters: Moon, Pumpkin, Candies, Witch hat, bat, ghost and casket.
 * cool design and animation
 * perfect graphics and effects
 * entertaining background music and sound effects
 * challenging levels
