title: Bubble Shooter Online
description:
Play the classic and most addictive bubble pop game for FREE, match 3 colors and clear levels.
When you start Bubble Shooter, you’ll notice many bubbles on your screen ready for you to pop them! You’ll have a bubble cannon at the bottom end of the screen with a colored bubble. The goal of Bubble Shooter is to make all of the bubbles on your screen disappear! The way to do this is to get three bubbles of the same color to touch.

Use your mouse to move the Bubble Shooter in a given direction in order to shoot the right bubble into the desired spot!

title: Lick Them all
description: Can you do the right reflection in speed moving? Lick Them all is a challenge game to test this skill. It is also easy to control, just need to hold and release your finger at the right time. Lick all things except for the dangerous ones, such as avoiding poop, ice, hot spice, and so on. Oh, it's really not easy as it looks. Are you ready to challenge?

title: Cosmo Pet Starry Care
description: Immerse yourself in the wonderful world of space and get to know cute alien creatures better. Choose your pet and find out how best to take care of them. Feed, walk and play with your space friends to give them happiness and care. Support your pets so that they please you with their devotion and love.

title: Kitty Lunchbox
description: Join Hello Kitty in the school cafeteria to choose what scrumptious lunch to prepare. If you make your recipe just the way Hello Kitty wants, she’ll give you supercute rewards to decorate your lunchbox and make it extra special!

title: Backflip Parkour
description: Become a real trickster in our new simulator of parkour madness Backflip Parkour! Have you ever wanted to perform crazy tricks? In our simulator, you can perform flips and backflips. Jumps from heights are not hard if you are playing our parkour madness simulator. Perform jumps from heights and make flips and backflips. You can learn basics of parkour mania in our jumps madness simulator.

title: Find the Differences Winter
description: In the game Find the Differences Winter, you will partially disconnect from the hero, having visited several locations and met terrible toys that have come to life and become dangerous. Your task in this game is to find the differences within the allotted time. A game that is fun and educational because it will help you improve your observation and concentration skills. You have 20 levels, each level with 7 differences with a set time to complete it.

title: Happy Fruit Link
description: Enjoy a fun and relaxing puzzle adventure in Happy Fruit Link! Match two identical fruit tiles and connect them with a line that can turn up to two times. Clear all tiles, solve challenging puzzles, and test your brain through exciting levels. With colorful graphics and smooth gameplay.

title: Pop Star
description: Ready to relax, think, and have fun all at once? In Star Pop Mania, the rules are simple, but the satisfaction is endless. Tap two or more matching blocks to pop them and clear the board. The bigger the combo, the higher the score—and the more rewarding it feels!

title: Sweet Candy Saga
description: Sweet Candy Saga is a HTML5 match-3 type game, match-3 is a popular type of casual puzzle game. The objective of Sweet Candy Saga is to swap one candy with another candy on a horizontal or vertical chain of three or more candy of the same color.

title: Cooking World Reborn
description:
The goal of the game is to go all the way from a small food truck to a large cafe in the center of the airport.

What awaits you:

- More than 50 large levels

- Various improvements to kitchen equipment

- Several game modes

title: Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY
description:
Style Anna’s outfits and bring her fairy tale story to life!

Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY takes you into a magical world of creativity and fashion! In this charming paper doll game, you’ll help Anna dress up for a variety of occasions, from costume parties and romantic dates to festive holidays like Halloween and Christmas.

title: Foosball
description:
Foosball is a HTML5 Sport Game.
Play against the CPU or challenge your friend and score the greatest number of goals!
Two game’s mode: Scrimmage and Championship!
Let’s get this match started!

title: Super Doll Skin Doctor
description: Go to the doctor with this superhero doll and make sure she gets the right treatment for her skin problems! Discover all the amazing tools that you can use, there are lasers, tweezers and all sort of things that help you get rid of the rashes. Make super doll's skin flawless again and she will be ready for new adventures!

title: Fun Coloring Book
description: Kids love painting and drawing and that’s why coloring books were always popular among kids. Our coloring book includes 16 different images of characters, vehicles and etc. that kids can choose from and color it as they like. There are 24 colors and 9 pencil sizes that they can use. There is also an eraser than can be used for erasing the colors and correcting mistakes. After they are done with painting, they can use the print button to save the colored image and show it to their friends!

title: Path Finding Cakes Match
description: Move the items to the blank spaces in order to create a horizontal or vertical row of 3 identical items. Use as less moves as possible for more score. To move just tap the item and then tap the location you want it to move. If there is any open path between the item and its destination, it would travel to the new place. Apart from making set of 3 identical items, you will get extra time bonus, if you complete the game early.

title: Foot Hospital
description: Foot Hospital is fun addictive hyper casual girls game... Hey Doctor, I hurt my feet and it is so painful! Could you please help me to treat my feet? I know you have the best medical tools in town! Treat each person's feet! Finally, complete the task by treating the nails! Patients trust you...

title: Minecraft Battle Party
description: Ready for a hot feast of square battles? In Minecraft Battle Party, you'll enter a pixel-styled battle arena where nervous fighting meets iconic Minecraft-style visuals. In this world, every game is a duel to the death. You will play different roles and use different weapons. For example, as a gunner, constantly move your character so that enemies are shot within your scanning range. Watch out for other people's attacks.

title: Color Match 3D
description: Color Match 3D is a very fun online puzzle game for boys for free. You can paint anytime and anywhere. According to the target item, just mix colors in the palette, paint a 3D model, and compare your mixed colors with the target to decide your grade. Finally, your designed items will be auctioned according to their quality, or displayed in your orchard. I guess it's easy for you. Are you ready to try it now?

title: Planet Takeover
description: take command of your interstellar empire and set out to conquer the entire galaxy! Forge strategic alliances that can be either your greatest asset or, under the cover of darkness.

title: Football Superstars 2024
description: Kick off your football career and rise to stardom. Test your skills in a friendly match, or jump right in and lead your dream team in the World tournament against international teams. Remember, no one ever drowned in sweat!

title: Guess The Italian Brainrot Animals
description: Get ready for a wild and hilarious ride with Guess the Italian Brainrot Animals, a fast-paced, emoji-fueled trivia game that tests your knowledge of 64 iconic Italian Brainrot characters! From the most famous to the obscure, this game challenges you to guess the correct character based on three emoji clues before the timer runs out. Think you’re a Brainrot expert? Prove it!

title: Spooky Sort It
description: Spooky Sort It! is a mind-sharpening brain puzzle that challenges you to sort a variety of haunting balls into the right tubes. As you tackle these spectral twists and turns, you'll not only enhance your problem-solving skills but also find a delightful way to cope with stress and refresh your mind in the captivating world of spectral sorting.

title: Winter Connect
description: Winter connect is a fun to play tile connect game. You need to connect two identical tiles. The Connecting Line between two matching blocks can have only two turns. Make connections between the matching tiles while you fight to keep up with the clock. Can you clear the board before time runs out?

title: Xmas Bubble Shooter
description: It is a classical bubble shooter game with Xmas theme and 36 challenging levels.  In each level you will find a different challenge. To complete a level you must eliminate all the lights from the screen. The lights will be eliminated when the light shot by you combines with a group of 3 or more than 3 lights of same color. You must complete a level within allowed time. You will get better score if you complete the level early.

title: Hero Fight Clash
description: A thrilling adventure, hearty duel, don't you want to play a horizontal fighting game like Hero Fight Clash? Various cool skills, choose your favorite hero, keep adventuring, keep upgrading, and defeat more powerful enemies.

title: Letters Match
description: Letters Match combines the best of the games you love. This is a mixture of matching games, word search and clearing the playing field. We took all these ingredients and spiced it up with exciting gameplay. If you like to stretch your brain with puzzles, then Letters Match is what you need!

title: Gorilla Adventure
description:
Gorilla Adventure immerses players in an open-world, action-adventure platform game that unfolds within a nocturnal cityscape. In this game, the future's technological advancements have precipitated the downfall of the natural world, plunging players into a mysterious and eerie electronic realm. 

Embark on this journey and master the art of hammer swinging to set new records. Embrace the fury of Gorilla and get ready for an exhilarating climb to the top!

title: Asteroid Shield: Tile-Matching Space Defense
description: Asteroid Defens is a clever puzzle game that combines match-3 mechanics with the addictive gameplay of defending a spaceship. Don't let the asteroids get to your spaceship by building your defenses with tactical tile-matching solutions.

title: Zooma Dragon
description:
Zooma Dragon is a brand new and amazing zoom style game!
Complete all 300 levels! Try to get three stars in each level!
A bright adventure with colored balls awaits you!
Instead of a frog, you will play as a dragon.

title: The Road Home: Granny Escape
description: Step into the chilling world of The Road Home: Granny Escape, a horror escape room experience where every shadow hides danger. Solve puzzles, collect items, and find a way out while being relentlessly hunted by Granny and Grandpa. Use stealth, strategy, and courage to survive this terrifying challenge and make your way to freedom.

title: Mystic Object Hunt
description: Welcome to 'Mystic Object Hunt,' a fifteen-level Hidden Object game. Explore ancient realms, discover hidden artifacts, and unravel secrets in dim chambers and ruins. Sharpen your skills, overcome challenges, and delve into the mysteries within each location. Get ready for a thrilling hunt!

title: Jinn Dash
description: Dive into a desert adventure in this arcade game! Similar to the classic Arkanoid, your mission is to break all the bricks using a magic carpet.

title: My Pet Care Salon
description: My Pet Care Salon invites you to run your very own pet spa! Groom, pamper, and style a variety of adorable pets with fun, interactive activities. From bath time and nail trimming to trendy haircuts and accessory styling, provide the best care for your furry clients. Manage your salon, meet different pets, and earn rewards as you create a welcoming environment for pets and their owners. Transform your pet care dreams into reality and become the ultimate pet stylist!

title: Cool Archer
description:
Aim for the target and show your archery skills in this beautiful 3D archery challenge.

Time and adjust your archer shots to land a bullseye and get bigger points.

Your skills will be tested with harder challenges over time like moving boards and stronger winds.

Master the game and become the bowmaster.

title: Rope Rescue! - Unique Puzzle
description: Rope Rescue is a puzzle game with simple controls but a challenging twist. Strategize to save everyone using ropes while dodging tricky traps and obstacles. Stay sharp to overcome each level and claim exciting rewards. With its easy-to-learn mechanics and increasingly complex challenges, this game will keep you hooked as you perfect your rescue skills!

title: Love and Treasure Quest
description: If you are looking for some fun and addictive type of game like PULL THE PIN & Grandscapes, then Love and Treasure Quest is one of the best choice for you. Get ready for an adventure as a knight as he seek his way to obtain treasure and save the Princess that he love.Test your skills as you figure out puzzles. Find out how you can get the treasure and avoid it from melting. See how you can defeat the enemy as you try to achieve your mission. Figure out which arrows needs to be removed and what sequence. Be careful with the spikes, boulder and poison gas. These obstacles can kill Monster, Hero or Princess.Have fun with more than 100 levels with unlimited lives. Try to earn as many coins as you can so that you can build our own castle.This game will surely test your problem-solving skills, pattern recognition and other cognitive skills. But most importantly, this game will surely give you lots of fun excitement. With its perfect match of music, effects and design, this game is something you wouldn’t want to miss. So grab a seat and start to play. You can also solve it with your family and friends.

title: Adventure of Flig
description: Fun airhockey with shooting and multiplayer for 2 players on one device! Adventures of Flig is an interesting story that combines three games in one - air hockey, runner and maze!

title: Mini Golf Battle
description: Mini Golf Battle is a casual sports puzzle where precision and timing decide the outcome. Your task is to sink the ball into the hole with the fewest strokes possible while navigating ramps, walls, and tricky obstacles. Special power-ups like Fire, Wing, and Spring shots add variety, letting you approach each course with unique strategies. Whether for short play sessions or longer runs, Mini Golf Battle delivers an engaging mix of relaxation and skillful play.

title: Back 2 School Makeover
description: Embrace the nostalgia and dive into our Back 2 School Makeover game, where you can fashionably express yourself, experiment with stunning looks, and relish into the feeling of heading back to school with style! Embark on a fabulous journey with our character, Amelia, as she transforms from an edgy e-girl to a chic, school-ready fashionista. Revamp her entire look starting with a haircare routine and a new haircut, a complete skincare routine, and a new, school makeup.

title: Baby Hazel Christmas Time
description: Merry Christmas everyone! Today, Baby Hazel is celebrating Christmas along with her friends, Bella & Liam, along with Honey Bonny and Katy, the cute little cat. She is eagerly waiting for Santa and very excited about what she is going to receive in presents. So she wants to complete all Christmas preparations as soon as possible. She has to pack gifts, make snowman and ride on snowboard, play snow fight and many more. Enjoy Christmas night along with Baby Hazel & her friends.

title: Stickman Shooter Bros
description:
Stickman Shooter Bros
Ready for action? Choose one of your 3 stickman characters with different powers and defeat your enemies with 4 different weapons.
Melt your enemies with the lava gun, destroy them with the minigun, deal damage from close range with the shotgun, and stun them with the teslagun.
Strong enemies, challenging bosses, and exciting levels await you.
Stickman Shooters is an immersive top-down shooter game.

description: Anaconda Runner is a casual arcade game. In the snake kingdom, size is a status symbol. The bigger you are, the more powerful you are and the higher your status. description: Besties Chinese New Year Celebration invites you into a joyful world of color, tradition, and friendship as you help best friends prepare for the Lunar New Year. Are you good at driving? This HD game will surely give you the thrills and excitement.
This game has Nerve Racking and Breathtaking obstacles and challenges, Then let's see what you got on passing through extreme obstacles.

description: Step into the world of Thanksgiving Squad Style! Explore a fusion of cozy elegance and festive fashion as the squad celebrates the season. From warm layers to stylish accents, discover the perfect ensemble to make this Thanksgiving unforgettable. Join the squad and embrace the spirit of gratitude and style! Play and have fun!

description: Begin a fun 3D cat simulator adventure in the Cat Chaos Simulator. As a mischievous cat, chaos occurs in various scenes. Such as houses, parks and so on. Knocking over things, or messing with humans. Use strategy, quick thinking, and precise shots to create huge combos. If the board gets filled, watch a reward ad to remove the last 3 lines of bubbles, or stop the timer and continue playing in relaxing mode.

description: If you're still seeking inspiration for your upcoming Valentine's Day look, then look no further Our social media influencers bring a selection of super sweet makeup looks that are going to impress your Valentine tonight. In the Valentine's Makeup Trends game for girls, you can discover the secrets of a sophisticated fantasy makeup look in candy colors. Play today and have fun!

description: The joyful Easter holiday is approaching. Join cute girls for Easter fun. Try to find all the Easter eggs. Choose outfits for girls that are suitable for the theme of the holiday. Don't forget about funny bags and hats with rabbit ears. Have fun with your friends by playing «Easter Rabbit Style»!

title: Square Punki Long Hand
description: Ever wondered what life would be like with super long arms? In Square Punki Long Hand, you get to experience just that! This unique puzzle game challenges you to stretch, grab, prank, and solve hilarious puzzles using your extra-long limbs. Whether you're rescuing trapped characters, reaching impossible places, or pulling off mischievous tricks, every level is filled with surprises and laughter!

Move the snow ball left or right and avoid pine trees.

The snowball grows bigger over time!

Beautiful Christmas winter theme with pine trees and challenging gameplay

title: Rings Master

Spin the rings, solve riddles
Embark on a fascinating journey of wit and strategy! Immerse yourself in a world of intricate puzzles and ever-changing challenges, where the key to success lies in your ability to manipulate rings and solve riddles!

title: Funny Nose Surgery
description: Mia has always had a snotty nose. But now it has been gone too far, and she need to clean it. Help fix her nose problems, maybe with some surgery. You can also put stickers on her nose after that!

title: Santa Go
description:
Santa Go is a cozy Christmas puzzle game where you help Santa reach his sleigh!
Draw a line for Santa to slide along and watch him glide under a cheerful holiday melody.
Be careful — with each level, more obstacles appear, and they can easily knock Santa down.
Your goal is to guide him into the sleigh and keep him there for 3 seconds to complete the level!

title: Brawl Stars Battle
description: Brawl Stars Battle is an exciting action shooting game where you control powerful heroes armed with guns and special abilities to defeat opponents in fast-paced combat! Select 3v3 battle mode and fight alongside your teammates. The team that kills fifteen opponents first wins. Use guns and powerful abilities in intense battles.

description: Yarn untangled is a cute puzzle game with unlimited levels. Can you untangle all the yarns? The kitties are ready to accompany you to solve all the levels.

description:
Match identical tiles in groups to clear the playing field in this music-themed puzzle game. Let the light of the super troupers shine on your performance as you unblock and match the tiles together.
Try the Rehearsal game mode for free play or unlock your inner music maestro and match the tiles to the beat of the music in the Concert game mode.

title: Cat Pancake Diner
description: Run your own pancake diner full of adorable cats! Serve hungry customers, manage your feline staff and expand your diner across multiple cozy locations. Flip pancakes and build your breakfast empire in this charming 3D simulation game.

MadBurger – it is great fun launcher! Cook the burger, get good recipes, buy the ingredients and new skills and kicks it as far as possible!

Refresh your available hero choices, drag units into open defense slots, and start each wave when you are ready. Hold the path, manage the base HP, and stop every attack before the fortress falls.

title: Thief Stick Puzzle Man Escape
description: Enjoy a hilarious and brain-twisting adventure in Thief Stick Puzzle: Man Escape. It’s a mix of stickman comedy, clever puzzle levels, and funny escape challenges that will keep you hooked for hours! You play as a sneaky thief stickman trying to escape from tricky situations. To survive, you’ll need to solve smart brain teaser puzzles. For example, finding the correct path through a maze to obtain treasure, or bypassing a cutting machine to save a puppy.

title: Fruit Goals Match
description: Fruit Goals Match is a fun and strategic fruit-matching  puzzle game where you collect specific fruits to complete each mission within limited moves. Every level brings a new challenge, rewards smart planning, and keeps the gameplay endless. Earn extra moves through reward ads and see how far you can progress.

title: Obby Prison Run
description: Obby Prison Run is an intense obstacle course game where escape is the only option—and survival is everything. Sprint, leap, and dodge through deadly traps and twisted takes on classic childhood games. Outsmart your rivals and stay ahead in the race for freedom, where every second counts and only the sharpest make it out alive.

Words will pop up on the screen, and your job is to type them as fast and accurately as you can. It's all about beating your own records and challenging your friends for bragging rights

Transform into a wild animal and train to become the fastest and strongest in "Robbie: Become a Beast"!

Match at least 3 candy of the same color to remove them from the field. Make combinations of 4 or more fish to create powerful tiles which explode areas on the board. Try to clear all levels with 3 stars and earn as many points as you can!

title: Sweet Dessert Hole
description: Ready to make cute and tasty desserts? In Sweet Dessert Hole, you control a hole that sucks up various sweet toppings. Move the hole around to collect chocolate, cream, fruits, cookies, dan many more. Collect everything on the base before time runs out. Use your coins to upgrade the hole and make the gameplay faster and easier. After making one or more cakes, you can arrange them neatly on a tray. This game is simple, relaxing, and very satisfying to play.

title: Dress Up Game Fashion Stylist
description: This amazing stylist fashion show dress up and makeover games for girls has gorgeous outfits for having looks of supermodel of dress games. You can turn you look into superstar bridal in fashion show makeover and dress up offline with levels.

title: Wreck The Tower
description: Take control of a powerful tank and unleash destruction in Wreck The Tower, an explosive demolition game where precision and power determine your success! Your mission is simple: demolish buildings by firing your tank’s bullets repeatedly until the structure collapses. But be careful not to hit the moving walls. If you hit them, your bullet will ricochet back toward you, adding an extra challenge to your aim.

title: City Bike Racing Champion
description: Let's ride some bikes in the Champions City with cool bikes against other riders or with your friend in the 2-player game mode in the City Bike Racing Champion game! Lots of bikes, bags, helmets, costumes, and many other customization options await you. Play either single or 2-player and have some fun in Champions City. Participate in races or ride on the huge free map and do some stunts. Let's ride!

That's why you have to make more strategic drawings. You can unlock new and more powerful cars with the coins you earn after the missions. This is a puzzle game. you can make a way to pass a level. Dig your way through unique physics puzzles.

It's new and fun brain teasers each step of the way.

Test your vocabulary and puzzle-solving skills with Daily Wordler, the ultimate word-guessing game that challenges your mind every day! With a simple yet addictive gameplay mechanic, Daily Wordler is perfect for fans of word games and brain teasers. 

Your goal is to guess the hidden word by entering valid words and using color-coded feedback to narrow down the solution. Yellow tiles indicate correct letters in the wrong position, while blue tiles signal correct letters in the right spot.

title: Brain puzzles-Quests
description: This is the puzzle game filled with challenging, interesting tasks that will help you relax and have fun. There are games for training thinking, mental tasks, and IQ tests suitable for those who like to think. Develop logic, pump your brains!

title: Spot The Patterns
description:
A good cognitive training game. Predict the next object based on the previous pattern.

Features:

- Hint system
- 3 different levels. Easy, Medium and Hard
- Fun and vibrant theme which encourages learning

This game is perfect for schools, preschool, families and even seniors.

Complete rows or columns to gather Elixirs. If the grid fills up with remaining Elixirs, it's game over. With 60 levels, master the art of alchemy in this addictive adventure!

description: Select your team and score more goals than your opponent to become the champion! Choose between single-player tournament mode (against AI) or challenge a friend in 2-player mode. Multiplayer mode is available only on mobile devices.

? BUILD YOUR DREAM SPA EMPIRE

Bouncing Balls is a HTML5 Skill Game.
Launch the ball and break as many blocks as possible before they reach the floor!
Collect extra balls bonus and make an endless balls chain!

description: Layers upon layers of dice await your skillful touch. Some puzzles ask you to think. This one dares you to see the whole picture. Flip, rotate and reveal new tiles as you uncover unexpected paths. Boosters lend a hand, but the strategy is all yours.

title: Dragon Year Jigsaw
description: Dive into the lively universe of 'Dragon Year Jigsaw,' a comical online puzzle game set in the Chinese Dragon Year. Solve 24 levels of dragon-themed jigsaw puzzles, featuring vibrant and playful comic art. Perfect for puzzle lovers and those seeking a whimsical online experience. Join the fun – start piecing together your dragon adventure now!

description: These two wonderful superheroes are best friends and they are used to doing all sort of fun activities together. Soon both of them will become mommies and they need to go through one last check up. Join them to the doctor and see if everything is going well with them and the babies. Learn how to use all the medical tools and then get ready for some fun activities like preparing healthy smoothies a

title: Spacebar Clicker
description: Set out on an epic cosmic adventure in Spacebar Clicker! Click your way through the space, gather light years, and recruit aliens to supercharge your journey. Unlock awesome rewards and aim for that cosmic jump to the next galaxy. Can you collect enough light years to uncover the secrets of the universe?

title: Princess Run 3D
description: Want a magical and exciting running adventure? Step into Princess Run 3D, a fun 3D platform arcade game full of exciting challenges. Play as a fearless princess racing through colorful 3D worlds. Collect beautiful clothes, shoes, hair, etc. Increase your charisma to get a maid of honor. They're going to help you fend off enemies in front of you or dirty mud, rain, etc. Be careful to avoid ugly clothes, costumes, bad weather, etc.

title: Car Eats Car: Winter Adventure
description: Up for a fight against rivals in a dynamic race on the highway? Overtake enemies and create your own car in the incubator in Car Eats Car: Winter Adventure! Your friends are put to prison - do everything you can to free evil cars! Good driving skills and turbo speed come in handy in this crazy driving simulator and a police chase game. Become a car tycoon, upgrade cars, and play for monster cars against the cops! Fight the boss to survive in these ultimate crazy races!

title: Cat From Hell Cat Simulator
description: Become the troublemaking cat in Cat From Hell - Cat Simulator. Run wild inside Granny’s house, knocking things over and making a mess, such as breaking plates, throwing balls, smashing fish tanks, etc. Escape before she catches you. Explore, prank, and cause chaos in this hilarious and mischievous cat simulator. Every corner hides a secret that can be destroyed, and discover new challenges.

title: Halloween Mazes
description: Halloween Mazes is a thrilling puzzle game with twists and turns. Race against the clock to find a path from the entrance to the exit before time runs out. Can you solve 12 puzzles and emerge victorious? Give it your best shot!

title: Idle Evolution From Cell to Human
description: A simulator of the evolution and origin of all life on the planet. You can trace the entire path of life development from the cell and the first living organism to the whole person! Follow the process of formation from the cell to the body.

title: One HERO
description:
One Hero: Dive into the ultimate action-packed shooting game! Play as a lone hero, dodging and shooting your way through waves of enemies. Eliminate all foes to claim victory. Are you ready to be the last one standing?
Dive into a thrilling, action-packed adventure where you’ll face waves of enemies and intense boss battles.
With intuitive controls and accessible gameplay, players of all skill levels can jump in and start unleashing chaos in no time.

title: Pizza Maker - Cooking Games For Kids
description: Become a pizza master by creating delicious pizzas from scratch with 15 unique recipes. Choose ingredients, slice vegetables, shred cheese, and prepare toppings. Knead and roll the dough, spread the sauce, add toppings, and bake. Once ready, box your pizza for delivery! Fun, engaging, and perfect for kids to develop cooking skills.

title: My Little Car Wash
description: Wash and shine with My Little Car Wash, a 2D cartoon game that lets you clean different vehicles. You don’t need any experience, just follow the hints and use the tools to make the vehicles look new. You will have 22 vehicles to choose from, each with its dirt and stains. You will also have the drivers watching you as you work, so be quick and efficient. You will earn yellow stars for each vehicle you wash. My Little Car Wash is a game that will teach you some washing skills! Have fun!

title: Ballbeez
description:
Welcome to the colorful, relaxing and satisfying world of ballbeez.

Throw colorful ballbeez into cups, watch them grow with water and try to reach the top line. But watch out, they should stay inside the cup.

title: BTS Animals Coloring Book
description: BTS Animals Coloring Book is an online game that you can play for free. In this coloring book that belongs to you, you can create your own color world. Choose any image you want to paint to fill it, then use the brush to choose the color you like. I believe that you can make a colorful and perfect painting. Enjoy this game and have fun!

title: My Pocket Blacksmith
description:
My Pocket Blacksmith is a medieval fantasy blacksmithing rhythm game for mobile devices and web platforms. It is a combination of Deemo II and Friday Night Funkin’ game mechanics, the epic atmosphere of classic RPG games, and abstract humor straight from Discworld.

• Forge to the melody rhythm and create legendary items! 
• Short game sessions (30 seconds) combined with visible game progress. 
• Decorations to change hero appearance and the player’s workshop.

title: Tricky Challenges: Mini Games
description:
Only 5% will pass all the Challenges! Ready to test your reactions and wit? Take the challenge and prove that you are better than thousands of bloggers!

✨ "Tricky Challenges: Mini Games" is a unique game that combines popular challenges from TipTop and puzzle elements.

title: Banana Farm
description: Embark on Banana Farm, an engaging business casual game catering to cat enthusiasts. As a diligent feline entrepreneur, oversee market operations and recruit adorable cat workers to enhance efficiency. Cultivate bananas and various products while serving charming cat customers eagerly queuing up. Ready to launch your supermarket?

title: Clash Rider - Clicker Tycoon
description: Join the journey through the epochs! Collect and upgrade your vehicle. Dozens of epochs, characters and opponents from dinosaurs to high-speed wheelbarrows of different factions are waiting! Go through the entire evolution of the world.

title: Mojo Emoji
description: Moji Emoji is a fun and clever word/emoji puzzle game where each level challenges you to guess the hidden word or phrase from a set of expressive emojis. Think fast, connect the clues, and test your emoji decoding skills across hundreds of creative puzzles.

title: 10K
description: You start with 10,000 points and a blank map. Your objective is to retain the highest number of points by pinpointing five cities on the blank map.

title: Arrow Hit
description: Embark on an exhilarating adventure in the virtual realm with "Arrow Hit," the ultimate arcade game that puts your archery skills to the test! Immerse yourself in a captivating world where precision, timing, and accuracy are the keys to victory.

title: From Nerd to Popular Ballerina Cappuccina
description:
From Nerd to Popular: Ballerina Cappuccina is a makeover and dress-up game that follows a sweet transformation story. Ballerina Cappuccina starts as a shy, awkward girl with big dreams—and it’s your job to help her glow up and become the confident ballerina she’s meant to be.

Style her through each stage with fabulous outfits, stylish hairstyles, and elegant accessories. As you dress her up, she slowly sheds her insecurities and gains the charm and confidence needed to shine on stage.

title: Hidden Funny Alphabet
description: Hidden Alphabets game is a fun and helps finding your skills in hidden objects. Have a great game!

title: Turbo Stars
description:
Hop on your skateboard and speed down the track in this wild and fast-paced racing game!

Zoom through a wide variety of exhilarating tracks and defeat your opponents!

Think fast to pick up items that will help you gain an advantage — or even pick up and throw your competitors if they get too close to you! 

Don’t forget to snatch coins and keys to unlock a whole bunch of awesome items, including power-ups, new objects to ride on, and gear for your character.

title: The Superhero League
description: Want to join the Superhero League and unlock endless puzzle fun? In The Superhero League, you’ll become a superhero and begin an exciting puzzle adventure. Take on various killing missions, solve puzzles, and save the world. Control your hero through challenging levels and become the strongest hero of all! This creative puzzle game combines superhero elements with rich strategy gameplay.

title: MergeDuel.io
description: Merge Duel is a fast-paced 1v1 battle game where strategy and quick decisions lead to victory. Merge and upgrade your cannons to summon powerful units and counter your opponent in real time. Every match challenges your tactical skills as you adapt to new enemies and situations. Climb the ranks, dominate the leaderboard, and enjoy vibrant visuals, smooth controls, and intense duels from start to finish.

title: Bubble Shooter Hawaii
description: Bubble Shooter Hawaii is a bubble shooter game with a hawaii theme and classic gameplay combined with special bubble mechanics. It's unique level map will guide you to the challenging levels with unique bubbles like the horizontal row destroyer, the rocks or the hidden bubbles.

title: Color Block Blast 3
description:
Drag and drop the correct block into the grid. Match 3 or more tiles of the same colour to eliminate them.

Score beautiful combos while earning bonus points and watching beautiful animations take shape.

How high can you score in this endless match 3 game?

title: Block Combo Blast
description: Enjoy a classic block puzzle game with exciting jewel blast gameplay and stunning visuals! Solve 1800+ challenging levels, earn combos, and climb the global leaderboard. Train your brain, relax with soothing sounds, and compete with friends for the top spot!

title: Instagirls Christmas Dress Up
description: Christmas is back in town! And the Instagirls are dressing up in fashion! Choose your girl, select your Christmas clothes and create the perfect X-Mas outfit! Snap a picture and post it on your Instagram with hashtag #Christmas. Merry Christmas! Ho Ho Ho!

title: My Garden Journey
description:
Grow your dream garden, raise animals, and enjoy peaceful farm life!

Welcome to My Garden Journey! ?? Start your peaceful farming adventure in My Garden Journey, the ultimate relaxing farming simulator!

title: Ball Mania!
description:
Ball Mania is an addictive little ball runner game. 
You never know what the future holds and a path full of unexpected obstacles awaits your exploration. 
Slide to control the little ball to move left and right, and then turn the corner, you have to be very careful, or you risk falling! 

This is a great test of the player's reaction ability, can you succeed in the challenge?
Simply click the big play button to start having fun.

title: Neon City Racers
description: Night Neon Racers game is a 3D car racing game with various game modes. You can race against other cars or you can drift as much as you want and earn diamonds from all of these. The game also has a car blasting mode to explode vehicles in traffic and earn diamonds from those vehicles while having fun! Various super sports cars and very fun game modes are waiting for you! Lets play!

title: Soda Block Jam
description:
Slide soda crates, collect bottles, and deliver to the right
exits. A smooth, colorful puzzler that blends motion and
color-matching

title: Find The Candy Winter
description: Finding stars and solving candy puzzles will be the cutest mission you never want to quit

title: Colored Bricks
description: Colored Bricks is a fun and simple endless game. There are colorful bricks and one on the top. You should move that one to the right or left. When it hits the same color brick, it will destroy all bricks of the row. The challenge is to improve your high score in the limited time that you have! Some bricks have extra time if you destroy them.

title: Glitch
description:
Glitch is a 2D platformer game where you must solve challenging puzzles to overcome the glitching platform and reach the finish door. Get ready for a gaming experience like no other, whether you’re a fan of puzzles, action, or platformers. Start your adventure!

Innovative Puzzle Mechanics: Tackle a range of puzzles designed to test your problem-solving abilities. Each level offers a unique brain teaser, from classic logic challenges to cutting-edge new mechanics.

title: Hospital Inc
description: Step into the fast-paced world of Hospital Inc, an exciting management simulator. This addictive idle tycoon casual game lets you build, expand, and manage your own hospital while earning profits even when you're away.

title: Christmas Eve Parking
description: Christmas Eve Parking is fun addictive hyper casual parking game.This is best game to check your parking skills on Christmas.

title: My Halloween Park
description:
Are you ready to run your own Halloween park? My Halloween Park is a 3D simulation game. You can create a spooky and fun amusement park for visitors. You can collect ghosts and load them into the haunted house, where visitors will enter and experience the horror.
You can use the money to unlock and upgrade more entertainment facilities and play areas. You can also increase your ghost-carrying capacity and gardening seed capacity. If you like Halloween, don't miss this game! Have fun!

title: Wild Animal Doctor Adventure
description: Let's help our wild animals Lion,Zebra, Bear, crocodile, Elephant and Hippo to recover and heal from their long term wounds. They got a heavy injury on their body, so they need severe treatment. Help them to heal all of their wounds. Have a great doctor game.

title: Offroad Jeep Game Simulator
description: Off road legends are brought to you by offline Car Games or Car Racing Games no wifi Tap studios that open an exciting (4x4 mania or 4x4 off road games) 4x4 Off road SUV Jeep Driving Games where off road outlaws or off road jeep drivers will take SUV test drive ahead in Hill Jeep Driving Simulator and Monster Truck Games. Extreme car driving simulator game.

title: Block Breaker
description: Embark on a 2D adventure filled with dynamic physics! Break ice blocks, use springs and portals, and launch the character through the air to reach the goal platform. Master the environment and discover all the creative ways to complete each level!"

title: Color Pipes
description: Achieve your flow state by connecting dots of the same colorConnect matching colors with pipe to create a flow Pair the colors cover the board to solve the levelPipes will break if they cross or overlapFeatures Clean and minimalistic design to focus purely on the gameplay Over  challenging levels Ability to reverse your moves Play any level any time Fun theme and music

title: Funny Animals Coloring Book
description: Who loves drawing and painting ? In this beautiful coloring book, we are in a jungle and there are 5 animals to paint. Do you know the colors of the different animals? Use the movable panel on the right to select the desired color. Drag the palette panel with the left mouse button. Enjoy this new coloring book..

title: Shooting Balls
description:
Shooting Balls is a casual and super fun game.
The objective is to destroy as many blocks as possible and reach the highest score.
Challenge your friends to see who can get the highest score!

title: Star Beacons
description:
It’s a peggle like game. The objective is to clear all the stars by hitting them with a ball shot.
You can earn 20 achievements by clearing all the objects on the screen in each level.

title: Dino Survival: 3D Simulator
description: Survive in this prehistoric Jurassic park. Tame and grow dinosaurs, fight dinos, explore uncharted territories and incredible areas. Build your settlement. Sail to distant islands. Go to Raid! Conquer! Defeat raptors and the huge T-Rex!

title: Pick Brainrot: 3D Battle
description: Choose one of two Brainrots, transform into them, and engage in intense battles with other players. Defeat opponents and unlock new abilities: a Brainrot morph, unique weapons, and powerful abilities. Every battle is a chance to prove yourself! At level 5, you'll unlock a protective shield, and at level 10, you'll unlock slow-motion , which will give you a huge advantage in battle. Earn titles for your victories, from "Noob" to a true "Pro"!

title: Loop Ghost
description: Time loop puzzle: ghosts of your past cycles automatically repeat your moves. Use them to press buttons, open passages, and escape together.

title: Mr Bounce
description: Challenge yourself with Mr Bounce, the brain-boosting puzzle game that will test your thinking skills and reflexes. Each level is a new puzzle demanding strategic planning and precise execution. Mr Bounce is more than just a game; it's a mental workout that improves your cognitive abilities.

title: Real High Stunt Car Extreme
description:
Real High Stunt Car Extreme is the ultimate stunt and trial car game with both entertaining and awe-inspiring tracks.
The main tracks are designed for casual play, but the bonus tracks offer more extreme challenge! The bonus tracks have high risks but also high rewards. Levels include hard trials levels, easy speed levels, and casual and fun jump levels.

title: Santa Adventure
description: Santa Adventure is a 2D running game. A wonderful game full of adventures. Divided into three stages, you must collect the largest number of gifts before finishing.

title: Gomu Goman
description: With simple tap-and-drag gameplay, Gomu Goman offers hundreds of challenging and laugh-out-loud levels. Each level is a unique puzzle that demands creativity—and a certain degree of spicy humor from you.

title: Pop It Fidget
description: Have fun playing Pop it Fidget. The object of the game is to tap all the circles on each toy. Relax and have fun with many different toys. It has among us, unicorn, fruits, animals, among others...

title: Noob Village Tower Defense
description: Dive into the dynamic world of a 2D platformer, where you play as a noob fighting for the survival of your village! Your main goal is to protect the village from endless waves of monsters appearing from an ominous portal. Control the tower manually: select shells, adjust the trajectory and shoot enemies one by one. Only your accuracy and tactics will help you survive the onslaught!

title: Sleepy Princess Pregnant Check Up
description: The sleepy princess is pregnant and she needs a doctor check-up before going on holiday with her prince! Find out how the pregnancy is going and use fun medical tools from the doctor's room. Listen to the princess's heartbeat, use the ultrasound to also check-up on the baby and then have fun choosing a belly tattoo.

title: Sort Games Challenge
description: Sort Games Challenge is a puzzle game. Here you can challenge yourself and choose from multiple modes, not limited to one. Your goal is to complete the mission within a limited time to pass the level. Dont underestimate this game, its still very difficult to pass. Come and challenge!

title: Clash of Stone
description: Help the hero to protect his homeland, use the trebuchet to kill the invading army of skeletons and become a tower defense legend!

title: BUBBLE FEVER BLAST
description: Shoot the bubble at bubbles of the same color to drop them! When the bubble enters STAR, there is a chance for FEVER! If the bubbles reach the bottom line, the game is over.

title: Leap and Avoid 2
description: Get ready for another thrilling journey with the white ball! "Leap and Avoid 2" brings new caves, lab levels, and fresh mechanics. Discover secret paths, collect coins, and unlock powerful bonuses like speed boosts and shields. Jump on white platforms, avoid black ones, and explore in all directions to find exits. The more coins you gather, the higher you rank. Compete with friends and uncover every hidden treasure!

title: Animal Fashion Hair Salon
description: Our top game for kids and toddlers Animal Hair Salon now takes the little ones on a crazy jungle hairstyle adventure with new adorable animals and even more makeover fun!

title: Idle Santa Factory
description: Step into Santa's fabulous toy factory! Manage the production, recruit elves to help you create and package toys in time for the holidays. Upgrade the machinery to make better and faster toys, meeting the increasing demands. Bring everyone's dreams to life by assembling, packaging, and distributing Christmas toys!

title: 3D Match Puzzle Mania
description: Enter the world of match-3 game brought to life in 3D. Solve captivating puzzles and collect coins to acquire power-ups. Complete daily tasks to earn fantastic bonuses and experience endless fun with every move you make!

title: Gun Evolution
description: Gun Evolution is both a shooting running game and a strategy merge battle game. With 3D cartoon models, you need to merge a power gun to win the battle after the finish line at each level. I recommend shooting the numbered pillars, you can claim money inside and get the items on them. When you earn enough money, you can upgrade the ATK and Speed to destroy more pillars more easily on the track. Good luck!

title: Geography Quiz
description: Geography trivia. Flags, countries capitals, world map quiz, famous landmarks around the world, foreign currency. Test your geography knowledge and learn new facts about the countries and continents. The best educational and intellectual geography quiz.

title: Furry Wedding Proposal
description: Hi, young stylist! You will find a very unusual couple in love - a brutal fox and a feminine bunny - who are preparing for their future wedding. They dream of looking stunning on this holiday and you will become their main assistant in this exciting adventure! You have to dress the characters in beautiful wedding dresses, choose stylish hairstyles for them and apply light makeup. Create, fantasize and create a fairy tale!

title: Head Soccer Arena
description: Head Soccer Arena takes you into a fast-paced football world! Play 2-player matches on the same device, dive into quick games, or rise through 15 leagues in Career Mode. Win matches, collect coins and diamonds, and upgrade your power-ups—ice, lightning, anvil, big head, and more! Unlock new characters and dominate the field with strategy, skill, and speed. Every match is a step toward football glory!

title: Cat Evolution
description: Cat Evolution is a fun parkour game. You will play as a cat, as a carnivore, collecting pieces of meat for you to evolve faster, light vegetables will degrade you. Also, don't forget to collect diamonds, which can be used for upgrades! Evolve from a cat to a tiger or even farther to the finish line to conquer the animals!

title: Seafaring Memory Challenge
description: Set sail into the captivating depths of the ocean with Seafaring Memory Challenge! Match pairs of sea-themed icons in an endless array of levels. Test your memory skills as you uncover treasures like colorful fish, delicate sea shells, and sunken treasures. With no level limit, the adventure never ends, providing hours of entertainment. Stay sharp and immerse yourself in the mesmerizing world beneath the waves!

title: Design With Me SuperHero Tutu Outfits
description: Welcome to Design With Me SuperHero Tutu Outfits. We all love superheroes very much! Likewise, our favorite princesses are inspired more by superhero tutu fashion. They planned to organize the fashion events under this theme. Join and help each princess to pick a suitable superhero tutu outfit. Play them and have fun!

title: Vehicle Parking Master 3D
description: Vehicle Parking Master 3D is a tough and realistic vehicle parking simulation game. You can test your driving skills in 3D Challenge Mode and Parking Mode, and handle the truck in harder levels. Each mode has 40 levels for you to play and beat. There is also a secret mode for you to unlock after you finish all 3 modes of levels. You have to drive carefully and park your vehicle in the parking area. Good luck!

title: Noob: Zombie Prison Escape
description: Noob: Zombie Prison Escape is an action platforming game inspired by the style of Minecraft. Your mission is to help Noob escape from a zombie-infested prison by finding keys, coins, solving puzzles, avoiding traps, and using parkour skills to navigate platforms. Along the way, you'll need to shoot down monsters with a crossbow, complete tasks involving torches, and face various challenges in 10 different levels and 6 challenges.

title: Save My Pumpkin
description: “Save My Pumpkin” is the second version of the popular game that has a Halloween theme and has made all the kids in the world fall in love with it. The gameplay consists of rescuing a creepy pumpkin with the help of drawing, which is in trouble. To test your drawing skills and create key resistances around the pumpkin, all you need to do is be careful and quick, because it is in great danger. Ready to save the spooky? Then let’s start!

title: Tiny Golf King
description: Simple, intuitive, fun and addicting. Make it to the top in Tiny Golf King! Complete more than 45 challenging levels and be the King of Tiny golf

title: Sliding Slide
description:
Enjoy and relax with a classi puzzle game. Six different images with 3 difficulty levels to satisfy the tastes of every players!
Beat your highscores trying to solve the puzzle as fast as you can!

title: Cake Shop
description:
Cake Shop features:
- multiple levels
- good graphics

title: Juicy Run
description: A toothed gear will be there for you. If you click and hold for a while, it will release its shadows to hack the way through the crowd of fruits. Are you gearing up for the splattering of a mesmerizing array of juices?

title: Feed the Panda
description: Very cute static physics game with a Panda theme. Engaging graphics and sound effects using same mechanics as “cut the rope”. Enjoy cool brainteaser now!

title: Hidden Paint 3D
description: Coloring 3D is a relaxing and creative game where you bring the world to life with color. Tap objects to instantly paint them in bright, beautiful shades and watch scenes transform. Simple controls and calm gameplay make it perfect for all ages and stress-free fun.

title: Hungry Corgi - Cute Music Game
description: Hungry Corgi is a music game where you feed the dog to music and try to catch the rhythm of the cutest songs created especially for this game. A perfect way to relax and have fun playing the cutest while also challenging rhythm game. Join to corgi adventure to meet new friends by opening characters, listen to fun songs and unlock incredible themes that change everything!

title: Color Wood Animal Jam
description: Begin a charming logic puzzle match game in Color Wood Animal Jam. Drag the colorful wooden animal pieces into their correct spots. Complete each delightful jam puzzle. One wrong move can make the color block jam even trickier.

title: Monsters' Wheels Special
description: Drive your huge and powerful car on various trucks. Go over hills, precipices and jump over different obstacles. Participate in races against strong opponents and very powerful cars. Ram your opponents and crush them because in demolition derby you need to win by whatever means necessary. Earn money, unlock new cars and upgrade you engine power, durability, nitro and so on. Get behind the wheel, step on the juice and enjoy these dynamic racing game!

title: Dirty Them All
description: Let's splash some dirt over the walking people near the road with this Dirty Them All game! Drive your car through the mud and splash it all around the other people. Let them chase you until the finish line. The more people chase, the more scores you get. Let this funny and entertaining adventure begin!

title: Build a Snowman
description: Build a Snowman is a hardcore logic game. Player needs to merge two parts of the snowman body. It sounds like a very easy task, but it is not as you control both parts at the same time and there are traps and blocked paths everywhere!

title: Pixel Demolisher Cannon
description: In Pixel Demolisher Cannon, we destroy various objects consisting of pixel maps. Shoot bombs at objects and make the explosions bigger. Upgrade your Cannon with the money you earn and make it more effective and powerful! You can also earn much more money on Bonus Maps.

title: Catch the Apple
description: Embark on an exciting adventure with a hedgehog as it prepares for winter in the game "Catch the Apple." This browser-based game will lead you through various clearings, each serving as a new level, with tempting apples strewn about. The hedgehog depends on your assistance to gather these fruits and stave off winter hunger.

title: Angry Chibi Run
description: Angry Chibi RunAn endless sprinting running game. Jump and slide to avoid obstacles and dodge oncoming trains as fast as possible. Choose your favorite character, dress him up and surf the streets to your heart's content! What are you waiting for, come and join the best parkour game ever!

title: Baby Penguin Fishing
description: Tiny Fishing is a fun and addictive 2D puzzle fishing simulation game that challenges your skills. Enjoy this charming game as you explore a fishing adventure. The game has two modes: Fishing and Trawling. In Fishing mode, you cast your line by clicking on each fish’s body and catch them quickly to advance to the next level. In Trawling mode, you release the net by clicking on the desired area and capture everything within it. You also have to complete the objective fast.

title: Nonogram Master
description:
Nonogram Master is an exciting puzzle game based on Japanese crosswords. Solve hidden pixel pictures using numbers as clues!

Choose a comfortable control method:
PC — Left-click to fill a square, right-click to mark with an "X".
Mobile — Tap control: select a mode and tap a cell.

Customize the game, train your logic, and enjoy the process! Are you ready to become a Nonogram Master?

title: 10x10 Winter Gems
description:
10X10 Winter Gems is a fun online matching game.

In this game, you need to make perfect rows and columns of blocks.

Place the different shapes of blocks strategically under the grid and try to complete rows and columns.

When you form a complete row or column, the row or column gets removed from the grid.

But be careful, while placing the blocks, because the game gets over if there is no space left. So, make a strategy in your mind before placing the blocks.

Place more and more blocks under the grid to make a high score.

So, what are you waiting for? Play 10X10 Winter Gems and take your tetris skills to the next level.

title: Archers Ragdoll Physics
description: Archers Ragdoll Physics is a physics-based archery action game where ragdoll characters fight using special arrows. The game features 10 characters and 12 unique arrows such as lightning, fire, poison, missile, and rocket. Players can equip three arrows and switch between them during battles. Some levels include traps like electric cables and spinning gears that can be activated with arrows. In 2 Player Mode, players choose from 7 arrows and compete to hit their opponent the most.

title: Dolphin Coloring Book
description: Explore the world of cute dolphins with these free coloring pages for kids. Color them online or print them out to color later. Have fun playing.

title: Goose Game Multiplayer
description:
Goose Game Multiplayer is a HTML5 Board Game. 
Enjoy this funny version of the classic Goose Game. 
3 Game’s Mode: 
- Multiplayer mode 
- Play against the pc 
- Challenge a friend playing on the same device

title: Bouncing Eggs
description: Bouncing Eggs is a HTML5 Physics game. Throw the falling eggs in the basket by bouncing them on the cloth and reach the target of each of the ten levels.

title: Pocket Car Master
description:
Pocket Car Master: The Ultimate Car Puzzle Game
Collect and merge parts to make your own robot car. Park it in the matching area and fight other robots. No time limit, just fun. Upgrade your car with coins and unlock more cars. Try and play now!

title: Coin Smash
description: Get ready for 'Coin Smash', an exciting maze game where you race to collect coins while avoiding tricky enemies! Explore twisting mazes, trying to grab all the shiny coins in time. But watch out for sneaky foes trying to stop you! Stay quick and smart to win big in this thrilling treasure hunt!

title: Sudoku Challenges
description: Sudoku Challenges is a logic-based, combinatorial number-placement puzzle. The objective is to fill a 9 × 9 grid with digits so that each column, each row, and each of the nine 3 × 3 sub-grids that compose the grid (also called "boxes" or "blocks") contain all of the digits from 1 to 9. Each puzzle will start at a partially completed grid, which has a single solution.

title: Bouncy king
description: Welcome to Bounce king. In this game, you will enjoy tricky puzzles of 30 levels. the game goal is very simple need put the ball into the hole. But it's a bit difficult to do that because you need to arrange some wood and other things too.

title: Sprunki Coloring Book
description:
Dive into a colorful adventure with Sprunki Coloring Book, a delightful game designed for kids and adults alike. Choose from a wide variety of adorable Sprunki characters, captivating landscapes, and fun designs to color your way. Whether you're a budding artist or simply looking to relax, Sprunki Coloring Book offers endless possibilities for self-expression.
Start coloring today and discover the joy of creativity with Sprunki Coloring Book!

title: Brainrot Mob Clash 3D
description: Welcome to the wild and chaotic world of Brainrot Mob Clash 3D. It’s a full-blown racing and fighting adventure. Dash through 3D obstacle courses, avoid deadly traps like spikes and spinning saws. Match and merge your stickman army. Crush enemy mobs in exciting action-packed battles. As you run, collect brainrot characters to increase your numbers and merge them to form powerful units.

title: Obby The Legendary Dragon
description:
Experience the thrill of an addictive pet-catching simulator, perfect for Pokémon fans! Explore diverse Roblox worlds and level up your heroes all in one exciting adventure.
Gather health, upgrade your hero, and unlock incredible new worlds to discover. Catch pets in battles, hatch them from cases and eggs, and trade or purchase them to build a team of powerful allies and friends. Earn money, climb the ranks, and enhance your Obby character with prestigious titles and upgrades!

title: Hyper Back to School
description: Ready to go back to school? My God! Class is like a battlefield. Go find your stuff.

title: GP Ski Slalom
description:
GP Ski Slalom is a HTML5 Sport Game.
Go around gates to complete the track and try to improve your best time on each track!
Game Features:
- Three players available! Select your favorite skier between male, female, and Santa;-)!
-12 Levels of increasing difficulty
-High-quality 3D Graphics
