description: Get spooky and stylish in Wednesday Addams Beauty Salon, where gothic meets glam in a 3-level makeover game. Treat Wednesday to a facial, apply stunning dark-themed makeup, and finish off with iconic dress-up fashion in her unique style. From skincare to eyeliner, you control every detail of her transformation. Whether you’re a fan of the Addams aesthetic or just love alternative beauty, this salon experience offers a complete glow-up from head to toe.

title: Bingo Halloween
description: A Halloween-themed bingo game where you can win exciting bingos to unlock spooky candy-themed images. Enjoy multiple call speeds and progressive unlocks.

title: Ragdoll Show: Throw, Break and Destroy!
description: Dive into the chaotic fun of ragdoll mayhem! Navigate thrilling challenges by guiding your ragdoll character through each level, leveraging realistic physics for epic destruction. Sharpen your skills and unleash maximum chaos—can you conquer every challenge and emerge victorious?

title: Sudoku Relax
description: Sudoku Relax is a fresh take on the world-famous sudoku puzzle that you can enjoy anytime and anywhere. This free sudoku game keeps the classic rules but adds a clean, colorful design and smooth controls, making it ideal for both beginners and seasoned puzzle lovers. Simply fill the grid with numbers from 1 to 9 without repeating them in any row, column, or 3×3 square. Train your brain, challenge yourself, and enjoy one of the most beloved logic games in the world with Sudoku Relax!

title: Survival Island
description:
Hey kids! Are you ready for a thrilling island survival adventure? In Survival Island, you’ll explore a mysterious island full of surprises! Cut down trees with your axe, mine rocks, gather grass, and fish to keep your energy up. Produce food to stay strong and upgrade your skills to survive longer.

Whether it’s day, night, or stormy, anything can happen! Explore caves, swim, and boost your speed and capacity. Get ready for a fun-filled survival journey in Survival Island!

title: Drill Quest
description:
Drill Quest is a casual game combining the excitement of crushing blocks, upgrading your drill, and building your city. 

Explore diverse locations, progressively upgrade your equipment, and choose from machines.

title: Cross the Road
description: Experience the classic arcade action of Crossy Road in Roblox style! Navigate through endless roads, rivers, and train tracks, dodging obstacles and aiming for the highest score. With its vibrant voxel-style graphics and simple yet challenging gameplay, it's a nostalgic journey for both new and seasoned players.

title: Diamond Colors Art
description: Are you new to painting? Don't worry! Just fill the diamond into the canvas according to the number to complete a masterpiece of your own. There are a variety of pictures in the game for you to choose from! 101 different pictures are waiting for you in the gallery. In each level, the pictures are detailed and the number of colored diamonds increases.

title: Sand Loop
description:
Discover Sand Loop, a uniquely relaxing puzzle experience where you collect the sand from the beautiful sand art which is very satisfying to watch and play.
Guide moving buckets along a conveyor belt, collect sand by color, and watch as each level comes to life in a smooth cascade of motion. Every grain falls with realistic physics, creating a mesmerizing and satisfying visual journey.

title: Gym Simulator - Tycoon
description: Welcome to Gym Simulator - Tycoon, where your business dreams take shape in the world of fitness. In this engaging online game, you'll manage and grow a network of gyms—upgrade your facilities, invest in top-notch equipment, and fine-tune every detail to run smoothly. Whether you're playing on your phone or computer, dive into a game where strategy meets a passion for health. With dynamic gameplay, you'll turn a small operation into a booming fitness brand.

title: LinkLink
description:
Round and cute animal blocks are piled up.
If you connect the same types together, you can get points by disappearing!
Let's compete to see who gets the highest score in a minute

title: Slingshot Chicken
description: Launch your fearless chicken from a slingshot and smash through unstable pig-filled towers in an endlessly fun physics adventure! With infinite levels and constantly evolving challenges, no two runs are ever the same. Perfect your aim, trigger explosive TNT chain reactions, and watch satisfying collapses unfold as you clear every pig before your shots run out. The fun never stops — how far can you go?

title: Lost Adventure
description: Lost Adventure is a survival puzzle game where you guide a determined pilot through a strange, untamed land after a mid-air crash. Craft tools, mine resources, and solve clever challenges as you race to rescue scattered passengers. Your choices shape their fate—will you lead them to safety before the wilderness claims them for good?

title: Chicken Banana Run
description: Explore the World and Space with the famous Chicken Banana! Run and keep running to collect gold, diamonds and special items and finish with the longest distance to get a high score! Play now the new free runner game for everyone.

title: Office Pyramid Solitaire
description: Your objective in Office Pyramid Solitaire is to clear the card pyramid. On hard difficulty you must also clear the draw deck.

title: Halloween Match Trio
description: Halloween Match Trio is a classic match-3 puzzle game with fun challenges. Swap items to make a line of three or more matching items, horizontally or vertically. Keep matching to unlock all tiles and reach the final stage. Use power-ups like bombs, arrows, magnets, and more to clear levels faster. Complete all 75 levels to win the game!

title: Mahjong Tiles Christmas
description: Mahjong Tiles Christmas is winter theme game. Collect the pairs of identical tiles by clicking or tapping them. You can collect only those tiles which are open from either left or right side. Collect all the tiles to complete a level. Complete all the levels to win the game.

title: One Line Drawing
description: Welcome to One Line Drawing, a game that brings together a variety of line drawing gameplays. You can relax through relaxing line drawing gameplay, or challenge yourself through puzzle-type line drawing gameplay.

title: Super Stock Stack
description: Super Stock Stack challenges you to sort food cans onto shelves with speed and clever organization! Match the cans by their labels, manage the growing stock, and test your skills as the levels get tougher. Can you become the ultimate stock master?

title: Moto Maniac
description:
Overcome all the obstacles as fast as you can.

Your goal is to go through the port docks trying not to fall into the water. And avoiding hitting your head too of course.

title: WaterPark Slide.io
description: WaterPark Slide.io for Aqua park is a sliding io game. Can you beat all others without hitting blocks and dropping the water? Go to the end of the Aqua park to become the 1st io player! Have fun playing this joyful and colorful water slide game. Push others in Waterpark race.io! Instructions: Press Left Mouse Button and slide side to side to controll player.

title: Rodha
description:
- Play 60 unique, hand-crafted levels!
- 9 Unique characters.
- 11 different and soothing color themes.
- Move through different portals.

Jump through the levels and avoid obstacles. Collect coins for later upgrades. There are cannons, moving saws, and many other contraptions to stop you in your tracks. When you die you’re returned to the last checkpoint.

#Rodha #Platformer

title: Obby Football Soccer 3D
description:
Online football / soccer and real sport — play with friends or random opponents.
Penalties and matches — score amazing goals, save shots, and become your team’s hero.
Obby challenges — train your reaction and speed while passing football obstacles.
Colorful 3D graphics and the atmosphere of a real stadium.

Go from rookie to champion. Prove that you are the best player in the world of football and sport.

title: Sleepy Princess Resurrection
description: Have loads of fun in this amazing new game with sleepy princess! You can learn how to do CPR and take care of a patient that was admitted in the emergency room. Use the defibrillator paddels to resuscitate the princess and then after she wakes up, make sure she drinks lots of water and takes her vitamins. The princess will feel ok in no time!

title: Just Ludo
description: Just Ludo is a tabletop dice board game. Roll the dice and let your chess pieces reach the finish line first, so as to defeat the opponent and win rich rewards. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Winter Tiles
description: Enjoy 'Winter Tiles' with a festive theme! Match and collect pairs of identical winter-themed tiles. Click or tap two tiles with a clear path between them with no more than two turns. Collect all the winter-themed tiles within the time limit to advance to the next level.

title: Cat Girl Halloween Preparation
description: Welcome to Cat Girl Halloween Preparation. Join Cat Girl in her Halloween Preparation journey! From spooky decorations to creative costumes, get inspired for the spookiest night of the year. Discover Cat Girl's tips and tricks for the ultimate Halloween celebration and make this year’s festivities unforgettable! Play and have fun with this new halloween game!

title: Duet Cats Halloween Cat Music
description: Welcome to Duet Cats Halloween Cat Music, a game feast for 2 players filled with fun and music!Join your friends in this Halloween-inspired game to challenge the cat's music and have fun! With the rhythm of the music, control the cute cat to move. Let them eat more ice cream. You can choose a different musical challenge. You should accurately move to collect ice cream, and get the highest high score!

title: Funny Heroes Emergency
description: The heroes look so messy after their fight to save the world. Help them to recover by taking care all of their injuries one by one. Makeover their looks till they are ready to get back into fighting action. Save your favorite heroes!

title: Ragdoll Jump
description: Welcome to Ragdoll Jump! In this exciting jumping game, you will control a lovable stickman character on a thrilling journey out of a building. You will experience the sensation of soaring high as you jump and glide through the air, creating spectacular action sequences. Get ready for hilarious falls, and remember that you won't always land safely.

title: Super Brain
description: In the game, you'll control a character sprinting down a track, but your path is blocked by a series of "Gates of Knowledge." Each gate presents an interesting question, and you must choose the lane corresponding to the correct answer in a short amount of time to pass through. A wrong choice ends the run! As you get faster, the questions become trickier. This game tests not only your knowledge but also your on-the-spot reaction skills. Come join this dual challenge of brain and speed!

title: Gun Craft Run Weapon Fire
description: Gun Craft Run Weapon Fire is an adrenaline-pumping endless running game that combines the thrill of shooting with the excitement of parkour. You must swiftly collect bullets and ammo packs to keep your gun firing. The obstacles are everywhere, but with quick reflexes and precise aiming, you can dodge them all. With its fast-paced gameplay, stunning visuals, and addictive soundtrack, Gun Craft Run Weapon Fire will keep you on the edge of your seat for hours on end.

title: Sticker Jam Peel Off & Match
description: Play Sticker Jam, the ultimate matching puzzle game! Peel vibrant stickers, match colors, and solve fun challenges. Relax and unwind with this unique blend of calming gameplay and brain-teasing puzzles. Perfect for hours of entertainment—start playing now!

title: Cook And Decorate
description: Cook and Decorate your kitchen. A blend of Cooking Game and Kitchen Decorating game, brings you to the amazing delicious food that you have to cook but also to an extraordinary decorating game! Play Now to build your dream kitchen with by cooking like a master chef!

title: Bubiloons
description: Funny, witty, bubbling and very magical… these are the Bubiloons, some cute unicorn animals full of surprises that you will discover in this App.

title: Сoloring by numbers
description:
Coloring by Numbers is the best Pixel Art style game to color pictures by numbers and create modern masterpieces based on numbers!

Treat yourself to a New Year's mood in our new fabulously beautiful game! 104 levels filled with the spirit of New year and Christmas are waiting for you!

The game can be played both on a computer and on tablets and smartphones, right in the browser,
without even downloading!

title: Idle Factory Empire
description:
Make sure those boxes are shipped FAST!

Click on factory buttons to upgrade your productivity. Earn cash and reinvest to upgrade your factory production.

Be sure to earn extra bonuses from balloons and drones.

Follow the advice of the IT guy and engineer to crank those profits UP.

Oh, and did we mention that your money is piling up as we speak? Go offline, return and claim profits.

title: Mr Stickman Gunner
description: Mr Stickman Gunner  is an exciting 2D shooter game about stick little men. The game has an unusual aiming system. After each shot it will be difficult to aim again, because the kickback of the weapon will act on your stick little men. And the more powerful the shot, the stronger the weapon or even your hero will be thrown. Destroy all enemies and complete more than 40 levels.

title: Obby Blox Hook
description: Obby Blox Hook is an addictive physics-based platformer where players control the Roblox players swinging through levels using a grappling hook. With smooth animations, challenging obstacles, and fun physics mechanics, the game tests your timing and precision as you swing from one point to another, avoiding obstacles and making daring jumps to reach the finish line.

title: Cashier Game
description: You play as a cashier who needs to punch the goods and give change to the customers. As you earn money, you can improve your store and buy new furnishings.

title: Hydro Racing 3D
description: Would you like to participate in a great boat racing game with Hydro Racing 3D? Not only racing but also lots of free map activities and exciting career mode chapters are waiting. The boats are shiny and faster than each other. The nitrous fuel makes them faster and stronger. Get in your place in the water parkour and start either racing or free driving in single or 2 player mode. Let the speedboat adventure begin!

title: Pull the Pin: Fish Rescue!
description: Pull the Pin: Fish Rescue! is a relaxing and addictive puzzle game with lots of interesting puzzles. You will see several niches in it. They will be separated by partitions. In one niche you will see a fish, and in another water. You will need to carefully study everything and pull the pin. Thus, you will open it and water will get to the fish.

title: Real Impossible Sky Tracks Car Driving
description: Real Impossible Sky Tracks Car Driving  simulator, stunts, and gameplay options keep it interesting. This game is great for racing, 3D car games, and extreme car driving fans. Multiplayer and internet games let you challenge friends and show off your track talents. ??️

title: Labubu Pop
description:
Labubu Pop is a bright and cheerful puzzle game where the playful Labubus have completely taken over the box! Connect matching characters into chains, clear the board, and earn points to level up. Each stage brings fun surprises, and even more exciting combos!

With its colorful visuals, smooth animations, and simple yet addictive gameplay, Labubu Pop is perfect for relaxing and having fun anytime. The longer your chain — the higher your score and the flashier the effects!

title: Line Puzzle
description: Try to move the lines to match each image  fun and relaxing levels

title: Paw Care
description: A new pet hospital has been opened and the business is booming every day. You are now a member of the medical staff to help small animals solve their invasion. This is a realistic 3D simulation game that allows you to experience real happiness.

title: Forest Tiles
description: There are several coins on the 9 by 9 playing field. It is necessary to place the blocks on the playing field in such a way as to completely assemble a vertical or horizontal line. Gold coins can be used to reset unnecessary blocks and continue the game if you lose.

title: Ellie's Recipe: Dubai Chocolate Bar
description: Whip up luxury in Ellie’s Recipe: Dubai Chocolate Bar! Help Ellie create rich, decadent chocolate treats in this fun, interactive cooking game. Gather ingredients, prepare molds, make gourmet fillings, and craft elegant chocolate bars with Dubai flair. Unlock stylish outfits for Ellie and enjoy hands-on cooking fun with real kitchen actions. From mixing to decorating, every step is sweet! Play now and become a luxury dessert pro with Ellie!

title: Ice Queen Home Recovery
description: The Ice Queen got home from the hospital and she needs to recover from her accident. The roads were slippery this morning and being the Ice Queen doesn't prevent falling and injuring yourself. Be her doctor and take care of the queen's wounds and fractures. Take her temperature, check her pulse and also make sure she doesn't get bored. Play her favorite music and make the best smoothie ever!

title: Fury Tanks
description: Beyond the hills and forests, war waits in silence. When it starts, it’s you, your tank and the enemy in your sights. Build your armor, power up your cannon and let instinct guide your aim. When the ground shakes, make sure it’s because you fired first.

title: Unblock That
description: Unblock That is a brain teasing game with several difficulties and challenging levels Each level has a unique solution Test your skills and the abilities in solving difficult puzzles

title: Street Food Master Chef
description: Are you street food lover? If yes, then join us our new game Street Food Master Chef, a virtual cooking fun game. There are french fries stall, hotdog stall, pizza stall, burger stall, noodles stall and churros stall! This sounds so amazing that you can get all yummy food at only one place. Cooking fever will start in this carnival food festival. Get ready for this.

title: Ice Queen Tongue Doctor
description: The cold weather can cause many health problems and today the Ice Queen has a doctor's appointment. Join her and see how you can get rid of the nasty bacteria on her tongue and teeth. Have fun using the medical tools you find in the doctor's office and use the X-ray to spot the missing and crooked teeth. Put on a pair of dental braces and the Ice Queen will have a beautiful smile again!

title: College Girl Coloring Dress Up
description:
BFF high school fashion makeover: coloring book & cool dress up games for girls!
New college girls dress up game & coloring book is here for you! Dress up the most popular high school girls, create their whole look, paint and color. These cool coloring pages and clothes design features made especially for fashion girls. Begin total fashion makeover with our girl dress up games!

Design outfits like a fashionista: dress up, choose hairstyle, necklaces and other amazing accessories such as skirts and dresses. Select a color and click on the fragment you want to color, when the painting of college girl is created, start drawing and coloring, become BFF fashion clothes designer.

Take screenshots, save as wallpaper, and share cute coloring pages with your friends and family absolutely for free.

title: Supermarket Manager Simulator
description: Supermarket Manager Simulator is a business game. Have you ever fantasized about running your supermarket in your childhood?  Play as the store manager in this game and stock up on a variety of goods, from chips and fries to meats, burgers, vegetables, and fruits. From stocking, and shelving to selling, you will be the one to take care of it!  Don't hesitate to start your entrepreneurial journey now and become a great store tycoon!

title: Mine Jump
description: Jump into action! ? Test your logic and reflexes in this addictive game. Collect slugs, upgrade your hero, and uncover the secrets of a mysterious planet! ?✨

title: Halloween Tiles
description: A Halloween themed collapse tile game.  Clear the board by destroying tiles to collapse the columns.  Receive Magic Pumpkins when the columns collapse and additional matches.  Use these pumpkins to strategically destroy tiles when no matches are available.

title: Mahjong Quest: Candyland Adventures
description:
Ready to go on a magical quest through a land made of candy?
Jump into Mahjong Quest: Candyland Adventures - where every corner is bursting with sweetness and surprises!

The streets are sprinkled with tasty treats, and they’re all yours to match! Find the snacky pairs, clear the board, and munch your way through this delicious adventure.

Can you collect all the colorful, candy-coated tiles? Play now and let's find out!

title: BLOCK MATCH 8x8
description:
Place blocks to form vertical or horizontal rows and erase the target blocks!
The game is over when no more blocks can be placed or there are no moves left.

title: Koi Fish Pond - Idle Merge Game
description:
An addictive idle merging game. Build your own Koi fish company and grow your business.
Release your Koi fishes into the pond and earn money every time they cross the finish line. Buy new Koi fishes (or collect them from the gift boxes), and merge the same level Koi fishes to upgrade into a new type. The higher-level of the Koi fishes, the more money you will earn. Use your earnings to buy upgrade packages in the Shop to help you make money faster!

title: Chicken Jump : A Tap Challenge
description: This is simple but addictive chicken jump game. You'll have lots of levels and you have to save your chicken but swiping on screen from bottom to up to make chicken jump so that it can avoid hurdles.

title: Evony The King's Return
description: Want to conquer the world? In Evony: The King's Return, step into a vast universe of war and zombie attacks. Command an army and use powerful weapons and guns to attack the enemy. Keep moving your soldiers, shoot digital doors, and expand your army! Keep shooting to get the gun. Face endless zombie waves with your shooting skills and unlock powerful weapons.

title: Ice Cream Sort
description: Sort delicious ice creams by moving them between shelves and match 3 identical treats to clear them. Reveal hidden desserts, plan your moves carefully, and solve hundreds of relaxing yet challenging sorting puzzles. Unlock exciting achievements as you progress, use the Shuffle booster to overcome tricky situations, and pause the timer by watching a rewarded ad and switch your preferred language anytime from the Settings menu.

title: Portal Hop
description: Portal Hop is a platform puzzle game where you carry a portal above your head and use it to solve tricky challenges! Move through each level by warping yourself onto higher platforms, collecting plus and minus power-ups to adjust the height of your portal. Think smart, plan your moves, and find the perfect path to reach your destination. Ready to warp your way to victory

title: 2 Player Dark Racing
description: Get your vehicle and race it on the tracks against different drivers. In this 2 Player Dark Racing game, you can play against your friends in the 2-player split-screen or single-player mode.

title: DayCare Tycoon
description: Are you ready to build your dream business empire and be a great babysitter in this money tycoon simulator ? Dive into the world of daycare games and experience the joy of managing your own thriving idle tycoon games. From welcoming adorable babies to creating a safe and happy environment, this game offers everything you need to grow your daycare business into a successful venture.

title: Fashion Girls Nail Salon
description: For most girls, having beautiful nails design is very fashionable and attractive. If you are also a fashion lover, then come to our brand new Fashion Girls Nail Salon game. In this nail salon, you will have the opportunity to learn how to make nice nails.

title: Idle Money Factory
description: Money Factory is a fast-paced clicker game with strategic elements where you build and expand your financial empire by optimizing money production lines. Start with a simple setup and gradually grow by upgrading equipment, unlocking new production areas, and enhancing efficiency to skyrocket your profits.

title: Marathon Race io
description: In Marathon Race io, players take on the role of a runner who strives to become the fastest athlete on the planet. Players start at a basic level and can improve runner skills such as speed, endurance, income, etc. The more the player covers the distance, the more opportunities there are to improve skills and collect bonuses.

title: Santa games
description: Collect some gifts along the way to find the magic sleigh! There are 7 levels to play. Besides gifts, you can also collect magic letters and then play another 7 special levels (minigames): Diamond rain, Drop gift, Brick out and more!

title: Paint Rush
description: White houses are boring. Bring the colors in and paint everything in seconds. Complete every level painting all white spaces. Swipe left, right, up and down and fill all the empty spots on Paint Rush

title: Backgammon Deluxe Edition
description:
Want to try a different kind of game of luck? Enjoy the best board game of luck, Backgammon Deluxe!

Challenge your friend to a game of chance and trust in the dice roll. Roll the dice with all your might and pray for a lucky number!

Who will come out on top in the end? Play now, and let's find out!

title: Radical Rappelling
description:
Feel the rush and hold on tight as Radical Rappelling is back!

Join Rip and Roxy as you rappel down mountains at breakneck speed using your rapid reflexes.

Pull off death-defying tricks by ricocheting between launch pads, riding rainbows and rocketing over obstacles in the most redonkulous adventure ever.

Rack up coins and complete rockin’ missions to unlock sweet new gear for Rip and Roxy, the most fearless risk-takers on the planet.

title: Xytrian Runner
description: Xytrian is an endless flight runner where you pilot a spaceship through a dangerous course. Dodge obstacles, score points, and survive as long as you can! Click to control your shuttle and hit the timing perfectly! Only precise altitude changes will let you overcome the obstacles ahead.

title: Princess Lovely Fashion
description: This time, you are the fashion maker! Apply makeup and choose a beautiful outfit, and hairstyle to make them look stunning. Don't forget to take a photo with various effects. Play the best fashion game with Princess Lovely Fashion!

title: Clean Ocean
description:
Clean Ocean

With the game Clean Ocean it helps to clean the ocean in a fun way on your phone, tablet or computer.

Game developed by:
Nau.kids

Oceano Limpo

Com o jogo Clean Ocean ajuda a limpar o oceano de uma forma divertida no seu telemóvel, tablet ou computador.

Nau.kids

title: Ayla World Princess life
description: Step into the magical world of Ayla World: Princess Life, where you can live the ultimate princess adventure! This exciting game lets you dress up your avatar, create stunning outfits, and design beautiful nails with endless styles.

title: Snow Race 3d Fun Racing
description: Snow Race 3D: Fun Racing is an addictive arcade game. Do you want to participate in a snow race? This is probably the most fascinating and addictive game you have ever played! Collect the snow around you to make huge snowballs, then let them build ladders and climb to higher levels. Your opponents will have the same talent and you will have to race against time to race against them! Be the first to reach the finish line to win! Come join us and become a snowball master!

title: Hole Battle.io
description:
The battle between the holes is beginning in the arena! Pick your hole and join this battle! Eat fruits, planes, cars, and many things that come to mind, and grow as much as you can! Your goal is to eat things that are smaller than you and make your hole bigger than the enemy's. Avoid bigger holes and try to collect power-ups besides eatable items.
Four different great maps are waiting for you:
- 2048 Map
- World Map
- Stationary Map
- Kitchen Map

title: Sniper Master
description: Take aim in mid-air and strike at the perfect moment! In Sniper Master, you jump, float, and fire while airborne—time your shots to eliminate targets with clean, satisfying hits. Stay calm, lead your aim, and master precision shooting across multiple levels. Earn rewards, improve your skills, and become the ultimate airborne marksman.

title: Barrel Roller - Amazing Runner
description:
Collect and stack barrels, avoid obstacles, and make the highest barrel stack ever! 
Unlimited levels of stacking satisfaction!

title: Funny Cooking Camp
description: The great outdoors is calling! But the mice are starting to get hungry. Help them to built the clay oven and collect the items for the grill. Bake delicious pizza and grill the BBQ satays. Enjoy this funny camping game!

title: SnakeLands.io
description: The wild is alive with motion and danger. Rival snakes close in, waiting for a single mistake. Grow faster, bite harder and outsmart them all. Evolve beyond limits and show that only those with courage and cunning can claim true power.

title: Mermaidcore Makeup
description: In Mermaidcore Makeup, you ladies can step into the shoes of a talented makeup artist and work your magic on three stunning ladies. Journey into the realm of fantasy as you help these beauties achieve their perfect, enchanting looks. Prepare for a sensational trip filled with endless options as you explore an extensive selection of hairstyles, eyeshadows, mascara, lipsticks, face patterns, and intricate shoulder and neck patterns that perfectly match each girl's unique style and personality.

title: GT Formula Championship
description: GT Formula Championship is an exhilarating high-speed racing game that brings the thrill of Formula racing to life. Step into the driver’s seat of the most powerful and technologically advanced Formula cars as you compete against elite racers on world-class tracks. With intense competition, realistic physics, and breathtaking visuals, this game delivers an adrenaline-fueled experience like no other.

title: Merge Blocks 2048 Style!
description: ● A game with a summer atmosphere! Compete with friends and colleagues?! In the game you have a playing area? where cubes fall and merge if they have the same number! Merge as many cubes as possible to make the biggest one, save up points?! Be the first on the leaderboard?! Play and relax ?!

title: Penguin Farm - Ice Merge
description:
Explore a world of frozen islands where penguins run their own farm. Collect resources, merge wood, build and upgrade buildings to open up new territories. Develop your settlement step by step, expand your glaciers, and watch your income grow.
Train your penguins, improve production, and head to the ocean for rewards—there drift chests filled with valuable treasures. Upgrade each building, manage your resources, and turn your small island into a thriving icy farm.

title: House Deep Clean Sim
description:
House Deep Clean Sim is a home-themed cleaning game with a strong sense of experience. It has 9 scenes for you to clean, which are fence, sculpture, trampoline, pool, robot, fountain, ground,
car, and dining table. Not only does it have a rich scene, but it also has everything you need for a clean game, such as full 3D effects, resizable nozzle size, and the ability to move around at will.  Try it if you are interested. Have fun.

title: Mad Medicine
description: Mad Medicine - a casual humorous health-themed runner. Collect first aid kits and other useful resources to get your character into a healthy athletic shape. Be attentive and avoid crippling obstacles. The better your fitness the easier it will be to win the final race.

title: Basketball Life 3d
description: Ready for the wonderful basketball challenge? Basketball Life 3D is a fun and creative sports game that tests your skills and timing! From classic hoop challenges to trick shots, every level is packed with excitement.

title: Train Drift
description: Train Drifting is an addictive arcade racing game that offers players a unique and incredible train drifting experience. In this game you will become a real master of drifting on iron horses.

title: Matrix Typer
description: Type like a hacker, train like a pro. Dodge incoming code, out-type digital attacks, and prove you can survive inside the system. Every word you type is a bullet dodged; every mistake, a strike you take.

title: Drawing Squares
description:
Drawing Squares is the logic game that will blow your mind!
It is a logic game inspired by the classic pen and paper game Dots and Boxes. Do you remember the game you used to play at school? (also known as Boxes, Squares, Paddocks, Pigs in a Pen, Square-it, Dots and Dashes, Dots, Smart Dots, Dot Boxing, or, simply, the Dot Game).

title: Prom Night Dress Up
description:
High school is over, and prom night is ahead! 6 girl friends are going to the prom. Which of them will become the new prom queen? Each girl is gorgeous and has an incredible fashion taste. Pick the best trendy dresses and other fancy items for the girls!

In this makeover / dress up game for girls and fashionistas there are over 200 clothing items, all available completely free without any annoying locks or in-app purchases. Actually, none of our dress games for girls ever demand real money!

title: Fallling Jewels
description:
Unearth the Ultimate Fortune! ?
Step into a world of sparkling gems and addictive puzzles! In this fast-paced match-3 challenge, your goal is to harvest as many dazzling Jewels as you can.

Master the Mechanics: Slide left or right to align your gems, flick up to rotate for the perfect fit, and slam down to drop!

 Blast the Board: Earn explosive rewards and deploy them strategically to shatter obstacles and clear the way to a high score.

Are you ready to shine? Start matching today!

title: Moto Attack Bike Racing
description: Moto Attack - Bike Racing is a fun bike racing simulator that takes speed and action to the next level. Drive your motorcycle and race against opponents. Vocabulary enrichment
Suitable for all ages

title: Sausage Man Shooting Adventure
description: Dive into a hilarious and action-packed adventure. Sausage Man Shooting Adventure is a fast-paced side-scrolling shooting game where you control a crazy, energetic sausage hero and blast through waves of enemies. Run forward, dodge traps, jump platforms, and shoot enemies with nonstop excitement! Collect airdrops to increase your damage.

title: Pursuit Rampage
description: In Pursuit Rampage, you’re behind the wheel of a police car in an endless, high-speed chase. Navigate through busy streets, dodge obstacles, and close in on criminals while keeping your cool under pressure. The game constantly pushes your reflexes to the limit, with each second offering a new challenge. Whether you're weaving through traffic or speeding down back alleys, the action never lets up.

title: Vortex io
description:
Play Vortex.io for free! Swallow everything in your path and become the biggest vortex in this fast-paced io game.

Vortex.io is a competitive .io game where you control a growing vortex that can swallow objects, vehicles, and even other players. As you absorb more items, your size increases, making you more powerful in the arena. The game features smooth controls and intense gameplay, requiring quick reflexes and smart movement to survive and dominate your rivals in real time.

title: Erase the extra element
description: Sharpen your focus and logic in Erase the Extra Element! Erase parts of each scene to reveal clues and solve tricky visual puzzles.

title: Mini Skin Doctor
description: The crazy experiments in the laboratory have side effects on Mini and this is your chance to learn how to treat them! Explore the medical tools, some of them are really cool! You can use different lasers to treat the skin break outs, but also spa masks to calm down the skin. Discover all the tools and take care of Mini, he will certainly feel better after the treatment!

title: London Taxi Driver
description: Drive Taxi in the capital of Great Britain - London. Pick up peaople on bus stops and take them to destination point wichh you can find on GPS screen in the car. Be careful with your passengers and have fun! Use Arrows or WASD to drive.

title: Zoo Trivia
description: Time to show off your animal knowledge! How many of them do you know? Can you spell the names correctly? Dozens of animals are waiting for you. Mammals, dogs, cats, fish, insects and much more! It's harder than you think! But don't worry, you can still use the elegant hint system to help you overcome difficulties.

title: Coloring And Learn
description: "Coloring and Learn" is a realistic coloring game for all ages!."Free mode": now you can freely draw, doodle, color and unleash your imagination. "Glow coloring mode": Create magic doodle artwork with neon paint! Explore the wonderful world of color! The whole family, parents, and children will have hours of fun together!

title: Math vs Bat
description:
Bats are invading our tower! Solve the math question, and attack the bat with your cannon.

Covers addition, subtraction, division and multiplication questions.

How high can you score?

Features:

- Interactive tutorial
- Kid friendly theme
- Multiple game modes to choose from, including a mixed question mode
- Linearly increasing math challenges

title: Doll Sister Throat Doctor
description: Super Doll's Sister has a throat infection! Let's go to the doctor and find out how we can help our patient. Use fun tools to treat the symptoms and then go even further getting a closer look with the magnifying glass. Find and destroy the germs using a laser gun and apply cream on the affected areas. The little one will be recovering in no time!

title: Robin Hood Archer
description: Enter a game of archery where distance means danger and victory demands precision. Each rival stands between you and glory. From armor to arrows, sharpen your edge. The farther the shot, the sweeter the win. How far will your skill take you?

title: Dino Ranch
description:
JON & BLITZ - IT’S VELOCI-TIME!
• Throwing the lasso to the escaped compies
• Dodging herds of ankylosaurus.
• Finding the naughty compies.
• Feeding Angus.
• Flying and dodging objects with Pteddy
• Moving the dinosaurs to the stable.
• Challenging the Trihorn Raptor to a race.
• Helping the compies to jump across the river.

title: Sweet Candy
description: Sweet Candy is a Match  game with  unique levels Switch and match  or more candy to reach level target and unlock the next level

title: Tetro Merge
description:
Tetro Merge is a physics-based merge puzzle game where Tetromino blocks come to life.
You’ll drop Tetrominoes of all shapes—classic, extended, and brand-new originals. When two matching pieces touch, they merge into a bigger, more complex block.
Master the bounce, plan your stacks, and build powerful combos as the board slowly fills up.
Will you manage your space wisely… or let the blocks overflow?
A perfect blend of strategy, physics, and classic Tetris nostalgia.

title: Inferno
description: Do you have what it takes to be the best firefighter ever? Fight the onslaught of fire in 20+ action-packed levels where you’ll have to outrun the clock and put the fire out before it consumes it all… even you! But beware: with a limited stash of water, you’ll need to use strategy and precision to make every drop count! Power-Ups, Achievements and High Scores await! It’s getting hot in here…

title: Flag Master: World Flags Quiz
description: Flag Master is the ultimate test of your flag knowledge and geography skills! Paint and recreate flags, solve jigsaw puzzles, guess capitals, match neighboring countries, and take on a variety of engaging challenges in a fun, fast-paced experience.

title: Rich Choice Run
description: Rich Choice Run is a fun swipe runner where every decision shapes your final lifestyle. Slide left and right to pick the best “boyfriend” choices and grab expensive items along the way. Your choices build your value and status—choose wisely, because one bad pick can ruin your chance.

title: Kiss O Neck
description:
Kiss O Neck: Stretch, Kiss, and Laugh Out Loud
Each level brings a new, funny, and totally unexpected situation.
You never know what’s going to happen when you stretch that neck a little further

title: Sorcerer Mahjong Marvels
description: Step into the Sorcerer Mahjong Marvels. Match mystical tiles adorned with enchanting artifacts. Collect only open tiles that don't have adjacent tiles to the left or right. Gather all the tile sets to win each level. Conquer 60 levels within the time limits to complete this game. Uncover magical secrets to become the ultimate magician!

title: Grass Cut Master
description: Grass Cut Master is a fun hypercasual simulation game. You have to cut the grass on different platforms within the limited time.  For a more efficient farming, you can improve your vehicle's capacity, blade length  and blade speed level by level. You can get faster and faster and earn more income.

title: Pipe Puzzle: Connect & Flow
description:
Pipe Puzzle: Connect & Flow – Relaxing Brain Teaser
Connect the pipes, let the water flow, and solve hundreds of satisfying puzzles!
Pipe Puzzle: Connect & Flow is a relaxing and addictive puzzle game where your mission is simple: fix the pipes and restore the flow of water. Perfect for all ages, it's the ultimate brain exercise you can play anytime, anywhere.

title: Metro Bus Simulator
description: Now you will drive city metro bus game on special roads in the city and mountains. City metro bus is a double cabin long 8x8 wheeler metro bus that is driven on special decorated roads in city and mountains. Pick passengers, drive this city metro coach bus through the hilly area and drop passengers on their desired destinations. Slow down the speed of metro bus while driving in huge traffic in the city to avoid crashes.

title: Plants Vs Zombies War
description: Plants Vs Zombies War is based on the famous PC game called Plants VS Zombies. This tower-defense strategy game needs your plans to fight against 15 kinds of incoming zombies. You can check the consumption and attack of all of your 15 plants before the battle. Then the tutorial will show the basic rules and plants at Level 1. The more levels you complete, the more plants you can unlock. You could also unlock them from ads in advance.

title: Tap It Away 3D
description: Tap It Away 3D is a fun and relaxing 3D block puzzle game. Tap the arrows to move and clear blocks, solve brain-teasing puzzles, and plan your moves carefully as blocks can block each other. Enjoy smooth, stress-free gameplay with no time limits. Play this free online puzzle game to relax, sharpen your logic, and train your brain anytime.

title: Tictoc Paris Fashion
description:
This beautiful girl is taking a trip to Paris. She needs your help to make her into a tictoc star by making her fashionable in Paris. Follow the hint
to choose the right make up, clothes, hairstyles, and accessories for her. Make her look stylish on every reel. Get many likes and earn money to buy new items.

title: Little Princess Dentist Adventure
description: Little Anna likes sugar most. She eats a lot of sugar every day, but she doesn't like brushing her teeth. This annoys her parents and Elsa. This day, Anna's teeth were very painful while eating sugar, so Elsa accompanied her to the dentist. Is Anna's teeth bad? Please come to play as a dentist and heal Anna's teeth.

title: Bouncy Barn
description:
Bouncy Barn is a lively farm simulation game where players explore the charming world of farm life. Care for cute animals like chickens, cows, and goats. 

Feed and nurture your animals to keep them happy, and in return, they’ll provide valuable produce like eggs and milk. Harvest these goodies and sell them at the market to earn profits for expanding and upgrading your farm. With vibrant graphics and engaging gameplay, Bouncy Barn provides a fun escape to create your dream farm!

title: Memoji
description: Match pairs of emojis and word cards to uncover and learn about a significant historical event from around the world each day.

title: Pickle Ball Clash
description: Step into the fast-paced world of Pickle Ball Clash — a thrilling sports game where every match is a battle of skill, speed, and strategy. Customize your character, unlock powerful paddles, and climb the competitive ranks from backyard brawls to pro-level leagues. Whether you're smashing winners or pulling off trick shots, the court is yours to conquer. Are you ready to clash?

title: Homemade Ice Cream Cooking
description: Yummy Ice cream is all over this game and it seems like you are about to create the tastiest dessert using your skills and your imagination too This is actually a cooking game where you get to make this sweet dish and also you will be asked to find a proper design for it too Think about a delicious design and follow the instructions to finish this frozen challenge

title: Hill Climb Pixel Car
description: Hill Climb Pixel Car is an off-road racing game where riders race over rough terrains such as dirt, sand, mud, or grass tracks. You will need to control your bike skillfully to overcome different obstacles and perform spectacular jump scenes. Race as fast as possible and become the only champion of this motocross championship.

title: Brainrot World Hole.io
description: Brainrot World Hole.io is a hilarious casual hole game packed with chaotic brainrot energy and funny Italian meme vibes. Control a growing hole and dive into a crazy world where swallowing everything in sight is the key to victory. Move around the map and collect objects smaller than your hole.

title: Tap Car
description:
Unveil stunning car masterpieces by solving image puzzles. Every tap reveals more of the picture—can you uncover them all? A must-play for car enthusiasts and puzzle lovers alike!

Would you like a few more variations depending on the tone you're aiming for (like more casual, exciting, or elegant)?

title: Tomb Of The Mask Color
description: In these 100 mazes, paint the whole maze, and you need to avoid the oncoming obstacles. How many levels can you pass?

title: Soccer Duel
description: An exciting game in the style of table football, which you can play both alone and with friends on the same device or over the network.

title: Hot & Cold Winter Style
description: Princesses Eliza and Milana are going on winter vacation, but for each of the girls, winter vacation will be special. Eliza lives in snowy regions and loves fluffy fur coats, warm scarves and winter dresses. Milana celebrates her holidays under palm trees and chooses swimsuits, light capes and bright accessories. Players will have to create stylish images, combining the cold shine of snow and the warm glow of the tropics. Help Eliza and Milana become the most fashionable princesses of winter!

title: Nail Doctor
description: Nail Doctor is one of the best nail surgery game for who love to play surgery game. Here in this game, you have various patients with injured toes so become a real doctor treat them with real surgeon tools.

title: Foam and Find
description: Foam and Find is a relaxing hidden object game with a playful bubble twist. Explore cozy houses, each filled with charming rooms and easy-to-spot hidden items. Your tasks appear inside floating bubbles — and when you find an item, it flies into its bubble and pops with a satisfying animation. No timers, no stress — just a calm, casual experience at your own pace.

title: Hide Ball
description: Hide Ball is an addictive puzzle game where your mission is to protect the red ball from dangerous spiky enemies. Use the given blocks to build a safe shelter and hide the ball. Each level brings a new challenge — the constructions become trickier, and the enemies more relentless. Plan your moves, create a solid defense, and save your little hero!

title: Clash & Run
description: One chance, no turning back. Speed is your only ally in a world that won’t wait. Race through ever-shifting terrain where every jump could be your last. Collect coins and unlock unique looks. Precision and quick thinking will keep you in the game longer.

title: Winter Tetrix Trails
description:
Winter Tetrix Trails is a relaxing shape-filling puzzle game set in a snowy world.
Drag and place colorful Tetris-style blocks to complete each unique silhouette — think carefully, fit perfectly, and enjoy the magic of winter puzzles!

title: Weapons and Ragdolls
description: Weapons and Ragdolls is an action-packed game featuring stickman characters and realistic physics. Use a wide range of weapons, from explosives to swords and firearms, while upgrading your arsenal to take on tougher challenges. Face diverse enemies, utilize slow-motion dodging, and enjoy randomly generated battles with increasing difficulty. Each fight offers a chance to refine your combat skills and try different strategies. Get ready for endless action and excitement!

title: Ice Queen
description: Ice Queen is an exciting, adventure-based game in which players can explore a world of ice and snow, all while completing levels, collecting ice creams, and eating sweets. Immerse yourself in the Ice Queen world as you make your way through each level, overcoming each obstacle the game throws at you.

title: Tile Adventure
description: A fun and satisfying tile-matching puzzle game! Match tiles in sets of three, clear the board, and enjoy a relaxing, brain-teasing experience. With smooth gameplay, colorful visuals, and levels that gradually increase in challenge, it’s perfect for anyone who loves casual puzzles. (Inspired by the classic Mahjong layout, but with a fresh, modern twist!)

title: Hidden Mushrooms
description:
Hidden Mushrooms is a game for nature lovers and those who enjoy walking in the woods. Beautiful views of nature in different forests, fields, swamps and other places. Birds singing and cute animals help you relax, and the search for hidden mushrooms captures your attention.
You will spend time usefully, because the game perfectly trains your observation skills!
Do you like hidden object searches? Then be sure to try to find hidden mushrooms!

title: Fishing Fishes
description:
Fish some fishes in Fishing Fishes with your fishing fishers


You'll start with a basic fishing setup, you get fishes and you can use them to buy new fishers and other upgrades that will help you get even more fish!


With intuitive controls, Fishing Fishes is a perfect game for anyone who loves fishing or management games. So what are you waiting for?

title: Bloom Sort 2: Bee Puzzle
description: Dive into the enchanting world of Bloom Sort 2: Bee Puzzle, where flowers bloom, bees buzz, and your mind gets a delightful workout! This unique 3D puzzle game combines stunning 2D and 3D graphics with a relaxing, chill vibe, making it the perfect escape for players of all ages.

title: Cosmic Tetriz Puzzles
description: Join a cosmic puzzle adventure where Tetriz meets pixel art. Place colorful Tetriz-style pieces on a grid to create shapes, ranging from easy to complex. Each piece has its own spot, adding to the challenge. Complete 45 levels, solving cosmic Tetriz puzzles in a space-themed setting. Can you beat this cosmic challenge before time's up?

title: Arrowtix - Train Your Brain
description: Arrowtix is a satisfying, brain-teasing puzzle game where your goal is to clear the board by sliding tangled arrows out of the grid. But there's a catch: each arrow can only move in the direction it's pointing, and its escape path must be completely empty! With 60 tricky levels spread across Normal, Medium, and Hard difficulties, Arrowtix will test your spatial logic and strategic thinking. Can you untangle the mess and clear the board?

title: Mommy Accident ER
description: Mommy tripped and fell while chasing the cat around the house, oops! Go to the emergency room with her and be her doctor in this amazing new game. Check her pulse because she got pretty scared and she needs to be stable, then go ahead and treat her wounds. Learn how to give the pregnant mommy an injection and you are all set! The patient will be ready to go home and enjoy the rest of the day in no time.

title: Cat Girl Christmas Decor Game
description: Welcome to Cat Girl Christmas Decor Game. Christmas is around the corner. Cat Girl is more excited than us to enjoy this Christmas with her friends. She has some crazy ideas to make this Christmas more fun! Join and help her to bake and decorate cakes, a Christmas tree, Cookies, and her house.

title: Baby Hazel Christmas Surprise
description: Christmas time is here again! Baby Hazel and friends are eagerly waiting for Santa Claus to come and give them presents. Santa has brought gifts for all the kids in his magical toy bag. Oh no! But Hazel's gift is missing. Santa has lost Hazel's gift somewhere in North Pole. Let's join Santa and kids to enjoy a sleigh ride to snow-clad North Pole and help them to find Hazel's lost gift.

title: Gun Rush
description: Begin an action-packed gun battle runner. Gun Rush is an electrifying arcade game that combines gun merging with platform running. Run forward, avoid obstacles, collect weapons, and blast your way to the finish line with ultimate firepower. Control the direction of your gun, shooting power, ATK speed, and Range to increase its value. Increase your damage by using high-value doors.

title: Jewels Mine
description:
Jewels Mine is a fun match 3 game. 

Swap and match 3 or more gems of the same type and make points and special power ups.

Earn points and compete with your friends and with all other players around the world in the global leaderboards!

title: Xmas Rush
description: Xmas Rush is fun addictive racing game.You have to finish the game in given time.Be Careful about the turn and other vehicles.Going off road and bump into other vehicles will slow down your speed . This game is based on Christmas theme This game is perfect for the Christmas.

title: Dino Digg
description: Dino Dig: Collect, Clean, Build! Exciting dino adventure in your pocket. Dig, find bones, clean 'em, and build your own dino museum. Easy, fun, and perfect for all ages!

title: Brainrot-A Difference Challenge
description: Put your observation skills to the test in Brainrot – A Difference Challenge, the ultimate photo puzzle game! Spot subtle differences between two eerily similar Italian "brainrot" images across a series of mind-bending levels. Each pair of pictures will challenge your focus, attention to detail, and visual memory. Can you find them all before time runs out?

title: Unscrew Them All
description: Unscrew Them All is a challenging  puzzle game where players must strategically unscrew all the screws securing large wooden planks to the board. After removing each screw, place it into the correct open slot. Unscrew all the planks before time runs out to complete each level. Master every level to win the game!

title: Happy Glass Game
description: Happy Glass is a fun and engaging puzzle game where your goal is to fill an empty glass with water. Draw lines to create a path for the water to flow into the glass. The less you draw, the higher your score. With 80 challenging levels, you’ll need to use your creativity and logic to make the glass happy again. Enjoy this delightful game on both desktop and mobile devices!

title: Magic Brick Wars
description:
Magic Brick Wars is the premium version of the quirky tower defence game you love! Exclusive to this version of Magic Brick Wars - enjoy uninterrupted strategic action.

Welcome to the magic world of Magic Brick Wars. Fight wars with your favorite characters from games like Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride using your own Raskulls!

title: Girl Fashion Closet
description: Barbie, a beautiful girl! Now let's visit her fashion closet! In her closet, there are so many fashion outfits, earrings, necklaces, shoes, and bags. Help her try different outfits and match some accessories. Have fun!

title: Draw Wheels
description:
Draw bike wheels to win the race!
Become the best player!
Unleash your creativity!
Play right now and have fun with our game!

title: Slinger Block
description: Guide a red square through compact grid-based puzzles filled with sliding blocks and locked paths. Clear the way, collect every yellow key, unlock the yellow door, and reach the exit to win. Simple rules, clever layouts, and satisfying logic challenges make each level a fun brain teaser.

title: Turbo Trucks Race
description: Turbo Truck Race, an intense racing game with diverse trucks, unique abilities, and action-packed modes. Experience the adrenaline with realistic graphics, strategic gameplay, and the freedom to explore different landscapes in FreeMap mode. Turbo Truck Race brings a new level of excitement with powerful trucks!

title: High School Anime Dress Up
description:
Kawaii dress up games for girls: fun high school anime doll dress up and make up
High School Anime Dress Up and Make Up games for girls — for all those who like dressing up cute Japanese school girl, manga comics, moe anime girls, otaku. College girl games offline are here for you! Dress up girls and create the most fashionable outfits with hundreds of items, all clothes are free.

Cool anime dress up games for girls: dress up the kawaii doll and Japanese high school girls, When you've completed the best outfit in free girls game for your doll, press the "Camera" button to create a screenshot. Share the picture with your friends to to show off your talent to your friends and use it as anime wallpaper!

title: Basketball Simulator 3D
description: Basketball Simulator 3D is the sports simulation game in which you can prove your basketball skills by making shots from all different distances. First select your favorite team and then make shots before the time runs out. Make as many as you can to get a high score that you can be proud of. Use WASD or Arrows to run, Mouse to make shoot (press LMB to detrmen shot fource), P to pause the game.

title: Animals Merge
description:
Animal Merge is a merge puzzle game like 2048.
Use your strategy to drop the animals into lines so that they can join together to unlock a new one which will have a bigger number.
Will you be able to unlock all the animals?
Play and have fun!

title: Funny Rescue Sumo
description: The sumo looks so messy after his battle. Rescue him immediately. Help him recover from the wounds and don't forget to give hime some makeover.

title: Labrador at the Doctor Salon
description: There are no better ways you could prove your love and affection to dogs than helping them to get healthier and more beautiful This animal game will let you know how to take a good care of a dental hygiene and also of a total nursing when it comes to looking after a nice Labrador Clean the ears and make the fur all shiny again with the whole spa treatment you are going to offer to this little dog

title: Baby Piano Children Song
description:
Do you like playing musical instruments? If you love music, we have just the game for you. This educational game offers 5 musical instruments to choose from. They are piano, xylophone, flute, drums, and guitar. You can select the instrument you are interested in playing. Apart from
offering a wide range of instruments, this game lets you choose your favorite music.

title: Princess Rescue: Save Girl
description: Dive into a heart-pounding quest in Princess Rescue: Save Girl, a thrilling puzzle adventure full of danger, strategy, and fast-paced action! If you're into dragon-themed puzzles that test your reflexes and thinking skills, this is your next favorite game.

title: Doc Darling Bone Surgery
description: Oh no, the girl just fell off her scooter and she needs Doc Darling to take care of her injuries. Play as a doctor who cures the injuries and fix all of the broken bones to get the girl back on her feet. Complete all of the stages to unlock dress up mode and give her a cute makeover.

title: Funny Tattoo Shop
description: Choose from the three sets of choices, and you'll be given the piece that you will then tattoo to your chosen model. Do the stencil, make the outline and color it according to your piece. After finishing your artwork, dress up your model that suits the tattoo you have created. Finish the game and unlock all the achievements. Share your screenshots to other players of the game. Have fun tattooing!

title: Julias Food Truck
description:
Help Julia run her burger food truck. Her goal is to prepare the most delicious burgers.
Her little food truck is constantly visited by hungry customers. 
Each customer approaches the food truck and orders his favorite burger. 
Julia has very little time to prepare the meal, but if she manages to do that quickly, customers are very generous.

title: Italian Brainrot Drag Merge Puzzle
description: A Revolutionary Jigsaw Experience. Each level, one image is randomly selected and split into 3×3, 4×4, 5×5, or 6×6 pieces, then completely shuffled. Your goal is simple: restore the picture by placing every piece in its correct position. But this is no ordinary jigsaw. When two neighboring pieces are placed correctly next to each other, they merge into a single movable cluster. Instead of slow, one-by-one placement, you can drag any piece or merged group onto another to instantly swap positions.

title: Toka Boka Home Clean Up Design
description: A new family has just arrived in this town, and they're in desperate need of your assistance. This isn't just a helping hand mission; it's a home transformation and management simulator! You need to help them clean dust, clean the home, rearrange clothes, design the house, and repair damaged things.

title: Zumble Story
description: Explore every corner of the jungle, create combinations and shoot colorful marbles. With each level, face unique challenges and utilize powerful boosters to enhance your skills. Unlock exciting chapters, conquer obstacles, and experience a vibrant journey full of surprises!

title: Gun Shooting Games Sniper 3D
description: Step into the battlefield and test your precision in Gun Shooting Games: Sniper 3D, an exciting fps experience packed with nonstop action. This immersive first person shooting game puts you in the role of an elite sniper armed with powerful weapons and challenging missions.

title: Color Nonogram Puzzle 2
description: Relaxing Color Nonogram is a vibrant logic puzzle game where every grid reveals stunning pixel art. Solve colorful nonogram challenges, train your brain, and enjoy a calm, stress-free experience. Perfect for fans of Picross and classic logic puzzles, this free nonogram game blends strategy, creativity, and relaxation. Discover hundreds of levels, improve focus, and unwind anytime with satisfying color puzzle gameplay designed for both beginners and experts.

title: Car Jam: Traffic Puzzle
description: Get ready for Car Jam: Traffic Puzzle, the ultimate test of logic and fun! Untangle the traffic, move the cars, and clear the way in this addictive puzzle adventure. With every level, new challenges appear—packed parking lots, tricky buses, and colorful traffic jams waiting for your brainpower. Easy to play, hard to master, and endlessly entertaining.

title: Unscrew Wood Puzzle
description: Unscrew Wood Puzzle: Screw Jam is an engaging puzzle game that combines logic, strategy, and dexterity in a tactile experience. Players are challenged to solve intricate puzzles involving bolts, nuts, and screws. With hundreds of unique levels, this game provides a blend of relaxation and mental stimulation, perfect for casual gamers and puzzle enthusiasts alike. The beautifully designed wooden and metallic elements create a visually appealing and satisfying gameplay experience.

title: Wood Screw Puzzle
description: Wood Screw Puzzle is a satisfying logic game where you untangle wood screws, nuts, and bolts from clever wooden structures. Each level challenges your spatial thinking as you analyze, plan, and carefully unscrew fasteners in the right order. Beautiful visuals and tactile mechanics make every puzzle feel rewarding and immersive.

title: Angry City Smasher
description: Angry City Smasher is a third-person RPG fighting simulation game with 3D-armed gorillas. Your goal is to defeat the enemy monster and destroy the marked number of buildings. Use the Ultimate Smash to make AOE damage and destroy more buildings with one hit. To be honest, it is necessary to defeat your opponent first because it will run to you on the level. No one wants to be disturbed by others. Good luck!

title: Car Eats Car: Sea Adventure
description: Up for a fight against rivals in a dynamic race on the highway? Overtake enemies and create your own car in the incubator in Car Eats Car: Sea Adventure! Your friends are put to prison - do everything you can to free evil cars! Good driving skills and turbo speed come in handy in this crazy driving simulator and a police chase game. Become a car tycoon, upgrade cars, and play for monster cars against the cops! Fight the boss to survive in these ultimate crazy races!

title: Light Line
description: Can you fill this maze with a single touch? Light Line is a game where you fill in every empty square with a single touch. Try harder stages as much as possible. Move the light lines to the delight of filling in the blanks perfectly.

title: Escape the Horror Craft
description:
Immerse yourself in a thrilling horror adventure set in the Minecraft universe. A regular, unassuming worker in Minecraft's universe becomes disoriented and has to figure out how to get out of each level and map in order to do the jobs.

A Minecraft nightmare comes to life in this eerie, ghostly realm. Stay calm as you navigate the terrain in search of an escape. Is it possible to complete each level without dying? If you're looking for a new game to play, check out kiz10.com.

title: Ice Queen Twins Birth
description: Call  because the Ice Queen is about to have two beautiful babies Gather all the important things you need in the hospital and keep the Ice Queen relaxed until the ambulance arrives Have fun learning how to take care of the two cute babies and make sure the three of them get home happy and healthy

title: Bubble Shooter Aura
description:
Bubble Shooter Aura brings a fresh, glowing twist to the classic bubble-shooting experience.
Enter a world of soft colors, smooth animations, and relaxing “aura” effects as you match and pop bubbles to clear levels and reach high scores.

Perfect for both casual players and bubble shooter fans, this game offers intuitive controls, satisfying gameplay, and a modern look that feels calm, fun, and addictive.

title: Slide Block Puzzle
description: Slide Block Puzzle is an addictive puzzle game. With no timer or pressure, every move is a calming and satisfying challenge for your brain. Solve color block puzzles, arrange blocks to escape from challenging boxes, a game that provides a fun and satisfying experience.

title: OMG Word Rainbow
description: Step into the vibrant world of OMG Word Rainbow, an engaging word finder game illuminated by the beauty of the rainbow. Explore a colorful mosaic of letter tiles, where drawing lines along neighboring letters unveils words inspired by the enchanting spectrum of colors; enhance your journey with rewarded ads, allowing players to effortlessly skip levels in this captivating linguistic adventure.

title: Wooden Fish
description: Merit wooden fish, calm down~ Pinch the bubbles on the bubble paper, pick petals, Tic-Tac-Toe and other games, each game is easy to understand, helping players relax and say goodbye to unhappiness!

title: Save the cats - Bubble shooter
description:
Think strategically, aim, shoot and get rid of all the bubbles.

Explore hundreds of levels with different levels of difficulty.

Be as accurate as possible to free all the cats.

Buy and use boosters on challenging levels.

To win - clear the field of all the balloons.

title: Gun Builder
description: Defeat all incoming enemies, and protect yourself from attacks! Pick up props to strengthen your attacks, but be careful—once your health reaches zero, the mission is over. Ready to experience the action? Play now!

title: Barbee Met Gala Transformation
