Choose your favorite 4x4 Jeep and show the world what you have got. Collect checkpoints to stay in the game and try not to run out of time. The best part is that you do not have to unlock any Jeep, just tighten your seat belt and get right into it.

title: Potion Merge Witch
description:
Combine magical potions to create bigger ones! Potion Merge Witch brings you a relaxing and magical merging experience. Can you create the ultimate potion? Try it now!

- Combine identical potions to create new, bigger ones.
- Use three special buttons:  shake the cauldron, remove a potion or upgrade potions to speed up merging.

Help the witch craft the biggest and most powerful potion ever!

title: Escape Ancient Egypt
description:
a 3D puzzle game in the mysterious ruins of the ancient Egypt, on the footsteps of Cleopatra and the pharaohs.
Can you escape from the pharaoh's curse? Solve the puzzles and unlock the next room, turn on the brain, you'll need it to open all the doors that will allow you to escape.

title: Real Parkour Simulator
description: Real Parkour Simulator is an addictive 3D parkour adventure game. You play as an ambitious protagonist determined to conquer the world of parkour. Taking you on an exciting journey to new heights as you run, jump and climb in an immersive world. Will you rise to the challenge and become a parkour master?

title: Dottie Doc McStuffins Cupcake Maker
description:
Cupcake Maker! Dottie Doc McStuffins Chef.
Be a mini Cupcake Maker chef. Hello, Chef, you are invited in the Dottie Doc McStuffins yummy cupcake maker online free game. We all love delicious sweet cupcakes. Come on, how could you miss our Cupcake Maker? And here comes a brand new dottie mcstuffins cupcake. Instantly play your favorite free online game Cupcake Maker .
Let's play.

title: The Shape
description: "The Shape" is an online geometrical puzzle game where players create figures based on given references. This fun, educational experience is suitable for all ages, featuring a seamless, gesture-based user interface.

title: My Hospital Learn Care
description: This is a doll placement simulation game. Have you ever wanted to run a hospital by yourself? Do you want to be a doctor? This game of ours can fulfill your wish. You can build a hospital Avatar world of your own.

title: Brainrot Hook Swing
description: Brainrot Hook Swing is an addictive physics-based platformer where players control the Brainrot swinging through levels using a grappling hook. With smooth animations, challenging obstacles, and fun physics mechanics, the game tests your timing and precision as you swing from one point to another, avoiding obstacles and making daring jumps to reach the finish line.

title: Popcorn Master
description:
Burst popcorn and complete all the popcorn making levels! Pop the popcorn bursting and shoot the popcorns out of it.   
 
Best ASMR casual puzzle game to get you relaxed. Relax yourself with casual puzzle popcorn bursting game and pop your way to the top!

title: Witch & Fairy BFF
description: Two unusual girlfriends - a Fairy and a Witch - study together, although they are so different. Fairy, with her delicate pink outfits and impeccable sense of style, is always ready to offer fashion tips and create vivid images. Her girlfriend-Witch, who prefers a Gothic style, chooses mysterious and gloomy outfits. Players will be able to help both heroines choose outfits for various events. Join magical friends in their exciting fashion adventure where style and magic go hand in hand!

title: Hospital Doctor Emergency Room
description: Do you want to be a doctor? Great, your patients are waiting for you. Hurry Doctor.

title: Poke The Presidents
description: "Poke the President" is the perfect stress-reliever game. Defeat politicians by throwing various weapons. The objective is to creatively inflict damage upon the politicians and watch them react in humorous and exaggerated ways. Earn money to buy various weapons and items in the shop. Have fun!

title: OUTSIDE
description:
OUTSIDE is a sleek and minimal puzzle game where every move matters. Guide a one-eyed character through a grid to collect the key and reach the exit — but there’s a twist: once you start moving, you won’t stop until you hit a wall.

Plan your route carefully, avoid dead ends, and use the environment to your advantage. With simple mechanics and clean visuals, OUTSIDE is easy to pick up but tough to master — a perfect test of logic and spatial thinking.

title: Cooking Mania Express
description: Prepare, cook and serve in an amazing cooking game! Cooking Mania Express is one of the most engaging and addictive restaurant cooking games with strategy and simulation fun along with fast action, this game will bring you a better cooking experience. Satisfy incoming customers and grow your business with the right sequence and strategy.

title: Airport Manager Simulator
description: Airport Manager Simulator game is easy and interesting simple games for everyone whose dream job is to be flight attendants when they grow up. Keep passengers happy, cook and serve food on the plane, clean the cabin after each landing and do much more!

title: BFFs Y2K Fashion
description: Welcome to BFFs Y2K Fashion, the exciting new fashion designer game that lets you explore the trend of the year 2000! With a wide selection of styles from the decade, you can create the perfect look and express your fashion sense. From skater girl skirts to ripped jeans and t-shirts, or even the classic Y2K look with fun-colored low-waisted jeans and crop tops, you can customize your outfit and become an ultimate fashion designer. Play now and let your style shine!

title: Stickman Team Detroit
description:
It's team time now! Cartoon character The game of Team Detroit is fun to watch. A gang of robbers is threatening the city of Detroit, but three little stick figures will come together to stop them.

Take pleasure in killing off enemy stickmen while using any of the three playable characters. Because of their unique abilities and weaponry, each playable character is tailor-made for their specific role.

title: Basket Swap
description: Slide into the gray blocks to help you position the ball and grid correctly. If you're stuck, click on the arrow in the bottom left corner to undo your last move, or press R to restart the level.

title: Hand Doctor
description: Today you’re doctors on a special mission to cure all hand injuries of your clumsy patients! Hand Doctor game offers all an incredible virtual surgery experience that’ll make you feel like real doctor working in a hospital.

title: Idle Airport CEO
description:
Step into the shoes of a savvy CEO and take control of your very own airport!

As you progress, collect passengers and upgrade your capabilities to increase plane capacity, speed, and efficiency. Optimize check-in times, revenue streams, and airline services to keep your customers happy and coming back for more.

Oh, and did we mention that your money is piling up as we speak? Go offline, return and claim profits.

title: ChristmasFishing.io
description: In this fun and easy-to-play game, you are about to be the first fisherman ever who reached the ocean floor. Collect Christmas treasures to buy fishing upgrades to reach deeper depths. Explore magic Christmas fishing! Experience all of this with a beautiful art style.

title: Tile Pair Match
description: Tile Pair Match is a relaxing puzzle game where you connect matching tiles to clear the board. Find identical pairs and link them with a path of up to three turns. Plan your moves carefully, use empty spaces strategically, and complete each stage before time runs out. With colorful visuals and simple controls, it is easy to play but offers satisfying brain challenges for all ages.

title: Taxi Driver Simulator
description: Taxi Driver Simulator offers an immersive experience behind the wheel of a taxi. Complete Work Mode’s 80 levels with 3 yellow stars to become an eligible taxi driver. Follow the blue direction indicators, pick up passengers, and deliver them to their destinations efficiently. Slow down before steering to save time. Don’t forget to buy the other 9 cars in the garage as you earn money! In Free mode, drive farther and pay for fuel at gas stations. Keep serving customers without advancing levels.

title: Doge Bubble
description: Doge Bubble is a classic bubble shooter game with multiple challenging levels. Doge Bubbles features the classic bubble shooter gameplay with 3 powerups: The rocket that clears the chosen path, the bomb that clears up to 8 bubbles at a time and the multi color bubble. The goal in each level is to "free" all the doge bubbles.

title: Spooky Link
description: Spooky Link is a relaxing Halloween-themed game where you connect matching spooky tiles. Tap a tile, then tap its match. If the path between them has two or fewer turns, the tiles are cleared. Each cleared tile creates more space to connect others. Enjoy many levels of fun with Halloween surprises!

title: Tung Sahur Coloring
description: Tung Sahur Coloring is a colorful joyride just waiting to happen! This super fun coloring game for kids turns every blank page into a chance to sparkle with creativity. Grab your virtual crayons and get ready to dive into the world of Tung Sahur, where imagination runs wild and colors know no rules. From cheerful characters to wacky shapes, each page is your personal canvas. Fill it with the wildest colors you can think of—green suns, purple trees, rainbow hats—anything goes here!

title: Marshmallow Rush
description: Marshmallow Rush is a one-button runner where you tap at the right moment to stack fluffy marshmallows, weave through cute obstacles, and dash to the finish. Build the tallest, sweetest tower you can, snag boosters for extra points, and master the timing to clear tricky layouts. Simple to play, satisfying to perfect—how far can your marshmallow tower go?

title: Downtown Parkour Drive
description:
Downtown Parkour Drive is a fast-paced stunt driving game set in a wide open city training ground. Take control of a powerful sports car and push your driving skills to the limit as you complete a series of challenging parkour-style levels.

Each level is designed with ramps, platforms, and precision-based obstacles that require perfect timing and control. From simple jumps to complex stunt sequences, the difficulty increases as you progress through all 30 levels.

title: Fashion Repair
description: Oh no, the girls stuff got broken and so dirty! Let's help them to fix their stuff! Remove the dirt on the phone, clean the bag, and sew rips in the cap. Paint with a new color and add some cute accessories. Decorate as nicely as possible and make their stuff look like new again. Don't replace it, repair it!

title: Topsy Turvy
description:
A spooky-cute arcade puzzler where you control a quirky little steampunk cannon.
Shoot and match creepy eyeballs or skull orbs before they slither their way to the drain!
Chain combos, clear the track, and survive as the creepy snake keeps crawling closer.
Simple to play, tricky to master and just the right amount of creepy.

title: Escape Room Mystery Key
description: Escape Room Mystery Key is an intense escape room adventure filled with horror and puzzle elements. Choose a role to enter an abandoned school or a hospital. Uncover hidden clues and keys to find your way out. In this game, you must carefully examine every detail in the room, searching for hidden clues.

title: Daddy Rabbit
description:
Daddy Rabbit must find all his lost babies inside the most amazing underground burrow you've ever seen. These baby rabbits sleep peacefully everywhere, but when daddy rabbit passes by, they will follow him all the way.
Baby bunnies will follow dad but will cry if they are awake and his dad wanders too far. When that happens, the zombies will get upset and go straight to eat them. That's when daddy rabbit will defend his sons with a carrot punch and give those evil zombies what they deserve.

title: CandyMatch.io
description: CandyMatch.io is a fun match 3 game with 100 levels, multiple game modes and attractive graphics.

title: Color and Decorate Christmas
description: Christmas themed coloring game for kids with 4 different colouring pages that will encourage your child to learn how to draw within the lines. Finally kids can have fun adding colorful Christmas stickers to decorate their art.

title: Basket Shot
description: Anyone may enjoy the swelteringly popular arcade game Basket Shot! Become the next basketball superstar by shooting baskets and unlocking new balls!

title: Cozy Kitchen Merge
description: This is an addictive cooking-themed merge game you won't be able to put down. Here, you'll become a kitchen master by merging identical ingredients and dishes to create new, more delicious cuisine. From simple vegetables to exotic feasts, continuously unlock tasty recipes from around the world. Fulfill customer orders to earn coins, and use them to upgrade and decorate your kitchen, transforming it from a humble diner into a dream culinary paradise.

title: My Cottagecore Aesthetic Look
description: Welcome to the My Cottagecore Aesthetic Look game. Cottagecore fashion is inspired by farm life, it is very impractical for doing chores around the farm! Princess Elsa, Anna, and Ariel are best friends planning to try something special. Get ready to explore the Cottagecore fashion style along with them to create the cutest looks!

title: White Party Surprise
description: Elsa invited Ariel Rapunzel and Cinderella to a white party Dress them up in appropriate outfits Pure white dresses skirts and tops are waiting to be chosen You can also find lots of accessories on the shelfs of wardrobes purses hair pins jewelry with pearls are ready to be taken Dont forget that Elsa told about some surprise What will it be

title: From Nerds to Beauties
description: Two girlfriends, the Little Mermaid and Arlene, embark on a world of stylish transformation. Their appearance, full of flaws, requires magical intervention. In the first stage of the game, the girls go through a series of fun cosmetic procedures that give them glowing skin and luxurious hair. At the second stage, you will have to become a stylist, choosing hairstyles, fashionable clothes and accessories. Each of your actions brings the heroines closer to their dream of becoming real beauties!

title: Idle Drive: Merge, Upgrade, Drive
description: Welcome to Idle Drive: Merge Upgrade & Drive! Unleash your creativity, craft a unique vehicle for travels. Start with a basic car, enhance it using in-game currency earned by tapping. Accumulate funds for components like engines and tires. Merge parts for higher levels, boosting speed and power. Visit the garage to customize your car. Idle DriftDrive offers exhilarating fun and satisfaction of creating your own ride. Perfect for car enthusiasts and racing fans. Exciting moments await you!

title: Cotton Candy Games for Girls
description:
Who doesn't love cotton candy? Now you can make your own in this sweet game! Choose from 12 yummy flavors and shapes, like hearts and stars. Decorate your fluffy treats with chocolate, fruits, ribbons and more.

Making chips
Do you like crunchy snacks? Then try this game and make your own chips! Follow the steps to harvest, wash, peel, slice and fry the potatoes. Add some spice to your chips with different seasonings like pepper, salt or pizza.

title: Dress Up Games & Coloring Book
description:
Coloring games for girls: start dressing up & create your own coloring pages
Cool combo of dressing and coloring games offline! Dress up dolls, pick backgrounds and your coloring pages are ready. Use glitter, gradient, and different patterns to color pictures, change any detail and create beautiful wallpapers in this fashion girl coloring book. New creative painting games you’ve been looking for! ???

Become a new doll designer. Create your own doll, dress up and makeup, choose hairstyles and accessories, then select the background. When the coloring page is created, start painting. Learn to combine colors and patterns, make your picture shine with glitter and gradient. It’s not that easy, but you can get a real masterpiece in the end. These girly games help you relax and teach you to be creative. Super interesting for those who love painting and drawing!

Dress up Games for Girls + Glitter Color Book

title: Makeup Fruits
description: In Makeup Fruits, give your favorite fruits a stunning makeover! Apply makeup, add accessories, and create fabulous fruit beauty icons. Choose from a variety of makeup options, including powder, lipstick, and eyelashes. Take a "selfie" of your creation and share it with friends! Earn gems to unlock even more fun items and keep the transformation going!

title: Black Hole vs Monster
description: Black Hole is ready for battle against big monsters. Gather your army with your black hole and fight against bosses. Don't forget to upgrade the hole to fight bigger and stronger monsters! Let the fight begin.

title: Zip Zap
description: Step into the fascinating world of Zip Zap, a unique online physics puzzle game that blends mechanics, movement, and precision. Tap, twist, and control your way through clever levels filled with moving parts and intricate structures. Every stage tests your timing and creativity — can you reach every target? Play for free on desktop or mobile and enjoy a perfectly balanced mix of challenge and relaxation.

title: Slenderman Back to School
description: On a very mysterious night you wake up and find yourself trapped in your high school, a town in Massachusetts, and you will have to survive until dawn and escape from the urban legend Slenderman. In Slenderman Back to School, a 3D online game, you will be able to feel the adrenaline that a horror game feels like.

title: Dolphin Dash
description: Launch your dolphin out of the water and smash through obstacles in this fast-paced underwater adventure. Collect coins, defeat bosses, and explore colorful ocean worlds full of surprises!

title: Pro Wrestling Action
description:
Get ready to rumble! Punch, kick, and wrestle your way through to be the last man standing.

Knock out your opponents, then throw them out of the ring!

Need to perform a spectacular feat? Climb the ropes, time your jumps and dive on the opponent.

Collect coins to upgrade your favourite wrestler in the shop.

Fans of WWE, WCW, WWF and UFC will love the game.

title: Top Burger Cooking
description:
Top Burger Cooking features:
- good graphics
- multiple levels

title: Funny Eye Surgery
description: Luke and Lora have been neglected their eyes by watching tablet all day, watch TV in dark, and never get their eyes proper rest. That cause problems to the eyes, and now they must go to eye doctor. Let's fix these kids' eyes so they can see better!

title: Eagle Coloring Book
description: Fun coloring book for kids and grown ups. Coloring is a great tool to relieve stress and relax the mind. Have fun!

title: Egg Farm
description:
Join the egg-citing adventure of Egg Farm and unleash your inner fox as you embark on a fast-paced egg-catching frenzy! 
Dash with lightning agility, master obstacle evasion, and craft a fox character like no other with a range of custom skins. It's time to become an egg-cellent egg-catching maestro - your prowess will earn you legendary status!

title: Minecraft Pixel Warfare
description: Minecraft Pixel Warfare" is a fast-paced PvP shooter set in blocky, Minecraft-inspired worlds. Players battle in competitive team modes (e.g., Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag) or free-for-all arenas using guns, grenades, and melee weapons—all with Minecraft’s iconic pixelated visuals. Unlock skins, upgrade weapons, and master maps to dominate the leaderboard!

title: Fish Tank: My Aquarium Games
description: Be ready to take care of your own pet fish and build an aquarium for your precious fish in this awesome game "Fish Tank: My Aquarium Games"? You need to take care of fish and even become a fish doctor!

title: Princesses Bridal Salon
description: Welcome to the most amazing bridal salon where any princess will find a perfect dress for the wedding of her dream Choose the princes you like the most and create for her the best bridal outlook ever Start with a wedding dress then come to the hairstyle and jewelries and complete the look with beautiful veil and wonderful bouquet  Your princess will be the best bride in the world Enjoy

title: Secret Rooms
description: After entering one of the rooms you have to find all the hidden objects. The names of the items you need to find will appear on the left side. You need to concentrate well and find all the objects in the room. You have to watch the time, because if it runs out it will be game over. Try to get the maximum points and three stars in every room.

title: NG: Flow Lines
description: Flow Lines is an engaging and straightforward puzzle game where the main objective is to connect dots of the same color through a continuous path on a grid.

title: Days of Xmas
description: On the first day of Xmas my true love sent me A new Match game to test my skills  Days of Xmas is the perfect game for these holidays A casual yet challenging game experience with a unique look

title: King Kong Chaos
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in King Kong Chaos, a modern 2D pixel art game where players must navigate through perilous levels, dodging spiked balls and barrels hurled by a colossal gorilla. Along the way, pick up the pickaxe strategically to destroy incoming barrels and secure the coveted golden banana to progress.

title: Candies All The Way
description: Slide a row of candies horizontally or vertically to make a horizontal or vertical row of 3 or more similar candies. Use mouse or finger tip to slide the rows.  Try and see how many levels you can complete in this time bound game.

title: Capybara Block Blast
description: Capybara Block Blast is a cozy puzzle game where you blast blocks alongside the world’s chillest animal, the capybara! Match colorful block shapes, clear lines, and rack up points while enjoying adorable animations and relaxing vibes. Whether you’re chasing a high score or just unwinding, this game offers the perfect mix of challenge and comfort.

title: Tile Living
description: Select matching tiles that can be connected with up to 3 straight lines to clear them! Clear all the tiles to complete the stage! Use the coins you collect from clearing stages to decorate your room!

title: Shoot Block Rush 3D
description: Shoot Block Rush 3D is a simple and easy-to-use shooting game consisting of many small levels. It doesn't require you to have great shooting skills. You need to choose the right abilities and paths to win. Your goal is to keep shooting in all directions and clear all the obstacles that stand in your way. Try to be the best destroyer and defeat the boss!

title: Block Puzzle Cats
description: Train your brain and solve puzzles with cute cats! Drag and drop the cats onto the puzzle board and try to put them all together! Unique puzzle shapes and ever-changing challenges will train your brain to think in a whole new way. Can you fit all the cats in? Collect cute new cats as you beat each puzzle challenge.Now come and join the fun and challenging game world.

title: Skibidi Toilet vs Cameraman Sniper Game
description: Camera man are trying to survive in toilet mans red light green light game. If there is a camera man moving when the toilet man says red light, you must destroy him with your sniper gun. When aiming, you have to make sure you hit the right player. If you shoot the correct player, you earn additional points. Compete with your friends by getting the highest score. Play Toilet vs Cameraman Sniper now!

title: Bubble Tea
description: Bubble Tea – Color Game is all about mixing and matching and blending and fusing a huge assortment of flavors and colors to create cold drink concoctions that will have you licking your lips. Receive orders, choose the right ingredients, pour them all into a cup, and serve to your thirsty customers. Take care not to spill your drinks in the excitement!

title: Chef Mix
description: Prepare ingredients cook them and try to remake famous sandwich recipes

title: Scooter Touchgrind Tricks 3D
description: Scooter Touchgrind Tricks 3D is an exciting and simple scooter game where you ride through challenging tracks filled with obstacles. Your main goal is to reach the finish line without crashing. As you play, you’ll need to dodge barriers, keep your balance, and react fast. You can collect coins along the way to unlock new scooters with cool designs. With smooth controls and many levels to explore, the game offers fun, speed, and tricks for anyone who loves action on two wheels.

title: Fun Mini Games For Princess
description: Welcome to Fun Mini Games For Princess, a collection of mini casual games for kids. Dive into the gaming world and enjoy the fun of playing at your fingertips! Whether you are a casual gamer who looks for relaxation or a skillful player with a purpose, you will find your favorite game and enjoy endless fun in our mini games. Our mini games cover a large range of categories.

title: Cubic Tower
description:
Build your own tower? Challenge the classic arcade game, but watch out – the digital edition has some new tricks!

What are you waiting for? Give it a try, it’s harder than it looks!

title: 4 Images and 1 Word
description: 4 Images 1 Word is a HTML5 Quiz Game. Guess the word in common for 4 images. Can you find it?

title: Merge Hero - Survival Tower Defense
description:
Quickly merge heroes to defend against monster attacks in intense tower defense battles.
Merge Heroes is a strategy tower defense game. Form and upgrade your hero units to prepare for an epic conflict battle that will test your wisdom and abilities.

title: Family Tree Puzzle
description:
Get ready to dig into the family history and piece together the puzzle! In Family Tree Puzzle, you’ll be presented with a set of clues that will challenge your problem-solving skills and test your ability to think critically.

Using the given information, assemble the family tree by connecting the dots between relatives and ancestors.

title: Harbor Operator
description:
As the harbor master and operator, navigate incoming ships to the correct docks. Tap and drag to draw routes into the docks, while taking into account the unloading time, speed, and other visual indicators.

Control beautiful ships such as yachts, super yachts, container ships, oil tankers and more. Plan your routes to avoid any shipping accidents.

title: NoNoSparks Genesis
description:
Be part of the genesis!

The goal of the game is to create a complete world step by step, including flora, fauna, humans and even dinosaurs, through solving logical puzzles based on nonograms.

The beautiful and humorous graphics and characters offer a charming appeal.
The unique reward-mechanic and the tried-and-tested, addictive puzzle gameplay create a flow that invites you back to yet another and another playing session.

Have fun!

title: City Bus Parking Simulator Challenge 3D
description: Welcome to the ultimate test of precision driving skills in the bustling urban environment! City Bus Parking Simulator Challenge 3D offers an immersive and thrilling gaming experience where you take on the role of a skilled bus driver tasked with navigating through complex cityscapes and parking your bus in tight spots.

title: How Smart Are You
description:
How smart are you? Answer random trivia questions ranging from broad topics such as popular culture, internet technology, geography, music, history and more.

Features:

- Simple and responsive design, suitable for customizations.
- Are you smarter than a 5th grader?
- Simple and clean design. Great for reskins.
- Full screen mode

title: Gun Rush
description: Fire off your epic selection of awesome guns to reach the end of each level while causing chaos and destruction! Amass coins to unlock more guns across endless levels of utter carnage!!!!! (╯°□°）╯︵ ┻━┻

title: Block Builder Jam
description: Block Builder Jam is a physics-based puzzle game that blends logic with creativity. Your goal is to drop blocks and fit them into the outlined shape on the screen. Each block falls according to real physics, so precision and timing matter. As levels progress, shapes become more complex and demand sharper planning. With its simple mechanics and engaging challenges, Block Builder Jam offers a satisfying mix of strategy and experimentation.

title: Pajama Party
description: It’s finally the weekend and you are heading over to the most epic slumber party of the season. Time to pick out the cutest pajamas, because who doesn’t want to relax and sleep in style?

title: Crazy Mommy Beauty Salon
description: Being a busy mom might get you insane if you are not having some welldeserved breaks from time to time so in this girl game you will actually help a crazy mom to get her preferential treatment Begin with the manicure part and once you are done you have to deal with her messy hair right away Do not forget about her face too because it needs a total restore and a deep relaxation time in order to recover

title: Which meme cat are you?
description: Which meme cat are you? Try this emoji quiz and find out! Just click on the emojis. Try to collect all 18 meme cats.

title: Flower Fairy Adventure Story
description: Welcome to Flower Fairy Adventure Story, a casual puzzle game that you can play for free. Flower Fairy lost her wings! Embark on an adventure where you solve each tiny jigsaw, dress up your girl in pretty clothes, and pave the way for the Flower Fairy. Practice your observation, logical thinking, and hands-on ability while enjoying the relaxing and captivating puzzle game.

title: Block Hexa Puzzle
description:
This is a great Puzzle game to challenge your brain, with more than 240 levels from beginner to advanced, easy to play very enjoyable game.
The goal is to drag pieces to board and fill up all grids!

title: Anomaly Content Record
description: Welcome to Anomaly Content Record, a terrifying horror adventure where your only goal is to escape and survive. You’re a field investigator sent to explore a restricted research facility that went silent overnight.

title: Stunt Fury
description: Stunt Fury takes adrenaline-fueled stunts to new heights in this action-packed gaming experience. Strap in and prepare to defy gravity as you showcase your skills on a variety of daring platforms. With heart-pounding excitement around every corner, this game challenges players to push the limits of physics and creativity.

title: Combinations Daily
description: Connect the tiles, make combinations and experience the ultimate puzzle adventure. Come back everyday for new challenges and maintain your monthly streaks!

title: Football Fun
description: Play as a team of 3 players against your opponents. Score goals and deflect attacks. Become the best player! The game has a store where you can buy many different balls and even stadiums. And the best players get on the leaderboard.

title: Badlands Hero
description:
Step into a treacherous world teeming with enemies and peril. Guide your hero across the battlefield — they’ll fire automatically when foes show up!

? Conquer intense levels
? Gain XP to unlock unique heroes
? Gather gold to enhance your gear
? Unleash powerful weapon types
? Face off against epic bosses and climb the ranks

Easy to play, hard to master. Do you have what it takes to rule the Badlands?

title: Fly Fly Fly
description:
Fly Fly Fly is a Flappy Bird alike game, where you have to fly through 30 different levels, avoiding obstacles an collecting berries. 
If you hit the ground it will be game over, if you crash on one of the earth worms around the level, you will lose a life. If you lost all your lives, it's game over. You can restore your health collecting the berries you will find around the level. Do your best and beat all the 30 levels and show the world what you really are!

title: Cake Pops Maker
description: Do you love cooking games? Do you love baking Cake Pops, Cupcakes, Cake, Candy, Donuts & other desserts? Then you will LOVE the most trendy Cake Pops Maker game. This food is now a fashion brand. You won’t miss it, and Cake Pops are the latest and greatest treat, and they're now available for your enjoyment.

title: Xmas Hidden Objects
description: This is a classic point and click hidden object game.  You need to find all of the items listed in the picture on the left side of the screen.  Complete the level before time runs out to get bonus points.

title: Kingdom Wars TD
description: Welcome to Kingdom Wars TD, an exciting tower-defense strategy game set in a captivating 2D kingdom. Assume the role of a skilled commander entrusted with the defense of a mighty castle. In your quest, assemble a formidable army comprising up to five soldiers, including archers, warriors, and priests. Brace yourself for the challenge of surviving two perilous waves across various meticulously designed levels scattered throughout the map. Immerse yourself in this thrilling adventure!

title: Meow Block: Color Collect!
description: A burst of color, clever thinking, and adorable cats await you in Meow Block: Color Collect! This charming puzzle experience turns simple movements into brain-teasing fun, where every swipe matters and every match brings you closer to victory.

title: Sprunki Puzzles and Singing
description: Before the sprunks take on their immediate duties, namely creating music, you must unlock sixteen characters. In the meantime, you have no one to create your own melodies with. To bring the Sprunki back to life, you must collect an image of each Sprunki. The picture consists of nine square fragments that are mixed on the playing field. Swap them and install them in the correct positions. Having collected all the puzzles, you can start making music in Sprunki Puzzles and Singing.

title: Puzzle & island
description: Collect diamonds and grow your island! Place blocks on squares to form vertical or horizontal rows. Game ends when no more blocks can be placed.

title: Moto X3M Dead Ahead
description: Racing game enthusiasts, are you ready? This is a game that's going to make your adrenaline skyrocket - Moto X3M Dead Ahead! It's an exciting blend of motor, driving, and even a bit of shooting. Driving a cool motorcycle, take your partner with you and race through tricky tracks.The game offers thrilling driving action as you avoid obstacles like wrecked cars, fallen debris, and explosive traps.

title: Ludo Wars
description: A unique Ludo game! Challenge an online player or challenge a friend in local two player mode. Be the first player to move all of your pieces to the end goal. Watch out for trap spaces and enemy pieces.

title: Shadowman Runner
description:
Shadowman Runner is a dark, atmospheric endless runner inspired by the minimalist silhouette style of Limbo and the fast-paced arcade spirit of games like Soul Knight and Alto’s Adventure. Set in a mysterious black-and-shadow world, the game challenges your reflexes, timing, and focus.
You play as a lone runner sprinting through a dangerous jungle landscape. Your goal is simple yet addictive: run as far as you can, collect potions to score points, and survive.

title: Moto Attack
description: Face the wonderful Moto Attack Showdown! In this explosive action game, you’re not just racing. You’re also shooting and fighting your way through waves of enemies in your powerful car! Perfect for every action-loving boy, Moto Attack is the high-octane combo of racing, driving, and shooting that you’ve been waiting for.

title: Kart Racing Pro
description:
A new and exciting kart racing  game with realistic graphics.

Turn left and right while overtaking other racers. 

Ride on speed lanes to get an edge over your opponent.

Collect fuel packs to extend your runway and score.

title: Dragon Egg Master
description: Sort colorful dragon eggs into matching nests in this relaxing puzzle game. Move eggs between nests and stack the same colors to complete each set. Watch magical dragons hatch with satisfying animations as you progress through increasingly challenging levels. Easy to learn, fun to master, and perfect for quick casual play!

description: Do you like Question Answer games? Trivia Quiz is waiting for you.

title: Color Dots Challenge
description: Dive into Color Dots Challenge, a bright and addictive puzzle game that puts your logic and strategy to the test. Connect, match, and move colorful dots to clear the board and score big! Simple to play yet hard to master, this free online game is perfect for quick breaks or long sessions on your phone or computer. Can you outsmart the colors and conquer every level?

title: Rescue Sharp Turn
description: Rescue Puzzle 3D is a lightweight 3D fun puzzle game. You need to click on the correct objects in the small three-dimensional scene to trigger mechanisms, remove obstacles or form a chain reaction to meet the level conditions and rescue the injured character. The levels are short but full of ingenuity: turn off the power switch, move rocks, release water to extinguish fire, synthesize props...

description: The stars are in the boxing ring and it is time to fight! These funny boxing characters are trying to destroy each other either in 1 player or in 2 player mode. Start this boxing competition and become the king of the boxing rings! Super fun physics with fun characters is waiting for you! Let the box fights begin!

title: Hangman Saga
description: Challenge your vocabulary with Hangman Saga! With thousands of levels, each word includes a category hint to guide you—like "Profession" for "Doctor." Guess the letters wisely, but too many mistakes end the game! Need help? Use the hint button for a clue. Perfect for all ages, this fun and educational word puzzle will keep you entertained while sharpening your spelling skills. Can you solve them all?

title: Road Painting 3D
description: In this game, you can pretend to be a real road sign designer. You will have various tools for road painting: roller, roller, many textures and colors, as well as entire cars for painting. And the main goal of the game is to decorate road signs and apply road markings. In addition to design decisions, you need to do everything carefully in order to get maximum marks. Make the city bright and beautiful.

title: Mahjong Seasons 1 - Spring and Summer
description: In Mahjong Seasons 1 - SpringSummer, your objective is to clear the Mahjong board by matching pairs of identical tiles. Each tile features unique symbols inspired by the beauty of spring and summer, such as blooming flowers, chirping birds, radiant sunshine, and more. Uncover and eliminate tiles strategically to reveal hidden ones and progress through the levels.

title: Wild Memory
description:
Match the same wild animal cards to win. How fast can you complete the set?

This is a fun memory matching game, suitable for everyone.

Train your brain and improve your memory every day.

Features:

- Tutorial
- Cool, minimalist theme
- Sleek and stylish animations

title: Fun Colors

In addition to an endless palette of colors and a variety of brushes, Fun Colors has the ability to upload your own images and coloring pages! And so that your eyes don't get tired of being in front of the screen for a long time, you can switch the interface to night mode! Finished your masterpiece? - send it to print without leaving the game!

title: Tile Fruits
description: In Tile Fruits, embark on a delectable adventure packed with vibrant fruits and captivating challenges! This 2D tile-matching game tests your strategic prowess as you aim to connect three identical fruits to advance through progressively difficult levels. Each match removes the fruits from the board, but beware: having more than seven different types of fruits on the board at once results in a loss.

title: Restaurant Simulator: Burgers & Pizza
description:
"Restaurant Simulator: Burgers & Pizza" is an exciting cooking and business management game where you become the owner of a fast food establishment. Prepare delicious burgers, tasty pizza, and other dishes while building a restaurant empire!

Features:
Real-time cooking - fulfill orders, combine ingredients
Varied menu - burgers, pizza, fries, drinks & desserts
Business growth - open new locations, hire staff
Economic strategy - manage finances, increase profits

An addictive hyper-casual game.
Build the bridges nicely to cross as many deeps as possible.
Use the special items (Attack, Second Chance, Accurate Eye, Jump) wisely to help your hero on his adventure.
There are many nice themes and cool heroes to unlock.
A global leaderboard is also supported. Try to win high scores and raise your name on the leaderboard.
ENJOY NOW!

title: Agents io
description:
Play Agents.io online! Eliminate other agents, grow your team, and dominate the arena in this free game.
Agents.io is a multiplayer action game where you control a lone agent and battle against others in an open arena. As you eliminate enemies, they join your team, allowing you to grow your squad and become stronger. The more agents you collect, the easier it is to dominate your opponents. Use smart tactics, avoid bigger squads, and climb to the top of the leaderboard!

title: Fun Obby Extreme

Are you ready to experience an extreme game Fun Obby Extreme is a 3D parkour type game, little Obby needs you to help him jump across the platforms and reach the goal of each level.

description: Ninja Spell Match is a fast-paced blend of match-3 puzzling and ninja action. Connect tiles to charge up your attacks and unleash devastating moves against waves of enemies. With each level, the challenge grows tougher as you fight your way through 30 unique stages packed with traps, puzzles, and rival ninjas. Stack Crash Ball is a 3d casual game where players smash, bump and bounce through revolving helix stacks to reach the end.
Sound easy? You wish!!
Your ball smashes like a brick through colorful stacks that block its descent, but if you hit a black one, it's all over! Your ball shatters to pieces and you have to start your fall all over again.
But even black stacks are no match for a fireball falling at full speed! Choose your strategy: speed up like a madman or stop and wait for your next chance to roll and jump.

Stack Crash Ball is a super fun and addictive one touch casual game.
Press and hold on the screen and let the ball go down without touching the obstacles! Hold as long as possible to make combo and break the black stacks. Let the ball fall down from the helix stacks.

title: ColorWars.io - Conquest Game
description: Color Wars is a fast-paced strategy game where you battle three opponents to control the most territory before time runs out. Deploy powerful cards like Warrior, Ranger, Thunder, and Wizard, each with unique abilities. Earn trophies by ranking in the top two and use gold to upgrade your cards. Plan smart moves, outplay rivals, and dominate the battlefield.

title: Obby Rescue Pin
description:
Obby Rescue Pin is a brain-burning, high IQ puzzle game that is especially addictive. How you pull the pins to rescue the Obby depends entirely on your logic and strategy!
Avoid Dangers: Navigate around bombs, ferocious animals, and deadly traps.
Outsmart the Room: Unlike simple rope rescue games, this experience focuses more on strategic adventures.
Help the Escape: Clear the path to help the Obby escape out of the dangerous room.

title: Reach 2048
description: The classic 2048 puzzle — slide numbered tiles on a grid, merge them, and reach the legendary 2048 tile! Simple to learn, impossible to put down. Challenge your brain with this addictive number puzzle. Plan your moves carefully, build combos, and aim for the highest score. How far can you go beyond 2048?

title: Splatcha!
description:
Splatcha! is a fast-paced local multiplayer party game where colorful blob rivals battle for paint-covered supremacy. Race against the clock in frantic 90-second matches, splashing every inch of the arena with your color while outsmarting your opponent. Play head-to-head on a single keyboard or sharpen your skills against AI opponents with three distinct difficulty levels: Chill, Rival, and Demon.

Master five wildly interactive arenas featuring spinning candy mixers, bouncing beach parasols, teleport portals, rising tides that erase paint, and a stormy castle packed with surprises. Turn the tide with explosive power-ups, speed boosts, shields, clones, storms, and more, while golden treasure chests and sudden-death overtime keep every match unpredictable. Arcade Series mode adds extra replayability with quick-fire challenges and escalating chaos.

With vibrant visuals, accessible controls, hilarious couch co-op action, and enough confetti to celebrate every victory, Splatcha! is the perfect competitive game for friends, families, and anyone who loves fast, colorful multiplayer battles full of strategy and fun.

title: Silent Fogs: Echoes of Evil
description:
Silent Fogs: Echoes of Evil is a First-Person shooter Survival Horror game inspired by Silent Hill and the Resident Evil series.

In the mist-shrouded ruins of a once-thriving American city, a war veteran returns home from the battlefield only to discover his greatest fight has just begun.

His daughter, Emily, has vanished. The last trace: a desperate call from a place that should no longer exist — a town swallowed by unnatural fog. As Daniel steps into the eerie streets, he quickly realizes something is horribly wrong. The city itself has become a living nightmare where humanity’s deepest sins have taken physical form and manifest as grotesque, twisted monsters that stalk the fog-choked alleys and decaying buildings.

Silent Fogs: Echoes of Evil is a love letter to classic survival horror, rebuilt for modern first-person immersion. Are you ready to face the monsters your sins created?

title: Ashen Ninja: Rust and Katana
description:
Ashen Ninja: Rust and Katana is a fast-paced hack-and-slash action game set in a breathtaking post-apocalyptic world buried beneath endless sands and the ruins of a fallen civilization. You step into the role of Black Ninja, the last surviving shinobi of the legendary Order of Light, awakened from cryogenic sleep long after the Great Fall—a catastrophic event orchestrated by ruthless factions seeking absolute power.

Armed with a razor-sharp katana and driven by vengeance, Black Ninja embarks on a dangerous journey to protect the innocent, uncover the truth behind humanity’s collapse, and confront powerful enemies standing in his way. Experience fluid sword combat, responsive movement, and satisfying hack-and-slash gameplay as you cut through hordes of foes and challenge formidable bosses.

Progress your hero by unlocking new abilities and becoming an unstoppable force in a world desperate for salvation. From abandoned cities swallowed by sand to haunting remnants of lost technology, every environment is crafted to immerse players in a striking vision of the future.

Featuring smooth combat, rewarding character progression, memorable boss battles, a straightforward story, and impressive visuals optimized for low-end PCs, Ashen Ninja: Rust and Katana delivers an action-packed ninja adventure that is easy to pick up and hard to put down.

title: The Patriots Revolution
description:
The Patriots Revolution is a free-to-play first-person shooter that combines fast-paced action with an attractive low-poly visual style. The game places players in the role of Ashley, a brave young woman living a peaceful life with her husband and child in a small American town. That peace is suddenly shattered when explosions erupt across the city, emergency alarms begin to sound, and military forces take control of the streets.

As chaos spreads, television broadcasts reveal shocking news: a powerful faction has carried out a coup, overthrown the government, and imprisoned the President of the United States. With her country thrown into turmoil and freedom under threat, Ashley decides to fight back. Armed with courage and determination, she joins the resistance movement and embarks on a dangerous mission to help restore order and defend the values she believes in.

Players will battle enemy forces across a variety of locations, complete challenging objectives, and experience intense firefights that require quick reflexes and smart tactics. The game offers accessible controls that make it easy for newcomers to jump in, while still providing enough action and excitement to keep experienced FPS fans engaged.

title: Unicorn Family Simulator
description: Unicorn Family Simulator is yet another great simulator where you’ll be controlling a unicorn. You can run around, explore the world and finish objectives. However, be sure to watch for enemies, mainly wolves and foxes. These can ambush and kill you. Try to defend yourself or run away. Aside from that you also need to watch your energy bar and eat regularly. You can also start your own family. The game offers beautiful 3D graphics and many different skins, so come on, let’s play!

title: Assault on the Demonic Realm
description: Assault on the Demonic Realm is a lightning-fast, adrenaline-fueled FPS that propels you into the heart of a demonic world. Navigate treacherous landscapes, from ancient fortresses to nightmarish temples, as you battle hordes of demonic minions and confront behemoths of monsters.

title: Tic Tac Foe
description:
Think you’ve mastered Tic Tac Toe? Think again. Tic Tac Foe reinvents the classic grid battle with over 30 unique power-up cards that transform every match into a strategic showdown.

Freeze cells. Erase symbols. Move pieces across the board. Expand the grid. Block future moves. And that’s just the beginning. Every card you draw can completely shift the momentum—so plan carefully, and outsmart your opponents. Easy to learn. Hard to master. Impossible to put down. Build your strategy, and prove you have what it takes to rise to the top.

Play Tic Tac Foe now and join the battle of brains, cards, and pure skill!

title: Platform Kid
description:
Platform Kid is a charming indie platformer that blends classic arcade roots with colorful modern flair. Set in the cheerful world of Hophop Land, the game follows a humble farmboy hero whose peaceful life is shattered when the evil Dr. Science and his ruthless Butcher Bandits kidnap his beloved Platform Girl and all the farm animals. Armed with nothing but determination—and a mysterious taunting note—Platform Kid embarks on a daring quest across diverse locations to save everyone he loves.

At its core, Platform Kid delivers pure, easy-to-learn platforming fun. Each level challenges players to explore, think creatively, and collect five hidden keys to unlock the exit. While the controls are intentionally simple—walk, run, jump, and double-jump—the level design encourages curiosity and rewards players who dare to stray from the obvious path. Secret routes, clever jumps, and off-screen surprises keep every stage engaging.

Boss fights break up the action with unique encounters, while vibrant visuals and an upbeat tone make the adventure accessible for all ages. Inspired by classic 2D platform games, Platform Kid focuses on tight controls, exploration-driven gameplay, and lighthearted storytelling. Whether you’re a nostalgic platforming fan or a newcomer looking for a fun indie adventure, Platform Kid offers a wholesome yet heroic journey worth taking.

title: The Last Santa Warrior: Winter’s End
description:
The Last Santa Warrior: Winter’s End is a dark fantasy action adventure where legend collides with holiday myth in a brutal fight for survival. In a kingdom crushed by tyranny and creeping corruption, Thorne—an ancient Santa Claus warrior torn from retirement—takes up his legendary axe for one final stand. Clad in crimson plate armor and driven by fate, he battles an evil King whose curse threatens to lock the world in eternal winter.

Set in the mythic Realm of the Ancients, the journey plunges players into haunting locations like the Dungeon of Skeletons, where wraiths roam and death echoes through bone-lined corridors. Expect visceral hack-and-slash combat, challenging enemies, and epic boss encounters wrapped in a grim, atmospheric narrative. With its unique twist on Santa Claus lore, gritty tone, and heroic last-stand storyline, The Last Santa Warrior: Winter’s End delivers a memorable action RPG experience forged in darkness, steel, and snow.

title: Planet Hero
description:
Planet Hero is an action-packed interstellar adventure where you command nine cosmic superheroes in a race to save four threatened worlds—Earth, Mars, Titan, and Hyperion. As a ruthless alien robot army sweeps across the galaxy draining planetary resources, you must wield each hero’s unique power to defend the cosmos from total annihilation.

From Sheriff’s blistering Rapid Fire and Max’s explosive Grenade Storm to Robert’s stunning Knock-Out lightning shots, every hero brings a signature playstyle that turns the tide of battle. Ignite enemies with Knight’s blazing Fire Bullets, melt defenses with Toxic’s corrosive Vulnerable rounds, or scorch entire squads through Pyroblast’s devastating Molotov attack. Unleash cosmic force with E.T.’s Lightning Hit, overwhelm invaders with Rambo’s Over-Charged fury, or rain destruction with Soldier’s triple-rocket Rampage.

With fast-paced combat, strategic hero swapping, and high-stakes planetary defense, Planet Hero: Defenders of the Cosmos delivers an electrifying sci-fi experience. Stand firm, harness your heroes’ power, and restore peace to the universe—its fate depends on you.

title: Project Exo Assault
description:
Project Exo Assault is a fast-paced sci-fi FPS multiplayer shooter designed for instant action and nonstop excitement. With just a few clicks, players jump straight into intense combat against skilled opponents or smart AI bots. The game features beautiful, atmospheric 3D environments that enhance every firefight, offering a fresh and competitive arena for all types of players. Choose from different futuristic weapons and explore multiple game modes that keep the challenge dynamic and engaging.

Inspired by legendary shooters like Halo, Titanfall, and Call of Duty, Project Exo Assault delivers fluid movement, smooth gunplay, and exhilarating battles that reward both strategy and skill. Whether you’re a casual gamer or an experienced shooter fan, this easy-to-play but hard-to-master multiplayer experience guarantees action from the first second. Prepare for fast reaction gameplay, teamwork tactics, and pure sci-fi adrenaline. Join the assault and dominate the battlefield!

title: The Crossing Barriers: Aid Deliverance
description: The Crossing Barriers : Aid Deliverance is a high-octane, top-down arcade racer set in the heart of a devastatingly war-torn land. you are a driver for a global aid agency. Your mission: navigate chaotic, ever-changing urban battlegrounds to deliver critical supplies—medicine, food, water—to civilians caught in the crossfire.

title: Rogue Sergeant: The Final Operation
description:
Rogue Sergeant: The Final Operation is an indie free story-driven first-person shooter game with beautiful graphics for Windows PC and web browsers.

Step into the boots of a battle-hardened soldier who refuses to follow orders blindly. Rogue Sergeant is a gritty, story-driven military first-person shooter that blends high-octane combat with tactical decision-making. Caught between loyalty to his army and the truth behind a shadow war, you’ll fight across war-torn villages, forests, and covert enemy strongholds. Every mission forces you to choose: follow standard protocols or take your own path, shaping the course of the campaign.

title: Marine Showdown: Standoff in Afghanistan
description:
Step into the boots of elite soldiers fighting across the war-torn landscapes of Afghanistan in Marine Showdown, a high-intensity, multiplayer-first FPS that blends fast-paced action with tactical realism. Engage in fierce combat across the battlefield, where every decision could mean victory or defeat.

Experience the grit and chaos of modern asymmetric warfare, where ambushes can turn the tide of battle in an instant.

title: Alone In The Evil Mansion
description:
Step into the shadowy corridors of Evil Mansion, a ِdark mansion steeped in unspeakable horrors. Inspired by the chilling atmosphere of classic Resident Evil and Alone in the dark, Alone In The Evil Mansion is a love letter to 90s survival horror—blending tank controls, Atmospheric backgrounds, and nerve-wracking tension. Armed with only a handful of bullets and your knife, you must unravel the dark secrets behind the mansion’s ghastly inhabitants. Solve eerie mystery, manage scarce resources, and fight—or flee—from grotesque monstrosities lurking in every corner. Every door creaks with dread, every hallway whispers forgotten terrors.

Key Features:

- Classic Fixed-Camera Angles – Experience the tense, cinematic horror of retro survival games with carefully framed shots that amplify the fear of the unknown. - Limited Resources & Survival Gameplay – Every bullet counts. Scavenge for ammo, herbs, and key items while battling nightmarish creatures that push you to the edge. - PS1-Era Aesthetic – Low-poly Character models, grainy textures, and eerie lighting recreate the unsettling charm of vintage horror games. Dare to step into Alone In The Evil Mansion—where survival is never guaranteed, and every corner hides a new terror.

title: Missile control: Infiltration Strike
description: Missile control: Infiltration Strike is a high-octane arcade action game that puts you in command of a powerful missile on a mission deep behind enemy lines. Blaze through hostile territory at breakneck speeds, dodge deadly defenses, and trigger explosive chain reactions as you race toward the enemy base. With stunning atmospheric visuals and intuitive controls, this fast-paced experience blends precision, chaos, and pure adrenaline. Whether you're looking for quick-fire fun or a white-knuckle challenge, Missile control: Infiltration Strike delivers explosive gameplay that keeps you coming back for more. Lock, load, and strike!

title: Baby Sniper In Vietnam
description: Baby Sniper In Vietnam is an action shooter game set during the time of the Vietnam War. Set in the backdrop of the Vietnam War, the game follows the journey of Minh, a baby who joins the Vietnamese Army and trains to become a sniper, determined to avenge. As players step into the shoes of Minh, they will experience a simple storyline filled with intense action gameplay. The game offers a unique perspective on the war, as players witness it through the eyes of a baby protagonist who is not only fighting for his country but also for her personal vendetta.

title: Lion Soldier's Vengeance
description: Lion Soldier's Vengeance is an action-packed, free third-person shooter set in a stunning, immersive world. Step into the paws of a fearless lion warrior on a mission to eliminate enemy forces in a wild, fictional universe. In this thrilling game, you'll face off against a variety of hostile humanoid animals across diverse combat arenas. Track down your foes, unleash powerful attacks, and dominate the battlefield. With intense gameplay and beautifully crafted environments, Lion Soldier's Vengeance delivers non-stop excitement for fans of animal combat games.

title: Red Escape
description: Red Escape is an immersive adventure puzzle game designed to challenge your logic and problem-solving abilities. Stuck in a sequence of three mysterious rooms, you must think critically, find hidden objects, collect useful tools, and crack complex puzzles to break free. Each room offers unique challenges and secrets waiting to be uncovered. As the difficulty increases, so does the thrill—making every escape a rewarding experience. Whether you're a seasoned puzzle enthusiast or a curious newcomer, Red Escape delivers an engaging gameplay experience packed with mental twists. Are you clever enough to conquer all three rooms and make your ultimate escape?

title: Soldier of Ruins
description: Soldier of Ruins is a gripping first-person horror shooter that plunges players into a nightmarish temple shrouded in mystery. As a skilled military operative, you’ll navigate eerie ruins, uncover dark secrets, and face relentless threats lurking in the shadows. The game masterfully blends atmospheric exploration with intense combat, keeping players on edge with its chilling environments and heart-pounding encounters. Designed for those who crave immersive storytelling without unnecessary complexity, Soldier of Ruins delivers a streamlined yet suspenseful experience. Will you survive the horrors within and unravel the temple’s apocalyptic secrets? Prepare for the unknown.

title: Idle Medieval: Tower Defense
description:
Idle Medieval: Tower Defense is a completely free game that challenges players to manage a tower and survive against endless waves of enemies for as long as possible. To endure, you'll have access to a variety of strategic powers—but use them wisely! Every decision matters, and choosing the right abilities at the right time is key to victory.

Each time you level up, you must choose one of four unique abilities, each offering distinct advantages. Your choices shape the course of the game, as the next level-up will enhance the selected ability, making it even more powerful. With the right strategy and skillful upgrades, you'll become stronger and better equipped to face increasingly difficult challenges.

Get ready for an addictive and thrilling experience where every decision could mean the survival or downfall of your tower. Do you have what it takes to become a legend in medieval tower defense?

title: Axe of the Ancients: Dwarven Fury
description:
Axe of the Ancients: Dwarven Fury is an epic action hack-and-slash adventure, blending stunning visuals with classic gameplay inspired by Warcraft and Golden Axe.  

Step into the boots of Thorne, a battle-hardened dwarf who, at 75, thought his warrior days were over—until fate called him back to arms. Corruption has overtaken his homeland, and only his legendary axe can restore balance. His journey begins in the dreaded Dungeon of Skeletons, a cursed crypt where the undead roam restlessly. With every swing, Thorne carves a path through darkness, uncovering secrets of the Ancients and forging his legacy.  

Are you ready to embrace the fury and reclaim what was lost?

title: Revenge and Justice
description:
Revenge and Justice is a gripping tale of vengeance, survival, and redemption in a world ravaged by destruction. Step into the role of Salvador, a skilled archer, as he embarks on a perilous journey through ruined cities reclaimed by nature, desolate wastelands, and hostile territories teeming with danger.  

In 2050, a devastating global war unleashed catastrophic weapons, triggering violent earthquakes that shattered civilization. The world was thrown into chaos, reducing humanity to scattered settlements, where survival became the only goal. Years passed, and a fragile peace settled over the remnants of society—until terror struck once again.  

A chilling warning reached Salvador’s village: “Leave, or we will take this land by force.” When the villagers refused, a brutal attack left most of them dead. Against all odds, Salvador survived. Now, fueled by loss and a burning desire for justice, he sets out on a mission to confront those who shattered his world. Will vengeance consume him, or will justice prevail?

title: Arena Baby Tournament
description:
Arena Baby Tournament is a fast-paced old-school shooter game inspired by classic games like "Unreal Tournament" and " Quake 3 Arena".

Step back into the golden age of gaming with "Arena Baby Tournament," an old-school arena third-person shooter that captures the essence of classic gameplay with a modern twist. In a dark and atmospheric world, players will engage in fast-paced combat across arenas. With an emphasis on skill-based Movement and chaotic Gunplay, "Arena Baby Tournament" invites you to unleash your inner champion and dominate the battlefield.

title: Legendary Archer
description: Legendary Archer is a thrilling archery adventure that puts your precision and focus to the ultimate test. Set against the hauntingly beautiful backdrop of ancient castle ruins, it’s just you, your bow, and a ticking clock. With 50 levels spread across 5 stunning and increasingly challenging locations, this game keeps you on your toes as the stakes get higher with each round. Designed to push your skills to the limit, Legendary Archer combines immersive gameplay with breathtaking scenery, delivering an unforgettable experience for players of all levels. Master your aim, conquer the challenges, and become the ultimate archer!

title: Two Hands of Satan
description:
Two Hands of Satan is a thrilling multiplayer first-person shooter that plunges players into intense, chaotic battles. This free-to-play game is designed to captivate with fast-paced, competitive gameplay, setting it apart in the shooter genre. Immerse yourself in electrifying 3v3 deathmatches, battling in vibrant arenas filled with intense action and atmospheric design. The game’s easy-to-learn controls and accessible interface make it perfect for both seasoned players and newcomers looking for adrenaline-pumping fun.

Whether you’re teaming up with friends or joining players worldwide, Two Hands of Satan brings unmatched excitement with its fast rounds and strategic playstyle. With simple, intuitive mechanics, this game is optimized for anyone craving an accessible, high-energy shooter experience without the cost.

title: The Surreptitious Operation
description:
The Surreptitious Operation is an intense action-adventure game that puts players in the shoes of Jack, a young and dedicated homeland security agent. Known for his patriotism and sharp instincts, Jack has quickly risen through the ranks, despite only having five years of experience. His trusted friend George, an investigative journalist, uncovers a trail of disturbing evidence linked to a powerful corporation. Alarmed, George turns to Jack for help.

When Jack reports the findings to his superiors, he’s met with an unexpected order to drop the case. Torn between loyalty and his duty to protect his country, Jack chooses to defy the orders and secretly embarks on a dangerous solo mission to uncover the corporation’s secrets. Players must guide Jack as he infiltrates the corporation’s offices, risking everything to safeguard his country from potential threats.

title: Volunteer to the Darkness
description: Volunteer to the Darkness is a gripping tale of survival and sacrifice, following Jose, a young man from South America, as he embarks on a perilous journey to the United States in search of a better life with his love, Lucia. Upon arriving in Los Angeles, Jose is met with harsh realities and endless obstacles, but the promise of U.S. citizenship drives him forward. His opportunity comes through an offer to join the military, but the path is deadly. Forced into a brutal competition known as "The Crucible," Jose's determination is further tested when he learns that Lucia has been kidnapped. With her life on the line, Jose must navigate the harrowing challenges ahead. Victory means freedom, failure means death.

title: Seeking Justice In The Galaxy
description:
Seeking Justice In The Galaxy is an epic game tale set in the aftermath of a cataclysmic world war in 2070, which left Earth ravaged and uninhabitable. Survivors ventured into space, forming a peaceful union on habitable planets. However, after nearly a century of tranquility, a coalition of three planets called the "Atlantic League," shattered the peace. They trained formidable military forces and unleashed chaos, enslaving planets and looting resources.

One planet, Resistentia, refused to surrender and fought back fiercely, managing to repel the invaders. Determined to prevent future attacks, Resistentia's leaders planned a daring commando operation. They dispatched their best soldier, Darius, on a covert mission to neutralize strategic targets across the three hostile planets. Darius, aboard a stealth ship, embarks on a high-stakes journey to restore peace and justice in the galaxy.

title: Robot wars : Rise of Resistance
description:
In the year 2100, Fifteen years after the devastating Third World War, the once great cities of Earth lay in ruins. Most of the population had been annihilated, and a few thousand numbers of survivors struggled to live. A group of wealthy elites, who had sheltered in their expensive bunkers during the war, emerged and established a colonial government, exploiting the remnants of humanity. They recruited a legion of ruthless mercenary soldiers, enforcing their rule with brutal repression.

A small group of people, want to fight back against the colonialists and restore freedom to the world. They formed a resistance movement and began to gather support from the oppressed people. Among the rebels, a group of engineers and scientists had embarked on a daring project: the creation of a combat robot capable of turning the tide of the conflict. Day and night, they worked tirelessly, pooling their knowledge and resources. The Resistance Coalition embarked on a series of missions to weaken the colonial government's grip on power. Their first objective was to liberate the city of New Hope, a once vibrant metropolis now under the occupation of the enemy's forces.

title: Tiger Family Simulator
description:
Tiger Family Simulator is a captivating game where you complete quests and level up to start and nurture your tiger family. Hunt and explore together in a vast, snowy forest, enhancing your family's traits to stay the strongest. With intuitive joystick controls, guiding your tiger is simple and realistic.

Choose unique breeds for each family member, each with distinct characteristics, adding depth to your gameplay. Engage in a wide variety of quests and upgrade your tiger's energy, health, and attack power to survive against predators.

Encounter diverse creatures and formidable bosses on your journey through a meticulously detailed open world. Enjoy daily gifts for consistent play and immerse yourself in a stunning environment. Experience the thrill of the wild in the Tiger Family Simulator!

title: Wolf Family Simulator
description:
Wolf Family Simulator is an action game where you live the life of a wolf in a captivating autumn forest. Embark on thrilling hunts, explore diverse locations, and build a formidable wolf pack.

Create a Wolf Family

Start by finding a mate at level 10 to assist in battles and protect against forest dangers. Reach level 20 to introduce a cub and tackle challenges together.

Enhance Survival Skills

Develop vital survival skills to protect your family. Boost health, energy, and damage stats for you and your wolf pack.

Unlock Diverse Wolf Breeds

Begin as a basic wolf and unlock breeds like the gray wolf, Indian wolf, jackal, coyote, and white wolf as you progress.

Face Forest Bosses

Watch out for powerful leaders like bears, tigers, and other wolves as you explore.

Open World Adventure

Explore a beautiful forest, gather coins, and improve survival traits.

Complete Quests and Earn Rewards

Finish exciting quests to gain experience and coins. Log in daily for special gifts!

title: Groomy Island
description: Groomy Island is a new horror-survival game that immerses you in a chilling 3D experience. Your primary objective is to survive while collecting 10 "Grimace Shake" shakes scattered across the eerie, expansive island. Follow the initial trail of light to your first shake and delve into the island's dark, deserted corners. The small map will be your guide as you navigate the treacherous terrain, ensuring you avoid succumbing to the island's horrors before completing your mission. Explore, survive, and conquer your fears in this gripping new adventure.

title: The Lonesome Shooter
description:
In the desolate plains of Wyoming, there lived an aged cowboy named Jack. His weathered face bore the marks of a life spent in hard work, and his heart held unwavering love for his only son, Ethan, who had left the ranch to serve in the US Army.
One day, a somber knock on his door shattered his tranquility. A military officer delivered the heart-wrenching news: Ethan had been killed in action. The old cowboy's world crumbled around him, his grief threatening to consume him. Days turned into nights as Jack mourned the loss of his beloved son. But a sense of unease lingered in his mind. Rumors had reached his ears that Ethan's death may not have been as straightforward as the official report claimed.
Jack embarked on a solitary investigation. With the help of a former buddy, he delved into the murky depths of the conflict, seeking answers that had been deliberately concealed. Their search led them to a remote outpost where Ethan had been stationed. As they pieced together fragments of information from reluctant soldiers, a chilling truth emerged. Ethan had not died in battle but had fallen victim to a satanic ritual, a sacrifice at the hands of his own comrades.
Jack vowed to expose the truth and bring justice to his son's memory. He then goes to his son's mission field with the motive of revenge.

title: The Scythian Warrior
description:
In the golden age, life was always spring. The soil was fertile and there was plenty of food. People were good and happy and old age came late. They were constantly in pleasant and free air and knew neither war nor poverty. Then came the Silver Age. Hunger and cold prevailed. People became selfish and divided. After the Silver Age, the Bronze Age came. People learned to make weapons and started to fight with each other.

The last age, the Iron Age, was the age of crime and infamy, and it was a time when mankind was completely destroyed due to greed and hatred. In the vast steppes of Scythia, a solitary warrior named Aryasp embarked on a perilous quest. Sent by his tribe's chief, he ventured into the depths of an ancient dungeon, To defeat the king who had killed many warriors.

title: The Malevolent Mansion of Evil
description: In the game The Malevolent Mansion of Evil, players become brave police officers investigating a chilling crime within a foreboding gothic mansion. As darkness descends, they navigate shadowy corridors, uncover sinister secrets, and confront spine-tingling horrors. The beautifully rendered gothic environment immerses players in an eerie world with intricate architecture, flickering candlelight, and foreboding ambiance. Ghostly apparitions, malevolent spirits, hidden traps, and macabre puzzles await discovery. Armed with only a gun, players must unravel the mansion’s dark past while contending with dread. Can you survive the horrors within? 🕯️🔍

title: A Snipers Vengeance
description:
This game, set in the backdrop of the Vietnam War, follows the journey of Linh, a young girl who joins the Vietnamese Army and trains to become a sniper, determined to avenge.

As players step into the shoes of Linh, they will experience a simple storyline filled with intense action gameplay. The game offers a unique perspective on the war, as players witness it through the eyes of a female protagonist who is not only fighting for her country but also for her personal vendetta.

title: Bullet and Cry in Space
description:
Experience the ultimate thrill with our action horror first-person shooter game set in a dark spaceship. Immerse yourself in an adventure as you navigate through the eerie corridors of a dark spacecraft. With realistic graphics and intense sound effects, you'll feel like you're truly trapped in this terrifying world. As you make your way through the ship, you'll encounter gruesome creatures lurking in the shadows, you must fight for humanity and uncover the mysteries of the abandoned vessel. Be prepared for intense battles and scares as you uncover the dark secrets hidden within the spaceship.

With a combination of action, horror, and first-person shooter elements, this game is perfect for horror enthusiasts.

title: Muscle Clicker: Gym Game
description:
Experience Muscle Clicker: Gym Game, transforming a skinny figure into a muscular powerhouse through rigorous gym routines. Initially weak, your character struggles with basic exercises but progresses by earning money through training and competitions. Manage stamina wisely; as you exercise, funds accumulate to purchase better equipment, enhancing muscle, wealth, and experience. With gained expertise, bolster strength and endurance.

This game mirrors real-life dedication—hard work yields success. Enjoy simple controls, diverse equipment, and customizable features including physical appearance and music choices. Witness real-time muscle growth and earn status points for each level completed. Unleash your inner muscle-building champ!

title: Darkness in spaceship
description: The story takes place in the future when the Earth has become uninhabitable and other planets are not suitable for life, so humanity lives only in large spaceships. The hero lives in a spaceship called Light and is a special agent. One day their ship is attacked by enemies. Enemies first bring monsters into the ship and then send robot soldiers. The hero must destroy the enemies and save his people.

title: Would You Rather?
description:
"Would You Rather?" stands as the quintessential group game for friends, offering an exciting array of over 120 thought-provoking questions. It's the ideal addition to any gathering, providing a perfect platform for social amusement. This party app promises an engaging experience, catering to both small groups and family settings, fostering shared moments of laughter and discussion. Its offline functionality adds to its versatility, transforming tedious road trips into engaging sessions filled with friendly debates and amusement.

Delve into a myriad of challenging "Would You Rather?" scenarios, spanning from the squeaky-clean to the daringly risqué, poised to challenge and entertain your circle of friends and loved ones. Will you conquer them all? This game sets the stage for an enjoyable and interactive experience, offering endless possibilities for lively conversations and unforgettable moments.

title: TOGETHER
description: Experience the exhilarating journey of TOGETHER, a captivating Platformer game that challenges you to navigate through obstacles by seamlessly switching between multiple players. Strategize and collaborate to conquer each level, utilizing the unique abilities of each character to progress through the mesmerizing black and white 2D world. Engage in a thrilling adventure where teamwork is paramount, as you leap, solve puzzles, and overcome hurdles by swiftly transitioning between players. TOGETHER offers an immersive gameplay experience, blending intriguing mechanics with visually stunning environments.

title: The Resistance Fighters
description:
The story of the game is about a young man who defends his country against enemies' invasion.

Isa is a young man who was born in America. His parents are Palestinian Christians who immigrated to America. One day Isa sees on TV that the Israelis have attacked Palestine again.
